description:
In Houston, our Team Jeni's Team Leaders have the opportunity to earn an average of $18.44 per hour!*

*This is an estimate of hourly earnings. It is based on the 2026 base pay rate, plus 2025's hourly tip average. 2026 actual customer tips may vary.

In Texas, if the average hourly earnings of a Team Leader are less than $17 per hour in a two-week pay period, Jeni's will add the difference to the person’s paycheck so that their average hourly earnings reach $17 per hour for that pay period.

Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams is searching for part-time Team Leaders to join our Citycentre team.

At Jeni’s, we’re devoted to making better ice creams and bringing people together. Our scoop shops are at the heart of how we serve this mission. They are where we offer the ice creams we work so hard to build from the ground up—where people come together to share joy and conversation. We love people. We love ice cream. We view ice cream as a form of art.

Team Jeni’s Team Leaders are part-time crew members who lead shifts. In addition to leading shifts, they scoop and serve ice cream to our customers, make waffle products, run the register with cash management responsibilities, keep the shop clean, change out buckets of ice cream, and perform a number of other important, related tasks.

As a Team Leader, you will:

  • Serve the ice cream Time magazine calls “the best in America”

  • Gain valuable real-world business and entrepreneurship experience

  • Work in an environment oriented around serving each other and making people’s day

  • Lead shifts and act as a role model for other team members

  • Have opportunities for growth within a growing company

  • Receive competitive compensation

Qualities of Team Leaders:

  • Exhibit passion for community, an eye for detail, a willingness to clean (a lot), stamina (to serve people in long lines), and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • The ability to positively influence and lead a shift of ambassadors, helping them uphold the highest standards and feel supported

  • Resourceful and calm when challenges come up

  • Have great judgment, common sense, and be skillful interpersonally

  • Familiar with (and be able to articulate to customers) what distinguishes Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams from other ice creams, and be able to articulate that to the 500th customer with the same care and presence as the 1st customer

  • Available to work weekends, late nights (past 11 p.m.)

  • Provide consistent, world-class service to every single customer

  • Reliable, on time, and ready to hustle for every shift

  • Committed to the well-being of their shop team, their community, and the environment around them

About Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams:

Founded by Jeni Britton in 2002, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams is a B Corp headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with scoop shops in over twenty cities across the country, making it possible for members of Team Jeni’s who are interested in developing their careers, or transitioning to a new city, to have meaningful opportunities to learn, grow, and explore.

Our Team Leaders make a difference in their shop, their community, and in how they partner with their team and serve their customers. If this opportunity sounds delicious to you, please apply.

Jeni's is an equal opportunity employer. Said our way, we love and honor differences, and we love sharing common values such as talent, hustle, guts, resilience, and empathy. Our differences are a primary source of our team's strength and we crave having a team rich with diversity which is creativity and art in its human form.

title: Fencing Specialist Queens
description:
ABOUT US

New York Edge is the largest after-school and summer camp program provider in New York City public schools. Each year, academic programs, including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access, help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

SUMMARY

New York Edge is looking for passionate and enthusiastic individuals to fill the role of Fencing Specialist. In this position, you will be critical in providing tailored, age-appropriate coaching and mentoring to young people in New York Edge's after-school day camp programs. As a Fencing Specialist, you will organize and lead fencing activities, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience for all participants.


WORK SCHEDULE

  • 9-15 hours per week.

  • Monday through Friday -- 2:30 pm - 5:30 pm


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS



  • Motivate students to engage in fencing activities and promote daily physical fitness.

  • Develop and implement lesson plans that are structured, age-appropriate, and align with our fencing curriculum, focusing on skills such as footwork, lunging, and blade control.

  • Maintain communication with the Program Director regarding schedules, competitions, and special events, including local tournaments and fencing exhibitions.

  • Encourage student participation in organization-wide fencing events and activities.

  • Establish and enforce safety rules and procedures to maintain order among participants, emphasizing the importance of sportsmanship and respect.

  • Instruct participants on fencing techniques, including attacking, defending, and scoring, while ensuring proper use of equipment such as masks, jackets, and fencing weapons.

  • Set clear lesson objectives and communicate these goals to students, focusing on skill development and tactical understanding.

  • Prepare facilities for fencing practices and matches, ensuring the area is safe and properly equipped.

  • Evaluate activities to ensure they meet desired learning outcomes and adapt to accommodate varying skill levels.

  • Foster the development of athletic skills and positive character traits, such as discipline, focus, and resilience among youth.

  • Provide support during academic hours as needed.



REQUIRED SKILLS

  • knowledge and experience in fencing, with a background in coaching or instruction preferred.

  • Prior experience teaching or mentoring youth is highly desirable.

  • Ability to follow a structured curriculum while adapting to meet participants’ needs.

  • Responsible, reliable, and punctual.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent required; some college preferred

  • A minimum of one year of work-related skill, knowledge, or experience is required.

  • A minimum of one year of teaching or coaching experience is required.

  • Must have passion for New York Edge's mission and demonstrated interest in education and youth development.

  • Candidates qualified to lead instruction in more than one activity are also preferred.


The Sports Specialist will be required to report to the school building and interact with staff, students, parents, and school administration.

At the time of offer and acceptance, the job requires safety and security clearances through the Department of Education and Department of Health.

New York Edge is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer

title: Resident Assistant The Washington Center - Part-Time Overnight Shift/ 32 Hours Per Pay Period
description:
This is a Part-Time Overnight Shift Resident Assistant position in The Washington Center Assisted Living which works 11:00 p.m. - 7 a.m. Schedules include every other weekend and every other holiday. This position is 32 hours a pay period.

St. Joseph Residence is a not-for-profit Catholic continuing care community seeking caring, compassionate, and responsible individuals to join our assisted living community to provide personal care and daily enrichment in a faith-based environment, supporting and promoting resident independence, respect, dignity, and community.

The Resident Assistant position is a great opportunity for someone who is looking to change careers, is beginning their career, or reentering the workforce. Are you an energetic and positive person who enjoys seniors and the elderly? Will you ensure our residents receive excellent care? Join our team!

Our assisted living communities strives to create a safe and stimulating environment, focusing on socialization and engagement, utilizing a friend-to-friend approach. The resident assistant plays a significant role in engaging our residents in meaningful activities throughout our resident's day.

Primary Shift Responsibilities: This position is responsible for providing direct care services to residents who reside on our community. Overnight shift typically assists residents with morning cares, administers medication, basic laundry and housekeeping services, and leading and assisting with resident engagement activities.

Having a C.N.A. certification is very helpful, but if you don't have C.N.A. certification that is okay. We will provide training and help with assisted living certification for those who possess the skills and attributes we are looking for to join our team.

Resident Assistant Duties Include:

Personal Care: Feeding, bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting, incontinence care, walking and transferring

Responsible for providing timely treatments and medication administration under delegation of an RN

Participate in customizing resident service plans

Monitor resident condition and address change of condition

Housekeeping service to resident's apartments including laundry, housekeeping

Work in collaboration with residents/family members, coworkers, and other healthcare providers

Responsible for timely and accurate charting in the medical record

Represent the St. Joseph Residence organization in a professional, customer service-oriented manner

Participate in team meetings, performance improvement projects, and ongoing education

State Required Certification Courses: Standard Precautions, Fire Safety, First Aid, Medication Administration

If you are willing to take courses, we will assist you in enrolling in the courses, and you can work while completing the courses

Availability to work every other weekend and alternating holiday schedule

Reliability: Must be punctual, have reliable attendance, and a good work ethic

Adaptability: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Team Collaboration: Interpersonal skills and the ability to work and contribute to a positive team dynamic

Professional Representation: Maintain a professional demeanor and deliver exceptional customer service while representing the St. Joseph Residence organization and communities

title: Advanced Practice Professional - Wound Clinic
description:
Regional West Physicians Clinic has over 28 specialty clinics to assist in the needs of the communities we call home. We are actively looking for a caring individual to join the team as an Advanced Practice Professional in our Wound Clinic.

As an RWPC Advanced Practice Professional, you will:

  • Assess patient health by interviewing patients, performing medical examinations and studying medical histories
  • Identify short term and long term patient care issues to be addressed
  • Determine abnormal conditions by administering or ordering diagnostic tests and interpreting results
  • Provide continuity of care by developing and implementing patient management plans
  • Prescribe medications within scope of practice as needed

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Graduated from an accredited Physician Assistant or Advanced Practice Registered Nurse program
  • Passed national certification
  • Licensure as a PA or APRN in the State of Nebraska

If this sounds like you, we’d love to connect!


A conditional job offer is contingent upon successfully passing a pre-employment drug test and background checks. A Physical Capacity Profile may be required for some positions.

title: FT Compliance Coordinator
description:
ABOUT US

New York Edge is a non-profit organization and one of the largest providers of school-based afterschool programs in New York City and the metropolitan region serving over 25,000 elementary, middle, and high school students each year. The mission of New York Edge is to help bridge the opportunity gap among students in underinvested communities by providing programs designed to improve academic performance, health and wellness, self-confidence, and leadership skills for success in life.

SUMMARY


Under direct supervision of the Compliance Manager, the Compliance Coordinator handles the various day to day pre-employment related operations within the New York Edge Compliance Department including communicating with staff and management regarding the processing of required background checks for potential employees. The Compliance Coordinator will have experience with pre-employment candidate background check requirements and provide high quality of customer support.


Primary Job Functions:

  • Review employment background clearance applications for completeness and accuracy, and process all required background screenings within designated timeframe

  • Manage a caseload of background check clearance requests for all prospective employees and transfers

  • Serve as the main point of contact during the background check process to candidates, Program Managers, and external agencies (Third Party) while providing high levels of customer support

  • Ensure proper workflow in document completion, collection, correction, and submission to DOH

  • Work closely with Compliance Specialist on all department operational activities and processes

  • Maintain, update and improve current employee records and database filling system on a daily basis

  • Update individual candidate tracker systems and report out to candidates and management as needed

  • Meet with new and/or rehire to collect and review compliance paperwork ensuring complete and accurate submissions during assigned office hours

  • Assist with Site inspections by preparing personnel compliance files and verifying document accuracy before submission; Conduct periodic site compliance file audits regularly and as assigned

  • Acquire and maintain understanding of background check regulatory requirements that may impact the organization’s processes and services

  • Performs other related duties as assigned by management


Supervisory Reports:

  • Update and submit new hire background screening updates to Compliance Manager as needed and requested

  • Update internal candidate tracking systems and create staff files on a daily basis


Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s degree preferred or requisite years of experience

  • 1 year of satisfactory experience in Human Resources, Compliance or related field

  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and diplomacy

  • Solid time management skills and the ability to work under pressure with tight deadlines

  • Ability to work accurately and within aggressive timeframes with acute attention to detail

  • Excellent teamwork and ability to work independently

  • Outstanding customer service and follow through skills

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

  • Super organizational, problem-solving, and analytical skills

  • Demonstrate ability to plan, prioritize, and manage multiple projects; flexible in changing work priorities

  • Proficient with Google Applications and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel), including document editing, and tracking changes

At time of offer and acceptance, the job requires safety and security clearances through the Department of Education and Department of Health. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and communities to apply.

title: Facility Director
description:
Why Acreage CCF New Jersey

Acreage CCF New Jersey is a subsidiary of Canopy USA, LLC, a leading vertically integrated, multi-state operator in the United States cannabis industry. With the transition of Acreage Holdings to Canopy USA, LLC in December 2024, Canopy USA, LLC is now positioned to consolidate operations across its three business units – Wana, Jetty, and Acreage – realizing synergies, cost savings, and supporting growth in state-legal markets across the U.S.

Through coverage of key market segments including flower via Superflux, vape and concentrates via Jetty, edibles and beverages via Wana, and retail through The Botanist, Canopy USA, LLC is well positioned to accelerate growth with an emphasis on the Midwestern and Northeastern U.S. markets. As newly formed Canopy USA, LLC, we are building a stronger, more agile organization that will unlock greater opportunities across the growing US cannabis market.

Who you’ll work for: Acreage CCF New Jersey, Egg Harbor Township

Our Culture:

Here at Acreage CCF New Jersey, Egg Harbor Township we believe in people first. We value our people and encourage continuous opportunities to learn, develop, and grow. We pride ourselves in innovation and passion for the cannabis industry.


We are always looking for motivated people who share our vision to join our team. Think you have what it takes? Then come grow with us!

About the Role:

The Facility Director serves as the single on-site leader and head of the facility, with full accountability for all operational aspects. This includes overseeing cultivation, harvest, production, processing, packaging, and finished-goods operations to deliver consistent, premium-quality cannabis products. The role manages all department leaders and their teams, drives operational efficiency, ensures strict compliance with state regulations and company SOPs, tracks and reports key performance indicators (KPIs), and aligns facility performance with company-wide goals. The Facility Director proactively addresses challenges, optimizes resources, and fosters a high-performance culture to meet production targets, budgets, and strategic objectives.

How you’ll make a difference:

Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly supervise, coach, and develop all department managers (e.g., cultivation, processing, packaging, inventory) and their respective teams, building a collaborative, high-performance culture across the facility.
  • Conduct regular performance evaluations, deliver constructive feedback, and implement development plans to drive continuous improvement and employee engagement.
  • Develop and lead comprehensive training programs to enhance skills, safety awareness, and compliance across all teams, exceeding baseline regulatory requirements where possible.

Facility & Production Oversight

  • Oversee end-to-end operations from cultivation and harvest through processing to finished-goods packaging, ensuring seamless integration, high-quality standards, and maximum operational efficiency.
  • Manage daily execution of all production, processing, and packaging activities while maintaining full adherence to state regulations, company SOPs, and internal policies.
  • Review, adjust, and optimize labor and production schedules based on business demands, incoming orders, product availability, resource constraints, and production goals.
  • Track, analyze, and report facility-wide KPIs (e.g., yield, throughput, waste, downtime, compliance metrics) and implement adjustments to meet or exceed targets.

Production Management and Oversight

  • Oversee all production phases from harvest through to finished goods processing, ensuring high-quality standards and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure timely and compliant execution of all production and packaging tasks, maintaining adherence to state regulations and company SOPs.
  • Review and adjust labor production schedules based on business needs, production goals, and resource availability. Track and report KPI metrics and adjust, as needed.

Quality & Compliance

  • Champion and enforce rigorous quality control systems to consistently produce premium cannabis products that meet or exceed standards.
  • Lead thorough audits of batch records, inventory, seed-to-sale tracking, and operational data to guarantee accuracy, traceability, and full regulatory compliance.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate compliance risks, ensuring the facility operates with integrity and zero tolerance for violations.

Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives to streamline workflows, boost productivity, reduce waste, and enhance overall facility performance.
  • Evaluate, implement, and manage new technologies, equipment, or methods to improve efficiency, product quality, and scalability.
  • Set and manage packaging and production goals aligned with inventory levels, sales forecasts, and regulatory requirements.

Reporting, Documentation, & Strategic Planning

  • Prepare and review comprehensive inventory, production, and financial reports to monitor progress against monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and targets.
  • Ensure accurate, real-time updates in seed-to-sale systems, inventory tools, and other tracking platforms.
  • Partner with senior leadership to establish facility goals, forecast production for sale, address operational challenges, and contribute to long-term strategic planning.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives that support company objectives, including cost control, employee retention, and operational excellence.

Other Responsibilities

  • Manage facility-wide resources, including budgeting, safety protocols, maintenance, and employee relations issues.
  • Resolve escalated operational, compliance, or personnel matters effectively and directly.
  • Other responsibilities, as assigned by manager
  • Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Skills to be Successful:

Minimum Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong leadership abilities with proven success in team development, performance management, and fostering a positive, high-accountability culture.
  • Deep knowledge of cannabis cultivation, processing, manufacturing, and regulatory compliance (state-specific regulations, seed-to-sale tracking).
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills; ability to prioritize and adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • Skilled at conflict resolution, employee relations, and handling escalated issues with integrity and fairness.
  • Proficient in production/inventory management software, seed-to-sale systems (e.g., Metrc or equivalent), Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), and other relevant tools.
  • Must pass federal and state-mandated background checks.
  • Operates with high integrity; trustworthy, reliable, and committed to ethical standards.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Proficient with inventory systems and office equipment
  • Knowledge of plant tracking software; state-mandated

Education and Experience

· Must be 21 years of age or older

· Bachelor’s degree in business management, operations, plant science, or a related field – Required

· Minimum 5 years of progressive leadership experience in cannabis production, manufacturing, or a regulated industry, with at least 3 years in a senior supervisory or managerial role – Required

· Demonstrated track record of successfully leading teams and achieving operational goals in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment

Perks & Benefits:

  • Annual compensation commensurate with experience
  • Full suite of medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Long-Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Employee life insurance and supplemental life
  • Spouse and child life and AD&D
  • Pet insurance
  • FSA and HSA available

*Based on eligibility.

Schedule:

40-hour work weeks: Monday – Friday minimum requirement with additional days / hours as required

**Subject to change as business needs.


Work Environment and Physical Demands:

The work environment characteristics and physical demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Manufacturing environment which requires extended time standing, walking, bending and reaching. Ability to carry up to 50lbs for up to 100ft may be required. Occasional extended and repetitive use of arms, hands and fingers. Ability to work in a humid and pollinated environment. Ability to work well and effectively in a manufacturing environment.

E-Verify Participation Notice

This Employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

What is E-Verify? E-Verify is an internet-based system that compares information from and employee’s Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, to data from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and Social Security Administration records to confirm employment eligibility.

Code of Conduct:

All employees are expected to represent the values and maintain the standards contained in the Code of Conduct.

Acreage CCF. New Jersey is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, disability, or protected Veteran status. We appreciate your interest in Acreage CCF, New Jersey]. If you need assistance with completing an online application due to a disability, please send a request to [insert email address]. Please be sure to include “Accommodation Request” in the subject line.

title: Senior Analyst, Financial Reporting
description:
Be Part of the IMAX Experience.

​

For more than 50 years, IMAX has been a global leader in entertainment technology, redefining how stories are experienced on the world’s biggest screens. Our mission is to power awe-inspiring experiences for audiences around the world.

Our people make everything we do possible. We’re curious, creative, and driven by the belief that great work happens when people are trusted, heard, and supported. At IMAX, you’ll collaborate with purpose in an environment that values innovation, diverse perspectives, and learning at every stage.

We invest in people and empower them to thrive. Our culture is grounded in trust and shaped by a shared belief that our best work happens together. By championing curiosity and encouraging courageous thinking, we push the limits of imagination and create experiences that redefine what’s possible. Careers here are shaped with intention, achievements are shared, and people always come first.

With our global team spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, IMAX brings together proprietary software, world-class architecture, and cutting-edge technology with deep industry expertise. Together, we partner with leading filmmakers and studios, advance entertainment technology, and connect audiences around the world to The IMAX Experience.

Come explore IMAX and create what inspires.

Ignite your future with IMAX.

About the Role:

The Senior Analyst, Financial Reporting is responsible for supporting IMAX Corporation’s financial reporting, consolidation, technical accounting, and financial analysis activities. This role will work to ensure accurate financial reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP and SEC requirements.

The Senior Analyst, Financial Reporting, under the guidance of the Financial Reporting management team, will be expected to assist with complex accounting matters including revenue recognition for IMAX systems, consolidations, and internal and external reporting for a global organization with over 30 legal entities, international operations and joint ventures.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the preparation and analysis of monthly and quarterly consolidated financial results and internal management reporting packages.

  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of financial information.

  • Assist in the preparation of accounting analyses related to revenue recognition for IMAX Systems in accordance with ASC 606.

  • Prepare certain account reconciliations, investigating trends, variances, and unusual transactions.

  • Assist with the preparation of quarterly and annual SEC filings, including supporting schedules, note disclosures, and tie-outs.

  • Support process improvement initiatives, automation projects, and other special projects as required.

  • Assist in documenting accounting processes and maintaining strong internal controls over financial reporting.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • CPA designation or working towards obtaining.

  • Understanding of U.S. GAAP and familiarity with ASC 606 or IFRS 15.

  • 5-7 years of experience in public accounting and/or financial reporting or corporate accounting.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Excel. Experience with AI-enabled productivity tools, or data analytics solutions is considered an asset.

  • Flexibility to work overtime during quarter-end, year-end, and other peak reporting periods as required.

title: RTM Analyst
description:
We are the movers of the world and the makers of the future. We get up every day, roll up our sleeves and build a better world -- together. At Ford, we’re all a part of something bigger than ourselves. Are you ready to change the way the world moves?

As part of our Manufacturing team, you’ll help build the world-class, state-of-the-art smart vehicles we're known for. In our plants around the world, we’re constantly developing new technologies and processes to further increase our efficiency. You'll get the satisfaction of making great products people use and love.

In this position...

The RTM & NA Inbound Network Design and Cost Analyst (Efficiencies, MCC, Warehousing, New Model, MFE, PF) role presents an exciting opportunity to take on a role in a critical area in our current Supply Chain climate. Apply your MP&L and Supply Chain knowledge to drive Cost and Efficiency to our Transportation Network.

What you'll do...

  • Implement freight efficiencies to achieve the assigned plants calendarized and annualized targets.

  • Develop logistics commodity strategies with Transportation Purchasing Organization.

  • Develop equipment & routing specs for Request for Quote with Transportation Purchasing.

  • Publish supplier shipping instructions, daily change management; including responding to operating plan changes.

  • Support TPO in helping carriers react to changes at least cost

  • Manage inbound freight cost by identifying and implementing improvements and tracking physicals.

  • Identify cost savings through sourcing changes and density changes.

  • Cube Utilization metrics, Planned to Actual metrics

  • Audit and dispute logistics provider billing discrepancies.

  • Review & Approve TONU, Approve Plant Requested pull-aheads, etc…

  • Interface with Plant Group Managers and MP&L Managers to manage logistics related issues between plants, suppliers and carriers.

  • MEL Meeting & metrics, Cost Reviews (with LLP Logistics Analyst)

  • Demurrage/detention tracking and adjudication for Rail and Intermodal.

  • Monitoring Cube Utilization, Brokering, Add/Cancel metrics, Rack Return-to-plan

  • Execute Forward Model Logistics plans in conjunction with the LLP and affected plant(s).

  • Interface with Lead Logistics Provider to ensure quality and timely delivery of services.

  • Monitor via weekly Plant Launch call

  • Support reductions in LLP Management fee. This also includes managing changes in LLP staffing to support shift, complexity and volume changes.

  • Support reduction in premium freight cost by ensuring proper float levels of in plant inventory.

  • Create 5% year over year save on long term purchase order agreements.

  • Achieve a reduction in brokering for key carriers utilizing Data Warehouse reports and detailed brokering & book of business reviews.

  • Maintain or improve 5.8 sigma rating for overall quality performance level for production disruptions.

  • Support new product launches in with zero production losses due to logistics failures.

  • Use Data and Performance Metrics to Develop Standards and Strategies based on Origin for float, transportation, and method of origin to reduce overall Transportation Cost including TONU, Detention/Demurrage Cost and Premium Freight.

  • Develop Standards and Strategies to Create a “Plan for Every Part” based on Transportation Flow including Routing, Float and Shipping Standards.

  • Interface with TPO on contracts for Transportation Provider Contracts.

  • Drive Optimal Window Times to the plants and Penske PLC teams to drive Optimal Window Times and Transportation Flow into our Plants.

  • Use our Pull Ahead Tools to Drive Improved KPIs for Cube and Rack Utilization.

  • Align our Cost to Production to Schedule and find creative ways to lessen the impact to our Transportation Network.

  • Lead efforts to use Telematics to help reduce our costs in Premium Freight and Accessorial Costs.

You'll have...

  • High School Diploma or GED

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong CMMS3 knowledge,

  • Rail / Intermodal Carrier Operations Experience

  • Experience with CMMS3 Data/Datamart/Alteryx or other Data Analytical Tools

  • Strong understanding of MP&L (CMMS, Data Warehouse) and Microsoft (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access) systems.

  • Travel maybe be required to the plants, External Warehouses, Provider Sites. Weekend work may be required on an exception basis.

  • Ability to create presentations with clear objectives that tailor your content to your audience’s interests, knowledge level and needs.

  • Strong supply chain and Plant Experience Preferred.

title: Harm Reduction Specialist - Cluster 1
description:
Job Title: Harm Reduction Specialist
Classification: Full-time, Non-Exempt
Reports to: Director of Peer Programming
Location: Works across four sites based in Manhattan (Huntersmoon Hall, Rustin House, Prospero Hall, Schafer Hall)
Status & Hours: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Lantern staff may be asked to adjust their work schedule depending on the operational needs of the site and the agency.

Who We Are: Lantern Community Services helps New Yorkers impacted by homelessness move from surviving to thriving by pairing safe, supportive housing with wraparound services that build lasting stability and independence. If you believe a steady home can be the start of everything else, you'll fit right in with our mission-first team. Lantern was also recognized as a Top 2025 Workplace by City & State New York — a great place to do meaningful work with people who care!

About the Role: The Harm Reduction Specialist is a critical team member within Lantern's Integrated Services Programming, providing person-centered support to individuals experiencing homelessness, mental illness, substance use challenges, and chronic medical conditions, including HIV/AIDS, within a supportive housing environment. This role focuses on promoting health, stability, and recovery through harm reduction strategies, substance use education, and linkage to services. The ideal candidate is compassionate, knowledgeable in harm reduction practices, able to support individuals in making informed decisions to improve their overall well-being, and invested in working collaboratively as part of an interdisciplinary service team.

Essential Functions: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Individual Tenant Engagement:

  • At each assigned site, work individually with a small, targeted caseload of tenants who have Harm Reduction goals related to acute substance use and health needs, supporting risk reduction, relapse prevention, coping skills, and treatment decision-making.
  • Provide person-centered harm reduction and substance use services that engage residents and promote health, wellness, and housing stability.
  • Conduct risk assessments related to substance use and provide appropriate referrals.
  • Identify short- and long-term service needs and support residents in achieving their goals.
  • Utilize harm reduction approaches to address mental health and substance use challenges.

Workshop and Group Development and Facilitation:

  • In collaboration with Harm Reduction Leadership, develop workshop curricula and group sessions on a variety of topics including recovery education, healthcare self-advocacy, coping skills, and social support based on tenant needs and interests.
  • Utilize evidence-informed interventions such as Seeking Safety, Illness Management and Recovery, Wellness Recovery Action Planning, and others for group engagement.
  • Facilitate group counseling sessions and educational and skill-oriented workshops.

Community Partner Collaboration and Resource Tables:

  • In collaboration with Harm Reduction Leadership and Integrated Services colleagues, engage in community outreach and support tenant participation in harm reduction activities.
  • Coordinate on-site health and service engagement and educational tables.

Documentation, Administration, and Interdisciplinary Collaboration:

  • Document all services, interventions, and assessments in accordance with program requirements, including OOPP and harm reduction supply tracking.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential resident records in compliance with funder and organizational standards.
  • Participate in staff meetings, clinical meetings, and supervision to ensure best practices.
  • Collaborate with interdisciplinary team members to coordinate care and support educational initiatives related to substance use and other risk behaviors.
  • Participate in training and pilot programs related to evidence-based practices and innovative adaptations to enhance service delivery.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • CASAC-T required, or willingness to enroll in a CASAC program within six (6) months of hire, with completion within eighteen (18) months.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience providing harm reduction and substance use services.
  • Experience working with individuals impacted by homelessness, mental illness, substance use, HIV/AIDS, or chronic medical conditions.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a diverse caseload.
  • Ability to work under pressure, including in crisis situations.
  • Experience conducting risk assessments and making treatment referrals.
  • Experience with community outreach.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with electronic case management systems such as ETO or CASES.
  • Experience with evidence-based practices including Motivational Interviewing.
  • Experience developing and facilitating workshop and group curricula.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.

Work Environment: This position operates in a supportive housing setting in New York City and works with individuals who may experience mental illness, substance use, disability, HIV/AIDS, and other chronic health conditions.

Physical Demands: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, climb stairs, and/or kneel. They must also use their hands to type, handle, or feel. The employee is frequently required to talk or hear and must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Other Duties: Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Lantern Community Services provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Lantern values the diversity of our clients, staff, Board of Directors, and partners. By bringing diverse individuals and viewpoints together, we create more vibrant, healthy, and just communities.

title: To-Go Specialist

title: Team Leader
description:
In Columbus, our Team Jeni's Team Leaders have the opportunity to earn an average of $21.11 per hour!*

*This is an estimate of hourly earnings. It is based on the 2026 base pay rate, plus 2025's hourly tip average. 2026 actual customer tips may vary.

Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams is searching for part-time Team Leaders to join our Grandview team.

At Jeni’s, we’re devoted to making better ice creams and bringing people together. Our scoop shops are at the heart of how we serve this mission. They are where we offer the ice creams we work so hard to build from the ground up—where people come together to share joy and conversation. We love people. We love ice cream. We view ice cream as a form of art.

Team Jeni’s Team Leaders are part-time crew members who lead shifts. In addition to leading shifts, they scoop and serve ice cream to our customers, make waffle products, run the register with cash management responsibilities, keep the shop clean, change out buckets of ice cream, and perform a number of other important, related tasks.

As a Team Leader, you will:

  • Gain valuable real-world business and entrepreneurship experience

  • Lead shifts and act as a role model for other team members

  • Have opportunities for growth within a growing company

  • Receive competitive compensation

  • Exhibit passion for community, an eye for detail, a willingness to clean (a lot), stamina (to serve people in long lines), and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • The ability to positively influence and lead a shift of ambassadors, helping them uphold the highest standards and feel supported

  • Resourceful and calm when challenges come up

  • Have great judgment, common sense, and be skillful interpersonally

  • Familiar with (and be able to articulate to customers) what distinguishes Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams from other ice creams, and be able to articulate that to the 500th customer with the same care and presence as the 1st customer

  • Reliable, on time, and ready to hustle for every shift

About Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams:

Founded by Jeni Britton in 2002, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams is a B Corp headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with scoop shops in over twenty cities across the country, making it possible for members of Team Jeni’s who are interested in developing their careers, or transitioning to a new city, to have meaningful opportunities to learn, grow, and explore.

Our Team Leaders make a difference in their shop, their community, and in how they partner with their team and serve their customers. If this opportunity sounds delicious to you, please apply.

Our differences are a primary source of our team's strength and we crave having a team rich with diversity which is creativity and art in its human form.

description:

title: Preconstruction Intern
description:
About Us:

The Garrett Companies is a full-service multifamily development, construction, and property management team with offices in Denver (CO), Indianapolis (IN), and Nashville (TN). We develop, build, and manage multifamily projects in 22 states — working together at every level to become the most successful multifamily developers in the country. Our superior strategies and award-winning culture span across 18,000+ apartments to date, and our expert trend forecasting helps us deliver living options that quickly find success in their unique markets. To make living and investing in our properties even better, we pair that expertise with mixed-use, retail, office, and restaurant development through trusted partners and in-house brands. At The Garrett Companies, we are passionate about turning visions into reality! As leaders in the multifamily industry, we pride ourselves in creating communities that positively impact the markets we are in, and our residents can proudly call home.

What You’ll Be Doing:

The Preconstruction Intern works in unison with the Preconstruction Team to review, document, understand, and deliver buildable plan sets that are within established budgets. The Preconstruction Intern assists with multiple projects by studying plans, performing on-screen takeoffs, and quantifying materials and scopes of work.

Major Objectives:

  • Understand the role Preconstruction provides as a critical link between the Development and Construction teams.
  • Ensure all plans meet the intent of Development and verify the project is constructible.
  • Assist with tracking plans throughout the entire process.
  • Assist with the procurement of subcontractors for their assigned projects.
  • Ability to become proficient in Bluebeam.

Specific Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Perform plan quantity take-offs and provide accurate documentation.
  • Use quantity takeoffs and past cost data to develop initial budgets.
  • Assist in the bid process, subcontractor coordination, and other related activities.
  • Understand Garrett Standards and inspect plan sheets to ensure they are being achieved.
  • Support Preconstruction Team with additional duties as assigned.

Educational Background:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in construction, construction management, or construction technology.
  • Must have a current GPA of 3.0 or above.
  • Experience with marketing, public speaking, and presentations is a plus.

Prerequisites (these are the most important items):

  • Positive attitude.
  • Relentless problem-solving skills.
  • Will never claim the work of others as their own.
  • We are trend setters and standards breakers. Our intent is to consistently surprise our audiences by being excellent.
  • Ability to anticipate.
  • Understanding the difference between causation and correlation.
  • We are all broom pushers. Every member of our team is willing to work and support at all levels.

Perks of the Internship:

  • Real-World Experience
  • Mentorship: Learn from industry experts and build relationships that will help facilitate your career.
  • Growth and Learning: At The Garrett Companies, we believe that Culture = People. That’s why we provide an array of opportunities for our interns to grow as individuals, including applicable learning opportunities, professional development, and more.

title: Android Developer – Ads Platform
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.

Viaplay is accelerating our growth on Advertising & Monetisation with sharper focus to bring measurable, attractive, modern advertising formats to the Nordic market cross all our platforms. Right now, we’re searching for an Android Developer in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

The Role

We are looking for an engineer to help build and evolve our ads & monetisation experience across mobile video and streaming products, focusing on our Android platform. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the user experience while solving complex technical challenges around playback, performance, reliability, and advertising delivery. You will work in a product team, collaborating with other teams, developers, backend engineers, product managers, designers, data/analytics specialists, and commercial stakeholders and partners, to deliver high quality ads experiences for our users.

What your day might look like

  • Design, build, and maintain features on our platform, related to ads monetisation in a modern mobile app

  • Work with tracking and measurement of ads, and ad decisioning integrations

  • Contribute to smooth, reliable ad experiences across live, linear, and on-demand streaming use cases

  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams on integrations involving client-side and server-side ad insertion workflows

  • Improve app performance, stability, observability, and user experience around ad playback

  • Participate in technical discovery, architecture discussions, code reviews, testing, and release activities

  • Help troubleshoot complex production issues related to playback, ads, analytics, and device-specific behaviour

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a passionate and experienced developer with a genuine interest in Android development. If you have experience in working with other clients or TV applications, we would be blown away.

You thrive in a high energy, team-driven environment where you love getting stuff done, and having fun while you are doing it.

Successful candidates also meet all or some of the following:

  • 5+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with a strong focus on building and scaling Android applications

  • Experience developing customer-focused products

  • Strong expertise in Kotlin, Java, or modern Android frameworks

  • Good understanding of architecture, performance optimisation, testing, debugging, and maintainable code design.

  • Experience working in complex mobile user journeys and if there is experience with video playback, streaming, media apps, we would be blown away.

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Insight into Jetpack Compose and the future of Android UI development

  • Experience with advertising technology in media streaming, such as TCF, SSAI, CSAI, VAST, VMAP, ad SDKs, ad tracking, or measurement

  • Experience from AVOD, FAST, live streaming, OTT, or other ad-supported video products

  • Knowledge of Android media playback frameworks, ExoPlayer/Media3, DRM, analytics, experimentation, or observability

  • Experience working with commercial, ad operations, or monetisation stakeholders

Why join us

You will have the opportunity to work on a business-critical area where you directly contribute to product quality, viewer experience, and sustainable revenue growth. You will join a team where technical excellence, experimentation, and collaboration are valued, and where your work can have visible impact at scale.

What we offer you

  • We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.

  • Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.

  • Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.

  • A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.

  • An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.

  • Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

Hit play today

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Music Specialist Queens
location: Far Rockaway Sites, Far Rockaway, NY, US
description:
ABOUT US

New York Edge is the largest provider of after-school and summer camp programs in New York City public schools. Each year, programs in academics, including STEM, the arts, sports and wellness, and college access, help 40,000 students develop leadership skills and succeed in school. Working parents count on our programs to provide safe and enriching environments for their children.

SUMMARY

New York Edge is seeking passionate and enthusiastic people to fill the role of Music Specialist. In this role, you will organize, lead, and promote interest in music activities. Instructors utilize and adapt the New York State Arts Learning Standards to create engaging and rewarding activities that encourage participation in New York Edge programs.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Establish and enforce rules for behavior and procedures for maintaining order among the students for whom they are responsible.

  • Organize, lead, and promote interest in arts activities such as music, drumming, and percussion.

  • Organize performance groups and direct their rehearsals.

  • Establish clear objectives for all lessons, units, and projects, and communicate those objectives to students.

  • Ascertain and interpret group interests, evaluate equipment and facilities, and adapt activities to meet the student’s needs.

  • Prepare materials and classrooms for class activities.

  • Explain principles, techniques, and safety procedures to participants in the activities and demonstrate the use of materials and equipment.

  • Evaluate activities to determine if they are producing desired results.

  • Adapt teaching methods and instructional materials to meet students' needs and interests.

  • Progressive development of student skills leading to a final project


REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Must be knowledgeable and skilled in various performing arts and have prior experience successfully teaching and instructing youth.

  • Must be able to follow a curriculum

  • Must be responsible, reliable, and punctual!

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required.

  • May be required to walk up and down stairs.

  • May have to lift or move objects/materials as needed.

  • Work is performed mostly within a New York City Public School but may be required to interact with the community at-large during trips or events.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent required; some college preferred

  • A minimum of one year of work-related skill, knowledge, or experience is required.

  • A minimum of one year of coaching experience is required.

  • Must have passion for New York Edge's mission and demonstrated interest in education and youth development.

  • Candidates qualified to lead instruction in more than one activity are also preferred.


WORK SCHEDULE

  • 9-15 hours per week.

  • Monday through Friday -- 2:30 pm - 5:30 pm



The Music Specialist will be required to report to the school and interact with staff, students, parents, and the school administration.

At the time of offer and acceptance, the job requires safety and security clearances through the Department of Education and Department of Health.

title: Thrift Associate
description:
Thrift Associate

The Arizona Humane Society is looking for a dedicated and motivated part time Thrift Associate to work at our Mesa Thrift Store location on Saturdays and Sundays from 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM. If you are a dedicated customer service professional, please continue to read more now!

Paws Up For Great Benefits!

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous PTO program
  • Up to 8 paid holidays per year
  • 401(k) with employer contribution
  • Medical, Dental and Vision Plans
  • Got student loans? Employment with AHS may qualify you for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program!
  • Discounts on veterinary services and other pet perks!

A Day in the Life:

The Thrift Associate will be responsible for ensuring safe and efficient operation of the thrift store. The Thrift Associate will help maximize revenues through use of approved marketing and display techniques, appropriate pricing practices and excellent customer service.

Job Requirements:

  • High school diploma / GED required
  • Thrift store and/or merchandising experience preferred
  • Ability to manage time independently in an unstructured environment with minimal supervision
  • Must be able to run the cash register without assistance upon completion of training.
  • Accept, process and price donations providing the best customer service to both donors and customers.
  • Assist customers with loading and unloading their donations/purchases, including furniture items.
  • Upon completion of training, must be able to process donations quickly and efficiently which can be up to about 700 garments or about 40 boxes of hard goods in a shift.
  • Assist volunteers with thrift store operations. Volunteers are to be thoroughly trained on cash register, receiving donations, processing and customer service.
  • Work closely with Thrift Store Drivers to ensure prompt pickups of donated items. Be ready and available to help drivers load and unload the truck if necessary.
  • Prepare inventory for all estate donations; prepare all required documents for tax purposes.
  • Keep volunteer roster current, including phone numbers and days and times worked; distribute copies to appropriate individuals. Track and maintain record of volunteer hours worked.

Physical Demands/Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 75 pounds. There may be occasional wet floors, odors, and dander. Most time will be spent in a typical air conditioned and heated office environment.

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Additional Information

The Arizona Humane Society is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a participant in the E-Verify program.

Ready to Join our team and make a difference every day?

Explore all of our current career opportunities here: Careers - Arizona Humane Society

Pre-employment background check is required.

title: Travel Superintendent
description:
Position Summary:

The Construction Superintendent is responsible for managing and overseeing the quality of construction activities on-site. This role ensures that all construction work meets the required standards, project specifications and is completed within the established schedule and budget. The Superintendent works closely with project managers, engineers and contractors to maintain high-quality construction standards and safety on the job site. This role would require about 40-50% travel.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Project Oversight:

o Supervise and monitor the work of contractors and subcontractors to ensure compliance with project plans, specifications, and quality standards.

o Conduct regular inspections of construction activities to ensure that work is performed according to contract requirements and safety regulations.

o Coordinate with project managers and engineers to resolve any issues related to construction quality or safety.

2. Quality Assurance:

o Implement and maintain a comprehensive quality assurance plan for the construction project.

o Conduct inspections and tests to ensure materials and workmanship meet project specifications and industry standards.

o Identify and document any quality issues or defects and work with contractors to implement corrective actions.

o Schedule and lead meetings with subcontractors and clients following preparatory phase, initial phase and follow-up phase meetings as applicable in a timely manner.

3. Documentation and Reporting:

o Maintain detailed records of construction activities, including daily reports, inspection reports and quality control documentation.

o Prepare and submit reports on the progress, quality and safety of the construction project to project managers and stakeholders.

o Ensure all necessary documentation, such as permits and inspection certificates, is obtained and maintained.

4. Safety Management:

o Ensure that all construction activities are conducted in compliance with safety regulations and company policies.

o Conduct safety inspections and enforce the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) on the job site.

o Report any safety incidents or near-misses and implement measures to prevent future occurrences.

5. Coordination and Communication:

o Collaborate with project stakeholders, including architects, engineers, contractors and clients, to ensure project goals are met.

o Attend and participate in project meetings, providing updates on quality and safety issues.

o Communicate any changes or deviations from the project plan to the relevant parties and ensure proper documentation.

6. Training and Development:

o Provide training and guidance to on-site personnel on quality control procedures and safety protocols.

o Stay updated on industry best practices, construction techniques and regulatory changes, and share this knowledge with the team.

  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Job Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering or a related field is preferred.
  • Must be either a citizen of the U.S. or a non-U.S. citizen who has been lawfully admitted for permanent residence as evidenced by a Permanent Resident Card (USCIS I-551).
  • OSHA 30, EM 385-1-1(preferred), USACE CQM(preferred) certification and CPR/1st Aid certification.
  • Ability to successfully pass and remain in compliance with required background checks from Tribal 1 and any required federal government background checks.
  • Must pass drug screen and remain in compliance with drug free workplace policies.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Ability to travel to various construction sites located in Colorado (50-75% traveling).
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds, stand or sit for long periods of time, access roofs, crawl spaces and all construction areas.

Experience:

  • Successful prior track record as a Superintendent on Federal government projects for a minimum of five (5) years.
  • Experience executing Quality Control Plans that align with Government Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans and Performance Measures.
  • Experience with writing, developing or modifying company and/or site-specific safety programs.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership and team management skills, including problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Willingness to complete additional training and/or obtain certifications in order to support contract requirements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in construction management software.
  • Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of construction processes, materials and legal regulations.
  • Understanding of Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and agency specific regulations, including the Defense Federal Acquisition Regulations (DFAR).
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and technical drawings.
  • Competent with MS Office products (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.).

Working Environment:

  • This position requires primarily working on constructions sites, which may involve exposure to varying weather conditions and physical hazards.
  • Travel may be required to various project locations.
  • Must be able to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, to meet project deadlines.

title: Commercial Estimating Intern
description:
Commercial Estimating Intern
From Onboarding to Premier Estimates
Location: Phoenix, AZ
Department: Estimating
Reports To: Estimating Manager / Senior Estimator
Program Length: 13 Weeks
Employment Type: Internship
Launch Your Career in Commercial Roofing Estimating
Diversified Roofing is seeking a motivated, detail-oriented Commercial Estimating Intern to join our Estimating Department. This structured 13-week internship provides hands-on training in commercial roofing estimation, project analysis, quantity takeoffs, and construction costing.
This is more than a data-entry internship. Our goal is to develop future estimators who understand commercial roofing systems, project execution, risk assessment, and how accurate estimates drive successful and profitable projects.
Working alongside experienced estimators, you'll gain real-world experience reviewing construction documents, performing takeoffs, analyzing costs, and learning industry-leading estimating practices using EDGE Estimating Software.
By the end of the program, successful interns will be capable of independently completing portions of estimates and preparing smaller project estimates for review by senior estimating professionals.
What You'll Learn
  • Commercial roofing systems, materials, terminology, and installation methods.
  • Reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications.
  • Quantity takeoff techniques and estimating best practices.
  • Material, labor, equipment, freight, and subcontractor cost analysis.
  • Risk identification, scope development, and proposal preparation.
  • Vendor and subcontractor pricing coordination.
  • Industry-standard estimating processes using EDGE software.
  • Quality control procedures that ensure estimating accuracy and completeness.
Key Responsibilities
  • Learn company estimating standards and the components of a Premier Estimate.
  • Develop proficiency in EDGE Estimating Software.
  • Review plans, specifications, addenda, bid invitations, and contract documents.
  • Perform digital takeoffs for roofing systems, flashings, drains, sheet metal, insulation, and related scope items.
  • Assist in calculating material quantities, labor requirements, equipment needs, freight, and project costs.
  • Request, organize, and evaluate vendor and subcontractor pricing.
  • Identify scope gaps, clarifications, exclusions, and potential project risks.
  • Support estimate reviews and quality-control checks.
  • Participate in project turnover and sales-to-production handoff meetings when appropriate.
  • Analyze completed projects to understand how estimating decisions impact field execution and profitability.
  • Maintain organized estimating files and documentation.
  • Assist in documenting estimating procedures and EDGE workflows.
  • Demonstrate increasing accuracy, accountability, ownership, and independence throughout the internship.
Qualifications
  • Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business, Architecture, or a related field.
  • Strong math, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn.
  • Interest in construction, estimating, project management, or roofing preferred.
Success Profile The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, organized, coachable, and eager to learn. Successful interns prioritize accuracy over speed, take ownership of their work, and continuously improve through feedback and hands-on experience.
What You'll Gain
  • Hands-on experience with commercial roofing estimating.
  • Training from experienced estimating professionals.
  • Exposure to real construction projects and bidding processes.
  • Proficiency with industry-leading estimating software.
  • A strong foundation for careers in estimating, project management, and construction operations.
  • Potential opportunities for future growth within Diversified Roofing.
About Diversified Roofing
Diversified Roofing is a leading roofing contractor dedicated to delivering exceptional commercial and residential roofing solutions. Our success is built on safety, quality, innovation, and operational excellence. We invest in developing future industry leaders and provide meaningful opportunities for growth and professional development.
Diversified Roofing is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description:
About

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.

Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!

Our Culture

At , we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Be AI-First in Everything You Do: We reach for AI first, not as a fallback. Automate the routine—spend your time on judgment and impact!
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!

Role Description

You'll join our Frontend Department as a Senior Frontend Developer, taking ownership of complex modules within our Vue 3 single-page application. You'll own code development, automation, and testing to ship functional, secure, and user-friendly features, working closely with our Backend Department, raising the bar on code quality, and mentoring mid-level and junior developers.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Influence architecture decisions and technical direction of different modules, not just implementation.
  • Shape the structure and design of platform modules and REST APIs, including real-time features on Web Sockets.
  • Own complex product features end-to-end, working closely with the Backend Department.
  • Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to automate builds and testing.
  • Utilized AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code/Cursor) and AI-assisted testing/review as a default workflow, not a fallback.
  • Balance functional and aesthetic design, keeping every screen responsive and on-brand across devices.
  • Develop reusable, well-documented frontend components and libraries the wider team can build on.
  • Optimize application speed and scalability as our user base and feature set grow.
  • Review code for quality, consistency, and performance, sharing feedback that helps the team improve.
  • Troubleshoot and debug frontend issues quickly to keep the user experience smooth.
  • Coach and mentor mid-level and junior developers as they grow into the team.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3-4+ years of relevant software development and/or testing experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Vue.js, ideally Vue 3.
  • Firm grasp of JavaScript (ES6+), Typescript, HTML5, and Tailwind CSS.
  • Experience building Single Page Applications (SPA) using Web Sockets.
  • Proficient with Vite/Rollup build tooling and Git/GitHub, including CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Vitest and Vue Test Utils for unit testing, Playwright for e2e testing.
  • Self-starter, comfortable working independently under pressure.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, able to isolate tricky bugs quickly.
  • Clear communicator in English, comfortable explaining complex ideas verbally and in writing.
  • Node.js, Tan Stack Query, and Design Systems experience (with Storybook) is a plus.
  • Performance profiling, bundle optimization, PWA, i18n, and Sentry familiarity is a plus.
  • Exposure to a UI library such as Vuetify, Quasar, Shadcn, or Reka UI is a plus.
  • GitHub profile link in your application is a plus.

What's in it for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a mental health allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

title: Business Intelligence Business Analyst
description:
Join Our Team as a Business Intelligence Business Analyst at KFC Rohloff Group!

Does transforming data into actionable insights excite you? We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Business Analyst to join our dynamic team at KFC Rohloff Group. The BI Business Analyst acts as the bridge between business needs and BI solutions, ensuring that reporting and analytics align with strategic objectives. This role focuses on gathering requirements, defining KPIs, and supporting the design of dashboards and data models that enable actionable insights. You will analyze business requirements, design BI solutions, and collaborate with stakeholders to deliver insights that drive operational efficiency and business growth.

What You'll Be Cooking Up:

Requirements Gathering & Analysis

  • Engage stakeholders to collect and document BI requirements.
  • Translate business needs into functional and non-functional specifications for reporting and analytics.

Solution Design

  • Work closely with the BI team to ensure solutions meet business objectives.
  • Participate in workshops and sessions to refine complex requirements and advanced analytics use cases.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to enhance BI processes and reporting efficiency.

The role will focus on API integration engineering, data quality, automation, reporting, and the secure integration of AI capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for building reliable, well-documented, and supportable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve the quality and accessibility of business data.

Job Details
Work Setup: Work from Home
Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | UK Time
Holidays: Will follow UK holidays

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain API integrations between business systems, including two-way synchronization between platforms and integration with the central data layer.
  • Build integrations with appropriate error handling, alerting, and reconciliation checks to ensure broken or partial data feeds are identified promptly.
  • Automate recurring manual processes across finance and operations, including scheduled extracts, reconciliation support, and supplier billing, using auditable and reproducible processes.
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues at source, including entity matching across customer, accounting, and CRM records, and implement controls to prevent recurring issues.
  • Contribute to the design and development of the central data warehouse, including staging layer design, entity matching, incremental loading, and history handling.
  • Work with finance and operations stakeholders to develop reports and dashboards based on the central data layer.
