  • Ensure solutions are documented, monitored, supportable, and maintained using disciplined development and source-control practices.
  • Follow the established delivery process, including planning, scope definition, pre-sales authorization, peer review, documentation, and go-live activities.

Qualifications

Essential Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting API integrations between business systems in a production environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of REST, OAuth2, and webhooks.
  • Experience with two-way synchronization, including understanding of write conflicts, retries, idempotency, and reconciliation.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Graph, Entra APIs, or comparable vendor APIs.
  • Ability to work with real-world production constraints, including permission limitations, rate limits, restricted schema access, and inconsistent API behaviour.
  • Strong SQL skills, including queries, joins, views, and stored procedures.
  • Experience with Power Query, including ETL, data transformation, and M language.
  • Experience automating recurring processes end-to-end, including scheduling, monitoring, and failure handling.
  • Practical experience using AI coding tools within a reviewed workflow, with the ability to verify and validate AI-generated output.
  • Experience building and delivering reports and dashboards for business users using Power BI or a comparable reporting tool.
  • Ability to translate reporting requirements from non-technical stakeholders into working and documented outputs.
  • Understanding of how the underlying data model affects reporting capabilities and limitations.
  • Strong focus on accuracy, reconciliation, and traceability of data back to its source.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to finance professionals and business concepts to technical colleagues.
  • Self-starter who can work independently with direction from the Finance Director.
  • Ability to gather requirements directly from business stakeholders and work effectively with colleagues who may have limited data-related knowledge.
  • Willingness to identify and communicate when a solution cannot be implemented safely.
  • Strong documentation and working practices, including maintaining work in shared workspaces and source control.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, particularly in orchestrating AI services over a data platform and understanding how models and APIs are selected and governed.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and pipelines, with an understanding of capacity and licensing costs.
  • Experience delivering a data warehouse or lakehouse, including staging layer design, dimensional modelling, incremental loading, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Working knowledge of data governance concepts such as sensitivity labelling, Microsoft Purview, access control, and data classification.
  • Experience integrating accounting platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, or NetSuite with reporting tools or downstream systems.
  • Experience with PSA/MSP platforms such as Halo PSA, ConnectWise, Autotask, or Datto.
  • Exposure to IT Glue, Liongard, or Scalepad.
  • Advanced Power BI skills, including DAX, semantic models, star schema design, and Power BI Service administration.
  • Experience in an MSP, professional services, or project-based business where billable utilization and project margin are important.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
Join the leader in collaborative licensing and help us advance inclusive and efficient new patent licensing approaches to drive innovation globally. Via is dedicated to accelerating global technology adoption, fostering participation, and generating return on innovation with balanced IP licensing solutions for innovators and manufacturers of all sizes around the globe.

Via is an independently managed company owned by industry-leading participants with over 25 years of intellectual property licensing leadership. Our expertise extends to intellectual property, technology standardization, strategic business development, and program administration. Affiliated specialists in the fields of finance, antitrust law, and patent analysis complete the set of capabilities that make Via a premier solutions provider to the world’s most sophisticated technology and entertainment companies.

About the NextGen Program:

NextGen is Via LA’s multi-phase enterprise modernization program focused on transforming legacy licensing, royalty-management, financial, and operational processes into a modular, cloud-native platform. The program is designed to improve automation, scalability, maintainability, data integrity, business-rule transparency, end-to-end traceability, and operational controls while reducing dependency on tightly coupled legacy applications. The platform supports complex, rules-driven processes across patent licensing, royalty reporting and processing, financial calculations, tax, audit and compliance, document management, notifications, reporting, and related operational workflows. The target architecture leverages reusable business capabilities, workflow orchestration, APIs, event-driven integrations, configurable business rules, and modern cloud services.

Position Summary:

The Senior Business Systems Analyst (BSA) will play a critical role in the analysis, design, delivery, validation, and implementation of Via LA’s NextGen platform while continuing to support related legacy applications during the transformation. The BSA will translate complex business needs into clear, testable, and traceable requirements and serve as a key liaison across business, Product Owners, developers, QA, and operational teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

This role requires strong business-analysis discipline and sufficient technical depth to collaborate effectively on microservices, workflows, APIs, data models, integration contracts, cloud services, and system dependencies. The BSA is not expected to develop application code but must understand technical designs, identify gaps and downstream impacts, and ensure implemented solutions align with approved business requirements. This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of three days per week in the Greenwood Village office. We are looking for a collaborative professional who is eager to learn, contribute, and grow while helping the team achieve its goals.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Analysis, Requirements & Scope Management

  • Lead requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and refinement for complex enterprise capabilities.

  • Develop and maintain BRDs, FRDs, use cases, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, decision tables, process flows, and functional specifications.

  • Translate complex licensing, royalty, accounting, tax, compliance, and operational processes into implementable system requirements

  • Facilitate workshops with Product Owners, business stakeholders, SMEs, architects, developers, QA engineers, and implementation partners.

  • Perform current-state, future-state, and gap analysis across legacy applications, manual processes, data flows, and target-state capabilities.

  • Identify and document assumptions, dependencies, constraints, risks, unresolved decisions, and cross-system impacts.

  • Establish requirements baselines and identify material changes requiring additional analysis, approval, or scope review.

  • Ensure requirements are complete, testable, traceable, and sufficiently detailed before development and testing begin.

  • Support internal go-to-market and adoption strategies for AI-powered workflows, agentic experiences, and internal products that simplify employee work across enterprise platforms.

Business Process, Capability & Data Modeling

  • Model end-to-end business processes, workflows, system interactions, decision points, exception paths, manual controls, and service boundaries.

  • Use Enterprise Architect, Miro, Visio, or similar tools to maintain domain models, capability maps, swimlane diagrams, data-flow diagrams, system interaction diagrams, and data dictionaries.

  • Decompose large business processes into reusable capabilities and clearly defined functional responsibilities.

  • Document business data definitions, field-level requirements, reference data, mappings, ownership, validation rules, and data-quality expectations.

  • Maintain alignment across business-process models, requirements, solution designs, Jira stories, test cases, and Confluence documentation.

Functional & Solution Design

  • Collaborate with solution architects, developers, Product Owners, and SMEs to translate business requirements into practical and supportable solution designs.

  • Evaluate solution options based on business value, usability, scalability, security, compliance, integration, data, cost, and operational-support considerations.

  • Define functional behaviors for role-based access, approvals, alerts, escalations, audit history, document versioning, metadata, reporting, and exception management.

  • Develop decision tables, scenario matrices, and rule catalogs that make business logic explicit, reusable, testable, and auditable.

  • Define reconciliation and traceability requirements so system outputs can be tied to authoritative source data and approved business rules.

Workflow, Integration & System Analysis

  • Define workflows involving human tasks, approvals, automated processing, notifications, and completion criteria.

  • Support BPMN-based workflow design and orchestration platforms such as Camunda.

  • Translate business processes into integration requirements for APIs, events, services, legacy applications, middleware, and third-party platforms.

  • Document source and target systems, triggers, request/response behavior, payload structures, field mappings, validation rules, error handling, retry behavior, and reconciliation requirements.

  • Work with architects and developers to ensure API and event contracts accurately support approved business requirements.

  • Understand and document integration payload without responsibility for developing API endpoints or application code.

Data, Reporting & Analytics

  • Define data requirements, business definitions, mappings, ownership, quality expectations, retention needs, and reconciliation controls.

  • Partner with technical teams on source-to-target mappings, data pipelines, integration dependencies, and monitoring.

  • Support data profiling, cleansing, conversion planning, migration validation, reconciliation, and post-conversion verification.

  • Develop reports, dashboards, and analytics using Qlik Sense, Power BI, or similar visualization tools to support operational and leadership decision-making.

  • Help ensure secure, reliable, and traceable data movement across enterprise systems.

Agile / Scrum Delivery & Backlog Management

  • Actively participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and lead or facilitate these sessions as needed.

  • Partner with Product Owners to maintain a prioritized, well-defined, and implementation-ready backlog.

  • Ensure Jira stories contain sufficient business context, requirements, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and traceability before entering development.

  • Support MVP definition, capability sequencing, dependency management, milestone planning, and release planning.

  • Identify requirement gaps, conflicting expectations, dependencies, and scope risks early to reduce downstream development and testing defects.

Testing, Validation & Release Readiness

  • Partner with QA engineers and business stakeholders to define test scenarios, business test cases, expected results, test-data requirements, and exception scenarios.

  • Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, reconciliation, parallel validation, and other business-validation activities.

  • Track defects, decisions, retesting, acceptance evidence, and unresolved risks through release readiness.

  • Support production-readiness reviews, deployment validation, post-implementation verification, and transition to application support.

Audit, Controls & Governance

  • Document business processes and system behavior in support of SOX, internal controls, security, compliance, and audit requirements.

  • Support development and maintenance of process narratives, control flows, system/data-flow documentation, and audit evidence.

  • Ensure documentation accurately identifies relevant systems, services, databases, jobs, interfaces, data movement, controls, and monitoring processes.

  • Support internal and external audit walkthroughs with complete, current, and traceable documentation.

Documentation, Communication & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Produce high-quality analysis and project artifacts and facilitate business validation and UAT activities.

  • Maintain accurate documentation in Jira, Confluence, Enterprise Architect, and other approved repositories.

  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to resolve ambiguity, facilitate decisions, and reduce delivery risk.

  • Collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams, including Global Licensing, Finance, Royalty Services, Accounting, Tax, Legal/Compliance, Patent Operations, IT Infrastructure, Information Security, and internal and external audit teams.

  • Support knowledge transfer, operational handoff, and ongoing documentation of implemented system behavior.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field;

  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Senior Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role supporting complex enterprise applications.

  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise modernization, platform transformation, microservices, or legacy-system replacement initiatives.

  • Strong experience developing business and functional requirements for complex workflows, business rules, calculations, data, and integrations.

  • Demonstrated experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

  • Experience collaborating directly with Product Owners, architects, developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders.

  • Experience supporting SIT, UAT, defect management, release readiness, and production validation.

  • Experience documenting enterprise integrations, APIs, data mappings, data pipelines, or event-driven interfaces.

  • Experience maintaining requirements and test traceability throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong foundational understanding of Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) concepts and data pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Enterprise Architect, or comparable modeling tools such as Miro and Visio.

  • Strong business-process modeling, requirements-analysis, and functional-specification skills.

  • Ability to document complex business rules, calculation logic, decision tables, and exception scenarios.

  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON/XML payloads, integration patterns, and event-driven architectures.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native and microservices-based architectures; Microsoft Azure experience is desirable.

  • Familiarity with BPMN and workflow-orchestration platforms such as Camunda.

  • Familiarity with enterprise ERP and CRM platforms, including SAP Finance and Salesforce(Sales/Service/Experience Cloud)

  • Experience documenting interface and integration specifications for middleware platforms such as Informatica, SAP BTP Integration Suite, or similar apps.

  • Experience in automation tools such as Tosca, Selenium or UiPath.

  • Relevant certifications such as PMP, Scrum, CBAP, PMI-PBA, or related business-analysis/product-management credentials.

description:

The role serves as a technical lead and project manager, partners cross-functionally, and supports high-quality programming outputs for regulatory submissions, publications, and other clinical communications.

Essential Functions of the Job:

• Technically lead and project manage multiple studies, managing all aspects of study deliverables related to statistical and clinical programming, as needed.

• Represent the Statistical Programming team at Study Management Team and Clinical Development meetings to address deliverables and timelines.

• Assess resourcing needs and support adequate staffing of projects.

• Assist in reviewing key study-related documents produced by other functions, including statistical analysis plans, case report forms, data management plans, database specifications, EDC data structures, DMC plans, and other clinical documents.

• Interact and communicate with Statisticians, Data Managers, Clinical Operations, Medical Monitors, Medical Writing, and other partners to address programming-related study deliverables.

• Write, test, and validate SAS programs to produce analysis datasets, tables, listings, graphs, and presentation outputs for regulatory submissions, publications, and other communications, as needed.

• Understand and execute department-, product-, and study-level macros and utilities; write, test, and validate product- and study-level macros and utilities.

• Serve as a technical resource for the programming group and provide advice on complex programming tasks and standards.

• Contribute to the development and review of Statistical Programming policies, standard operating procedures, and other controlled documents.

• Interface with outsourcing partners and vendors.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Individual contributor role. No direct people-management responsibility is specified. Provides technical leadership and project management for multiple studies, including resource planning and coordination with centralized teams, outsourcing partners, and vendors.

Computer Skills:

• Expert-level SAS programming with experience delivering complex programming assignments and analyses.

• Knowledge of SDTM and ADaM standards, including writing CDISC-standard dataset specifications and creating SDTM and ADaM datasets from specifications.

• Ability to develop, test, and validate analysis datasets, tables, listings, graphs, macros, utilities, and presentation outputs.

Other Qualifications:

• Minimum 5+ years of clinical research and development programming experience using SAS.

• Expert-level knowledge and extensive hands-on experience with CDISC methodologies.

• Experience leading or working with centralized Statistical Programming teams.

• Experience in oncology trials.

• Experience with FDA, EMEA, and CFDA clinical trial and regulatory submissions.

• Experience with the drug development process in preclinical, early, late-stage, and/or observational settings in related industries or academic research.

• Knowledge of the drug development process and fundamentals of project planning and management.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a dynamic environment.

• Licenses or certifications: N/A.

Education Required:

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Summary:

In this role, you will develop advanced data science and AI/ML solutions that address critical healthcare business, operational, and client questions. You will work with complex clinical, financial, operational, claims, and electronic medical record data to build scalable analytical capabilities that improve clinical, operational, and economic outcomes. You will apply statistical methods, machine learning, natural language processing, and large language models while partnering across product, technology, clinical, engineering, and business teams to translate complex problems into production-ready solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop advanced data science, machine learning, and AI solutions using complex healthcare clinical, operational, financial, claims, and electronic medical record data.
  • Conduct exploratory and predictive analyses across large, disparate data sources to identify patterns, generate hypotheses, evaluate performance, and uncover opportunities for improvement.
  • Apply statistical modeling, machine learning, natural language processing, and large language model techniques to solve complex healthcare and business problems.
  • Design, develop, evaluate, and refine LLM-enabled workflows, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt optimization, model evaluation, and techniques that improve the accuracy and reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Develop AI/ML workflows that support production applications, analytics products, and data platforms through model orchestration, API integration, data processing, deployment, and optimization.
  • Translate raw clinical, financial, operational, and client data into standardized, enriched, and analytically useful data assets that support healthcare analytics and product capabilities.
  • Integrate LLMs and machine learning models with APIs, data pipelines, enterprise applications, and other technology platforms to move solutions from experimentation into production.
  • Partner with product, engineering, technology, clinical, and business clients to translate requirements into appropriate statistical, machine learning, and AI approaches.
  • Evaluate data quality, model performance, and analytical outputs and troubleshoot issues across data, AI/ML workflows, and production solutions.
  • Communicate analytical approaches, findings, limitations, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences and contribute best practices across data science, experimentation, AI/ML, and analytical solution development.

Qualifications:

  • Relevant degree preferred.
  • 5 or more years of relevant experience required.
  • Proficiency in Python required; experience with R, SAS, or other analytical programming languages preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience applying statistical methods, machine learning, and predictive modeling to complex business or healthcare problems.
  • Experience developing or applying large language models, natural language processing, or generative AI solutions, including techniques such as RAG, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, or prompt optimization.
  • Experience developing AI/ML solutions that integrate with APIs, data pipelines, enterprise applications, analytics products, or data platforms.
  • Experience developing, deploying, or orchestrating AI/ML solutions within cloud-based environments such as AWS, Azure, Palantir Foundry, or comparable platforms strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with large, complex, and disparate datasets and translate data into scalable analytical solutions.
  • Experience communicating complex analytical concepts and findings to technical, business, and executive audiences and collaborating across engineering, product, technology, clinical, and business teams.
  • Experience with healthcare data, healthcare operations, finance, revenue cycle, clinical workflows, or hospital performance analytics strongly preferred, including exposure to claims, electronic medical record, financial, billing, or operational data and platforms such as Epic Clarity/Caboodle, Cerner CCL-Discern/PowerInsight, or Palantir Foundry.

Rare Disease: Myasthenia Gravis, Huntington's, ALS, DMD, CIDP, DM1 (myotonic dystrophy) and FSHD - CAR-T experience

  • Drives Risk Identification and Issue Resolution at project level (RBQM/RESOLVE).

  • Ensures project team compliance with organization policies, SOPs, ICH- GCP, regulatory and project specific requirements.

Education

  • Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 8+ years’).

In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

  • Effective oral and written communication and presentation skills

  • Proactive, solutions oriented and adaptable to changing priorities and situations

title: Part Time Bourbon Educator - Evan Williams Bourbon Experience
description:
This is a part time onsite role at the Evan Williams Bourbon Experience in Louisville, KY. Open availability preferred, including weekends.

Standard Operating Hours: Monday - Thursday 10:30a-5:30p, Friday & Saturday 9:30a-5:30p, Sunday 12:30p-5:30p

What the Role Is

The Bourbon Educator is responsible for escorting individuals or groups on sightseeing tours at the Evan Williams Bourbon Experience. This position is specifically responsible for hosting our guided walking tours and tastings while providing information about our products, heritage and industry.

How You Will Spend Your Time?

  • Divulge information that keeps the guests focused on the topic of interest while highlighting the visual artifacts and other offerings.
  • Describe tour points of interest to group members, and respond to questions
  • Escort individuals or groups on sightseeing tours, or through places of interest such as public buildings, visitor centers, etc.

  • Monitor visitors’ activities to ensure compliance with establishment or tour regulations and safety practices
  • Provide directions and other pertinent information to visitors
  • Greet and register visitors, and issue any required identification badges or safety devices

  • Working in our retail store and light janitorial duties
  • All other duties as required

Who You Are…

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • Minimum 1 year work-related skill, knowledge, or customer service experience
  • Must be a minimum of 21 years old
  • Knowledge of principles and processes for providing customer and personal services. This includes customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction

  • Excellent oral communication skills with the ability to talk to others to convey information effectively

Valued but not Required Skills and Experience:

title: Non-Destructive Testing Tool Inspector, Level II
description:
Role Overview

The NDI Technician - FPI Level II independently sets up, performs, interprets, evaluates, and documents fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI/PT) on aerospace hardware in accordance with approved procedures, applicable specifications, and Beehive Industries' NDT written practice. The Level II serves as a technical resource for FPI execution, provides guidance and supervision to trainees and Level I personnel, and supports consistent, compliant special-process performance in accordance with NAS 410.


What You’ll Do...

  • Set up, standardize, and independently perform fluorescent penetrant inspection (FPI/PT) in accordance with approved procedures, work instructions, drawings, and applicable customer or industry requirements.
  • Interpret and evaluate FPI indications against applicable acceptance criteria, make acceptance or rejection determinations within assigned certification authority, and accurately document results.
  • Perform and verify required equipment standardizations, system performance checks, process controls, and material checks; identify, contain, and escalate nonconforming process conditions.
  • Review applicable codes, standards, specifications, drawings, purchase-order requirements, and contractual documents that control FPI activities performed by Beehive.
  • Provide technical guidance, direct observation, and/or supervision to trainees and Level I personnel as permitted by Beehive's written practice.
  • When authorized by Beehive's written practice, develop detailed work instructions from approved general procedures for final technical approval by a certified Level III.
  • Ensure inspection records, traceability, process logs, and nonconformance documentation are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
  • Support root-cause investigations, corrective actions, process improvements, and cross-functional resolution of inspection or manufacturing issues without exceeding assigned NDI authority.
  • Support internal, customer, regulatory, and special-process audits, including demonstration of FPI process controls and personnel compliance.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of Quality and manufacturing operations.


You have...

Education

  • High school diploma or GED required; technical or trade-school education in nondestructive testing, inspection, manufacturing, engineering technology, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Must meet the formal training, examination, and vision requirements for Penetrant Testing Level II under NAS 410 Revision 6 and Beehive Industries' approved NDT written practice.

Experience

  • For PT/FPI Level II qualification with prior Level I certification, NAS 410 Revision 6 specifies a minimum of 16 additional hours of formal PT training and 270 hours of applicable experience. Direct
  • access to Level II requires a minimum of 32 hours of formal PT training and 400 hours of applicable experience.
  • Documented prior training, experience, and certification are subject to review and approval by Beehive's Responsible Level III or Examiner in accordance with the written practice.
  • Demonstrated experience performing and evaluating FPI on aerospace or other high-reliability hardware.

Skills & Competencies

  • Thorough working knowledge of FPI/PT principles, techniques, process limitations, materials, equipment, system performance checks, and common manufacturing discontinuities.
  • Ability to independently interpret and evaluate indications and apply acceptance criteria from approved technical documents within the scope of certification.
  • Working knowledge of relevant aerospace manufacturing and inspection technologies and their relationship to penetrant inspection results.
  • Ability to provide clear technical guidance and effective oversight to trainees and Level I personnel.
  • Strong technical documentation, problem-solving, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to maintain applicable near-vision and color-perception requirements and ongoing qualification/recertification status in accordance with Beehive's written practice.
  • The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.

Nice to have...

  • Current or previous employer certification to NAS 410 or EN 4179 as PT/FPI Level II.
  • Experience inspecting aerospace castings, forgings, weldments, machined components, or additively manufactured hardware.
  • Experience in an AS9100 and/or Nadcap-accredited special-process environment, including audit support and process-control documentation.
  • Additional NDI certifications or documented training in other methods such as magnetic particle, radiography, ultrasonic, or eddy current testing.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to work for extended periods in a manufacturing and inspection environment, including standing, walking, bending, reaching, and using inspection equipment and hand tools.
  • Ability to safely handle parts and materials consistent with site lifting requirements, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Regular use of required PPE and work around approved penetrant-process chemicals and UV-A inspection equipment; must follow applicable EHS controls and safety procedures.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts and overtime as business needs require; limited travel may be required for training or support at other Beehive locations


If this sounds like you, please submit an application with your resume. This could be the opportunity you are looking for to expand your skills, contribute to a winning team, and work with talented people who love what they do and take pride in our mission.

title: Clinical Team Supervisor
description:
The following statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities required of personnel so classified.

Position Summary:

The Clinical Team Supervisor coordinates and supervises a team of clinical staff to ensures staff provide appropriate mental health services (including assessment, group therapy, group rehab, targeted case management, individual and family therapy services) to the community at-large. The Supervisor will coordinate cases internally or with the Department of Mental Health and/or other funding sources/agencies, to ensure timely access to care is delivered based on the identified level of care. **A $5,000 stipend is provided, in addition to the base salary, to support the on-call portion of this role.

Program Information:

The Housing Supportive Services Program (HSSP) is a specialized program that provides comprehensive and intensive field-based community mental health services designed to meet the unique needs of individuals. HSSP services are provided as part of an integrated model in which the Los Angeles County (LAC or County) Department of Mental Health (Department or DMH), Department of Health Services (DHS), and Department of Public Health (DPH) partner to respectively provide mental health services, intensive case management services (ICMS) and substance use services, as appropriate, to clients who are in or have been matched to PSH. The integration of services provided to clients is expected to decrease incarcerations, homelessness, hospitalizations, and frequent visits to psychiatric emergency rooms.

Core Duties And Responsibilities:

  • Provide administrative and clinical oversight to assigned staff via regular supervision. Document staff performance and growth objectives.
  • Ensure that staff client service hour expectations are met to ensure access to care capacity to serve community needs.
  • Facilitate Meetings to ensure staff are given accurate, timely information.
  • Train and coach staff to ensure adherence to Enki policies and procedures, documentation standards, and EBP certification requirements.
  • Ensures staff adheres to Enki and Los Angeles County- DMH policies and procedures.
  • Provide consultation to staff on clinical issues, including diagnosis review, level of care, referral to MCP, charting, mandated reporting, and risk assessments (DTS/DTO).
  • Available to respond to clinic crises or client complaints. Provide client care as needed, including intake assessments and ongoing treatment.
  • Assist in organizing, directing and supporting inter-agency relationships, assuring treatment in program(s) reflects the input of the multi-disciplinary team, while matching the program’s Statement of Work.
  • Assist in interviewing, hiring and onboarding staff for clinical positions. Train and orient new hires to Enki’s mission and documentation standards.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with other community agencies, schools, programs and the Department of Mental Health by attending program specific meetings and/or trainings.
  • Inform Clinic Manager of significant administrative, clinical and/or personnel issues.
  • Coordinate with Clinic Manager to develop program(s) that meet the needs of target population.
  • Provide clinical supervision to unlicensed clinicians accruing SPE for licensure.
  • If applicable, obtain LPS designation to provide LPS assessments as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Education And Experience Preferred:

  • One (1) year administrative experience supervising a multidisciplinary team in a clinical setting.
  • Knowledge of the Los Angeles County Department of Mental Health policies and procedures.
  • Two (2) years experience working with Chronically Mentally Ill population.

Licenses/Certifications Preferred:

  • Licensed or license eligible MFT, LCSW, LPCC, Ph.D. or Psy.D. with clinical experience (i.e. providing individual, group and family treatment) under supervision and registered with the State Board.
  • Valid California driver’s license, current automobile insurance, and eligibility to drive for the Company preferred.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities:

  • Ability to perform in a positive, courteous, flexible and adaptive manner.
  • Able to exercise independent judgement and initiative.
  • Computer literate and experienced with computer programs such as Microsoft Office Word, Outlook and Excel.
  • Experience using an Electronic Medical Health Record databases is a plus.
  • Must be able to communicate clearly, both orally and written.
  • Possesses excellent organizational skills and must be able to prioritize and complete multiple tasks.

Physical Requirements:

  • Finger, handle, feel, and reach with hands and arms, including ability to use a computer keyboard.

  • Stamina to effectively perform work activities.

Team Jeni’s Team Leaders are part-time crew members who lead shifts. In addition to leading shifts, they scoop and serve ice cream to our customers, make waffle products, run the register with cash management responsibilities, keep the shop clean, change out buckets of ice cream, and perform a number of other important, related tasks.

As a Team Leader, you will:

  • Serve the ice cream Time magazine calls “the best in America”

  • Gain valuable real-world business and entrepreneurship experience

  • Work in an environment oriented around serving each other and making people’s day

  • Lead shifts and act as a role model for other team members

  • Have opportunities for growth within a growing company

  • Receive competitive compensation

Qualities of Team Leaders:

  • Exhibit passion for community, an eye for detail, a willingness to clean (a lot), stamina (to serve people in long lines), and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • The ability to positively influence and lead a shift of ambassadors, helping them uphold the highest standards and feel supported

  • Resourceful and calm when challenges come up

  • Have great judgment, common sense, and be skillful interpersonally

  • Familiar with (and be able to articulate to customers) what distinguishes Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams from other ice creams, and be able to articulate that to the 500th customer with the same care and presence as the 1st customer

  • Available to work weekends, late nights (past 11 p.m.)

  • Provide consistent, world-class service to every single customer

  • Reliable, on time, and ready to hustle for every shift

  • Committed to the well-being of their shop team, their community, and the environment around them

About Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams:

Founded by Jeni Britton in 2002, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams is a B Corp headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with scoop shops in over twenty cities across the country, making it possible for members of Team Jeni’s who are interested in developing their careers, or transitioning to a new city, to have meaningful opportunities to learn, grow, and explore.

Our Team Leaders make a difference in their shop, their community, and in how they partner with their team and serve their customers. If this opportunity sounds delicious to you, please apply.

Jeni's is an equal opportunity employer. Said our way, we love and honor differences, and we love sharing common values such as talent, hustle, guts, resilience, and empathy. Our differences are a primary source of our team's strength and we crave having a team rich with diversity which is creativity and art in its human form.

title: Grant Writer
description:
GRANT WRITER

About Us

Arts for Learning Maryland (formerly Young Audiences of Maryland) is devoted to enriching the lives and education of Maryland’s youth through educational and culturally diverse arts programs. Through Arts for Learning, professional teaching artists from all disciplines partner with educators, schools, and school districts to provide -- on average -- over 560,000 hours of learning in, through, and about the arts to more than 150,000 Maryland students annually.

Arts for Learning is a mission-driven organization that values community, innovation, and passion. The staff, board, and teaching artists have a shared commitment to advance equity in the field of education by working tirelessly to generate opportunities for students to imagine, create, and realize their full potential through the arts.

Position Overview

The Grant Writer plays a key role on the Development Team and is responsible for crafting compelling, well-organized proposals that inspire institutional funders to support Arts for Learning’s mission. This role collaborates closely with staff across the organization to gather information, develop strong cases for support, and ensure accurate and timely submission of proposals and reports. The Grant Writer will also cultivate relationships with funders, gaining insight into their priorities and aligning proposals accordingly. This is a full time, exempt position and reports to the Development Director and may occasionally collaborate with external grant consultants.

Key Responsibilities

Grant Writing & Reporting

  • Write, edit, compile, and submit high-quality proposals, LOIs, and reports for foundation, corporate, and government funders.

  • Ensure all submissions meet funder requirements, reflect organizational priorities, and align with funder interests.

  • Collaborate with staff across departments (Program Teams, Education, Finance, Communications, CEO’s Office) to gather necessary budget, data and narrative elements.

  • Track deadlines and ensure timely submission of all assigned deliverables.

Funder Engagement

  • Support relationship-building with institutional funders by coordinating calls, meetings, and site visits.

  • Participate in funder conversations when appropriate.

  • Follow up on declined proposals to gain insight and strengthen future submissions.

  • Track progress toward institutional fundraising goals and share updates with the Development Director.

Prospect Research

  • Research potential new foundation, corporate, and government funding opportunities.

  • Collaborate with the Development Director and Chief of Engagement to identify strong prospects and recommend targets for outreach.

Data & Grants Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date grant records and files in the organizational database.

  • Support the Development Director in maintaining the grants calendar, ensuring accurate timelines for all institutional giving activities.

  • Work with the Development Coordinator to ensure consistent documentation and proper tracking of grant activity.

Department & Organization Participation

  • Participate in weekly department meetings, supervisor check-ins, and external fundraising events as needed (some evenings may be required).

  • Participate in organization-wide meetings, retreats, trainings, and other all-staff activities.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, Nonprofit Management, Arts Administration, Education, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.

  • Proven ability to write compelling, well-structured content for diverse audiences.

  • Experience collaborating across departments to gather information and support organizational processes.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Google Docs/Sheets; familiarity with fundraising databases such as Salesforce, Bloomerang, or similar systems is a plus.

Skills & Attributes

  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling abilities.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent reliability in meeting deadlines.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, timelines, and information sources simultaneously.

  • Strong interpersonal communication skills and the ability to “manage up” and collaborate across teams.

  • Commitment to equity, inclusion, and Community-Centric Fundraising principles; willingness to examine and improve traditional philanthropic practices.

  • Adaptive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to respond professionally to unexpected challenges.

  • Receptive to feedback, committed to continuous learning, and proactive in identifying opportunities for process improvement.

Compensation:

We offer a starting annual salary of $59,300 and an attractive benefits package which includes medical, dental, and vision health care coverage, retirement contributions, and flexible time off.

To Apply

For consideration, please apply on our website at . Please do not send applications that include headshots or photos of yourself. No phone calls or recruiters, please. All employees will be subject to a federal and state background check in accordance with state and federal law.

Arts for Learning Maryland is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to cultivating a diverse workforce and equitable workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, veteran status, and disability. All qualified applications will be given equal opportunity.

Position Summary

The Senior Project Scheduler develops, maintains, and analyzes complex project schedules in support of aerospace, defense, and manufacturing programs. This role ensures schedule accuracy and alignment across engineering, supply chain, production, and quality teams while operating within regulatory and contractual requirements. The position supports integrated master scheduling, baseline control, risk identification, and performance tracking across multiple medium complexity programs.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and status detailed project schedules across engineering, production, testing, and supply chain workflows.

  • Monitor schedule performance, analyze variances, and update timelines based on actual progress, delays, or changes in priorities.
  • Perform schedule risk analysis, identify critical path drivers, and recommend mitigation strategies to program leadership.
  • Prepare recurring schedule reports, dashboards, Gantt charts, and performance metrics for internal leadership and external customers.
  • Support baseline planning, change control processes, and configuration management per aerospace and defense program requirements.
  • Communicate scheduling impacts related to longlead materials, manufacturing constraints, supplier delays, and testing dependencies.
  • Partner with project managers to ensure schedules align with contractual milestones, manufacturing readiness, and customer deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling practices, templates, and tools.

Requirements

  • Experience developing schedules for electronic subsystem and system development from the ground up.
  • Proficiency with MS Project scheduling tool.
  • Understanding of aerospace and defense program requirements including EVMS, WBS structures, and configuration control.
  • Knowledge of engineering change processes, production flows, and supply chain dependencies common to manufacturing environments.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, milestone driven environment supporting multiple programs.

Skills

  • Preferred: Experience with DCMA audits, Integrated Master Plan/Integrated Master Schedule (IMP/IMS) development, or DoD program requirements. Experience with SSI Tools.
  • Preferred certifications: PMISP, PMP, or similar.

Experience

  • 5-7years of scheduling experience in aerospace, defense, or complex manufacturing environment.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, Industrial Technology, or related field; equivalent experience considered.


About:

This position requires compliance with Comtech’s Drug-Free Workplace Program. Candidates must successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening as a condition of hire. Employees may be subject to random, reasonable suspicion, and post-incident testing. Illegal drug use — including marijuana, regardless of state law — is disqualifying under federal adjudicative guidelines and DoD DFARS requirements.

The pay range reflects the expected base salary for this position. Final compensation will be based on role, level, skills, experience, and geographic location.

The ideal candidate will provide expertise in Authority to Operate (ATO), the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), security controls, cloud security, and governance, risk, and compliance (GRC). The Cybersecurity Engineer will support RMF activities across the full ATO lifecycle, develop and maintain security documentation and artifacts, assess system risks and vulnerabilities, and coordinate with system administrators, developers, system owners, ISSOs, and other stakeholders to address security requirements and authorization gaps.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

  • Support RMF Steps 1–7, including security categorization, control implementation, assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring.
  • Lead and coordinate security and privacy activities within project teams, including development and maintenance of required RMF security artifacts.
  • Develop and maintain security documentation, including Incident Response, Contingency Planning, Disaster Recovery, POA&M, and other authorization documentation.
  • Analyze authorization packages and security artifacts to identify gaps, establish remediation plans, and coordinate resolution with system stakeholders.
  • Conduct security risk assessments, impact analyses, gap assessments, compensating control evaluations, and residual risk assessments.
  • Assess IT products, operating systems, and security configurations for compliance with NIST SP 800-53 and applicable security policies.
  • Develop and implement security controls and support remediation of identified vulnerabilities and compliance findings.
  • Support security configuration and compliance activities for infrastructure, operating system images, and IT product deployments.
  • Prepare and present security reports, briefings, risk assessments, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with system administrators, developers, system owners, ISSOs, and internal/external customers to assess the security impact of hardware, software, and configuration changes.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Assurance, Information Security, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of information security experience, including at least 3 years of cybersecurity and cloud security experience supporting a large government agency.
  • Strong experience supporting NIST RMF, ATO, security authorization, and continuous monitoring activities.
  • Experience developing RMF security artifacts, implementing security controls, and managing POA&Ms.
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, security compliance, GRC, and federal cybersecurity policies and practices.
  • Experience conducting security assessments, risk analyses, gap assessments, impact assessments, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Experience with cloud security and FedRAMP, including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and shared security responsibilities.
  • Experience with security assessment and vulnerability tools such as Tenable Nessus, Nmap, SCAP, and Wireshark.

  • Knowledge of network security, software development, systems engineering, cloud architecture, and infrastructure security.
  • Strong documentation, analytical, presentation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to translate technical cybersecurity requirements into actionable recommendations.

Additional Qualifications:

This position assists the Village’s Community Services Administrator in developing, coordinating and administering various grant programs for the Village of Oak Park. Receives general direction from the Community Services Administrator.

title: Team Leader
description:
In ATL, our Team Jeni's Team Leaders have the opportunity to earn an average of $19.51 per hour!*

*This is an estimate of hourly earnings. It is based on the 2026 base pay rate, plus 2025's hourly tip average. 2026 actual customer tips may vary.

In Georgia, if the average hourly earnings of a Team Leader are less than $16 per hour in a two-week pay period, Jeni's will add the difference to the person’s paycheck so that their average hourly earnings reach $16 per hour for that pay period.

Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams is searching for part-time Team Leaders to join our WSPD team.

At Jeni’s, we’re devoted to making better ice creams and bringing people together. Our scoop shops are at the heart of how we serve this mission. They are where we offer the ice creams we work so hard to build from the ground up—where people come together to share joy and conversation. We love people. We love ice cream. We view ice cream as a form of art.

Team Jeni’s Team Leaders are part-time crew members who lead shifts. In addition to leading shifts, they scoop and serve ice cream to our customers, make waffle products, run the register with cash management responsibilities, keep the shop clean, change out buckets of ice cream, and perform a number of other important, related tasks.

As a Team Leader, you will:

  • Serve the ice cream Time magazine calls “the best in America”

  • Gain valuable real-world business and entrepreneurship experience

  • Work in an environment oriented around serving each other and making people’s day

  • Lead shifts and act as a role model for other team members

  • Have opportunities for growth within a growing company

  • Receive competitive compensation

Qualities of Team Leaders:

  • Exhibit passion for community, an eye for detail, a willingness to clean (a lot), stamina (to serve people in long lines), and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • The ability to positively influence and lead a shift of ambassadors, helping them uphold the highest standards and feel supported

  • Resourceful and calm when challenges come up

  • Have great judgment, common sense, and be skillful interpersonally

  • Familiar with (and be able to articulate to customers) what distinguishes Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams from other ice creams, and be able to articulate that to the 500th customer with the same care and presence as the 1st customer

  • Available to work weekends, late nights (past 11 p.m.)

  • Provide consistent, world-class service to every single customer

  • Reliable, on time, and ready to hustle for every shift

  • Committed to the well-being of their shop team, their community, and the environment around them

About Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams:

Founded by Jeni Britton in 2002, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams is a B Corp headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with scoop shops in over twenty cities across the country, making it possible for members of Team Jeni’s who are interested in developing their careers, or transitioning to a new city, to have meaningful opportunities to learn, grow, and explore.

Our Team Leaders make a difference in their shop, their community, and in how they partner with their team and serve their customers. If this opportunity sounds delicious to you, please apply.

Jeni's is an equal opportunity employer. Said our way, we love and honor differences, and we love sharing common values such as talent, hustle, guts, resilience, and empathy. Our differences are a primary source of our team's strength and we crave having a team rich with diversity which is creativity and art in its human form.

FACT office, as well as in the community where most contacts occur. Exposure to extreme heat and humidity during the summer months.

Computer Literate

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Job Title: Senior Product Designer

Job Location: San Diego, CA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:


Company Description

About AbbVie

At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.


Job Description

About the Role

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape the software experience that connects millions of consumers and providers to the Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. This includes Allē, our core loyalty program spanning brands like BOTOX® Cosmetic, The JUVÉDERM® Collection of Fillers, and SkinMedica®, with over 8 million members.

You’ll report to the Product Design Manager on the Allergan Aesthetics Tech team and join a close-knit group of senior and lead designers who genuinely love great craft, push each other to do their best work, and care about building products our users love.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end design across products in the Allergan Aesthetics software portfolio, including Allē, from early concept to shipped feature.
  • Support your Product Manager in product discovery, helping shape what gets built, and uphold consistency and UX standards.
  • Design for both consumers and the providers who treat them, keeping both perspectives in mind as you work.
  • Prototype ideas using AI-assisted tools like Claude Code to share bring concepts to life.
  • Craft detailed, production-ready blueprints in Figma that engineers can build from with confidence.
  • Work with engineers to ensure feasibility of designs, craft high-quality handoff artifacts, and participate in the visual QA process to ensure quality implementation.
  • Contribute to our design system with scalable components and patterns.
  • Work with our user research and strategy team to run usability testing and incorporate key learnings.
  • Take part in design reviews with stakeholders across marketing, medical, legal, regulatory, and compliance, helping translate complex constraints into clear design decisions.

Qualifications

  • You have 7+ years of UX/UI design experience and a portfolio that shows strong craft in SaaS platforms or consumer mobile apps at scale.
  • You’re highly skilled in Figma, including auto-layout, components, variables, and prototyping, and you’ve dabbled in AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code to bring ideas to life.
  • You are skilled in mobile-first responsive web design, iOS/Material Design patterns, accessibility, and design systems.
  • You’re a strong communicator who can bring people along, whether that’s a quick working session or a conversation with senior leaders.
  • You’ve helped take an idea from 0 to 1, and you’re comfortable being the one to bring clarity and a compelling vision to something new.
  • You’re quick to get context in an unfamiliar space, synthesize what matters, and figure out where to focus first.
  • You have empathy for how our consumers and aesthetic providers behave and feel, and you actively participate in user research.
  • You take feedback well and give it just as thoughtfully.

Additional Information

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

  • The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of thisposting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location,and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​

  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​

  • This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs. ​

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission,incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless anduntil paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

title: Country Partnerships & Technical Assistance Lead
description:
Overall Purpose of the Job

The Country Partnerships & Technical Assistance Lead serves as mothers2mothers' primary representative and country focal point in Technical Assistance countries under the EKN HIV Instrument programme.

The role is responsible for coordinating country-level project implementation, provide technical assistance to partners to strengthen project quality, managing strategic partnerships, supporting government engagement, facilitating technical assistance, strengthening local organisational capacity and supporting localisation objectives. Working closely with government stakeholders, local civil society organisations, community-led networks and regional programme partners, the role ensures effective implementation of project activities and contributes to sustainable, community-led and rights-based HIV responses.

The position plays a critical role in building and maintaining relationships with government, civil society, community stakeholders and development partners while identifying opportunities that strengthen m2m's long-term positioning, sustainability and future growth within the country. Locations: Angola, Eswatini, South Africa, and Zimbabwe.

Key Performance Areas

Country Project Leadership and Coordination

Purpose

Provide country-level leadership and coordination of projecte activities to ensure effective implementation of the EKN HIV Instrument.

Key Accountabilities

  • Serve as the primary m2m representative and focal point within the country.
  • Coordinate implementation of country workplans and project priorities.
  • Ensure alignment between country activities and regional programme objectives.
  • Facilitate country-level planning, implementation and review processes.
  • Monitor progress against agreed deliverables, milestones and commitments.
  • Coordinate inception activities, project start-up and implementation readiness.
  • Facilitate effective communication between country stakeholders and regional programme teams.
  • Support adaptive management and implementation improvements.

Government Engagement, Systems Strengthening and Policy Support

Purpose

Strengthen collaboration with government stakeholders and support implementation of national HIV priorities and health system strengthening initiatives.

Key Accountabilities

  • Build and maintain productive working relationships with relevant government ministries, departments and agencies.
  • Participate in technical working groups and relevant national coordination platforms and stakeholder forums.
  • Support implementation of integrated HIV, SRHR, GBV and MHPSS approaches.
  • Facilitate government engagement in project planning, implementation and learning activities.
  • Support institutionalisation of programme approaches within existing systems.
  • Promote alignment between project activities and national priorities.
  • Support implementation of recommendations arising from technical reviews and assessments.
  • Facilitate collaboration between community actors and public systems.
  • Identify opportunities for strategic collaborations that enhance program impact, visibility, and sustainability

Partnerships, Localisation and Capacity Strengthening

Purpose

Strengthen local organisations, partnerships and community-led responses to promote sustainable programme impact.

Key Accountabilities

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local CSOs, CBOs and community-led organisations.
  • Support implementation of localisation and power-shifting commitments.
  • Facilitate sub-partner onboarding, engagement and coordination processes.
  • Support organisational capacity strengthening initiatives for local partners.
  • Promote meaningful participation of AGYW--led organisations in programme activities.
  • Facilitate peer learning and knowledge sharing among local partners.
  • Strengthen local ownership and sustainability of programme approaches.
  • Support implementation of partner development plans and capacity assessments.

Technical Assistance, Quality Improvement and Learning

Purpose

Coordinate technical assistance and support quality implementation across programme interventions.

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead the design, delivery and monitoring of technical assistance initiatives provided to subgrantees
  • Facilitate knowledge transfer and capacity-strengthening interventions in relevant programmatic areas.
  • Ensure technical assistance activities are aligned with national priorities, donor requirements, project priorities and organizational standards.
  • Facilitate technical support visits, mentoring and coaching activities.
  • Support quality improvement activities and implementation of technical recommendations.
  • Monitor application of technical standards and programme guidance.
  • Promote continuous learning and evidence-informed programme improvement.
  • Facilitate documentation and sharing of programme lessons and good practices.
  • Track technical assistance outcomes, lessons learned and impact
  • Coordinate grantee reporting requirements and performance reviews
  • Support implementation of operational research and learning initiatives .

Stakeholder Engagement, Community Participation and External Representation

Purpose

Ensure meaningful engagement of programme stakeholders and strengthen community participation in programme implementation and accountability processes.

Key Accountabilities

  • Support establishment and effective functioning of Country Advisory Committees.
  • Facilitate meaningful participation of AGYW and community representatives.
  • Support community-led monitoring and accountability processes.
  • Represent m2m in stakeholder meetings and external forums as delegated.
  • Strengthen relationships with civil society, development partners and community leaders.
  • Facilitate stakeholder consultations learning activities.
  • Support implementation of advocacy and community engagement initiatives.
  • Promote visibility of project successes, lessons and community priorities.

Programme Performance, Monitoring, Risk Management and Opportunity Development

Purpose

Support programme accountability, performance improvement and long-term sustainability through monitoring, risk management and strategic positioning.

Key Accountabilities

  • Monitor implementation progress, programme performance and partner commitments.
  • Prepare programme reports and performance updates.
  • Support program reviews and evaluation activities.
  • Proactively identify implementation challenges, risks and emerging issues.
  • Support development and implementation of risk mitigation strategies.
  • Escalate significant risks and issues to programme leadership.
  • Monitor the external environment and identify emerging opportunities, risks and trends.
  • Identify potential partnership and funding opportunities that may support future programme growth and sustainability.
  • Provide country intelligence and stakeholder insights to support resource mobilisation and strategic planning processes.

Key Deliverables

  • Effective country-level coordination and project implementation.
  • Strong government and stakeholder relationships.
  • Effective local partner engagement and capacity strengthening.
  • Successful implementation of technical assistance activities.
  • Strong localisation and community participation outcomes.
  • Timely and accurate programme reporting.
  • Effective management of programme risks and operational challenges.
  • Strengthened positioning of m2m within the country.
  • Identification of opportunities that support future sustainability and growth.

Accountability

Owns

  • Country-level programme coordination.
  • Local partner engagement and support.
  • Government liaison and technical working group participation.
  • Technical assistance coordination and delivery.
  • Country Advisory Committee participation and support.
  • Localisation and capacity strengthening activities.
  • Stakeholder engagement and external representation.
  • Country-level risk identification and escalation.
  • Opportunity identification and stakeholder intelligence.
  • Country programme budgets

Does Not Own

  • Direct service delivery implementation.
  • Country programme budgets.
  • Regional programme strategy.
  • Donor stewardship and donor relationship management.
  • Resource mobilisation strategy.
  • Executive government engagement.
  • Programme Management Office functions.
  • Regional performance management.
  • Partnership governance structures.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Public Health, International Development, Health Systems, Social Sciences, Public Policy, Project Management or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional qualification in HIV/AIDS, Health Systems Strengthening, Community Development, Policy or Social Development.
  • Training in capacity strengthening, systems strengthening or organisational development advantageous.

Experience

Required

  • Minimum 8-10 years' progressively responsible experience in public health, HIV, health systems strengthening, development programmes or related sectors.
  • Experience managing or coordinating complex donor-funded programmes.
  • Experience working with government ministries, civil society organisations and community structures.
  • Experience providing technical assistance, supporting capacity strengthening and organisational development or capacity strengthening initiatives.
  • Experience working with AGYW, SRHR, HIV or community health programmes.
  • Experience facilitating multi-stakeholder collaboration and partnership management.
  • Experience in programme planning, implementation, monitoring and reporting
  • Experience in one of the EKN focus countries.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting policy implementation or systems strengthening initiatives.
  • Experience working within regional or multi-country programmes.
  • Experience working in localisation and community-led development settings.

Core Competencies

Technical Competencies

  • Project Leadership and Coordination
  • Partnership Management
  • Government Relations
  • Capacity Strengthening
  • Health Systems Strengthening
  • HIV and Community Health Programming
  • Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning
  • Risk Management
  • Localisation and Sustainability
  • Stakeholder Engagement

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Relationship Building
  • Influencing Without Authority
  • Partnership Development
  • Problem Solving and Decision Making
  • Negotiation and Diplomacy
  • Communication and Facilitation
  • Political and Contextual Awareness

Personal Competencies

  • Results Orientation
  • Accountability
  • Adaptability
  • Initiative
  • Integrity
  • Resilience
  • Learning Agility
  • Cultural Sensitivity

Key Working Relationships

Internal

  • Project Director
  • Senior Project Director
  • Senior Partnership Governance & Engagement Lead
  • Senior Project & Coordination Manager
  • Strategic Information Team
  • Advocacy Team
  • HR Lead
  • Grants & Compliance Team
  • Finance Team

External

  • HIV Instrument partner organisations
  • Ministries of Health and relevant government bodies
  • National AIDS Councils
  • Technical Working Groups
  • Local CSOs and CBOs
  • Community-led organisations and networks
  • Country Advisory Committees
  • Health system stakeholders
  • Development partners and implementing organisations

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
  • Comprehensive benefits (health, retirement, leave)
  • Opportunities for growth, leadership, and professional development

title: Quality Technician Lead
description:
Reports To: DC Supervisor or Designee

Location: Phoenix, AZ

Job Summary

The Quality Technician Lead assures the Quality team is focused on the quality management of caster products. Colson USA considers quality fundamental to the work that is undertaken by all personnel.

The Quality Technician Lead ensures the successful day to day operation of the local Quality team in support of the Director of Quality, USA, whose directives include production quality validation and product support.

Essential Job Functions

· Responsible for supporting the work of the Quality Assurance group in their designated daily responsibilities by; supporting the optimization of receiving inspection, developing the team quality assurance capability, develop concession solutions for assurance of customer service and assuring SIP and SOP directive is followed.

· Supports the preparation of accurate PPAP, FMEA, PFMEA reports.

· Act as the primary contact for Distribution Center operations quality issues as needed.

· Assists the management representative on all matters relating to the quality management system.

· Assists the Management Representative during audits of the Facility.

· Create, update and manage Risk, Opportunity and Continuous Improvement Matrix DC Operations Annually.

· QMS Processes: Assists in the continuous improvements and maintenance of the QMS Processes, assuring compliance to applicable standards. Under the direction of the Director of Quality, USA assists in maintaining SOPs, Develops & generates relevant metrics and trending driving performance improvements, where needed.

· Responsible for overseeing and monitoring effectiveness of the following systems: Complaint management activities, including investigation, Quality Incidence (non-conformance), CAPA 8D, Deviation, Batch record review and product release, Calibration and maintenance of equipment, Document control and record retention.

· Auditor: Responsible for assisting in auditing activities, including internal audits

· Problem Solving: Actively participates in product or process troubleshooting by providing feedback and offering solutions that meet both business and compliance needs.

· Assists in implementation and compliance of Colson Group quality procedures at the DC operation.

· Develop and implement additional local quality procedures required as necessary.

· Developing resolutions to cross-functional issues

· Assists and supports conducting ISO Management Review two times per year.

· Performs other related duties as assigned.

· Adheres to all Colson Group policies and procedures

Knowledge

  • Associate or Bachelor’s Degree in a related field preferred
  • High School Diploma required
  • Minimum of 2 year’s experience in a Quality role in manufacturing or distribution center

Experience

· Demonstrated ability to professionally communicate in a clear and concise manner both one-on-one and in a group setting.

· Demonstrated ability to function in a multi-task environment.

  • Experience using an ERP system such as Epicor desirable.

Skills

· Personal computer skills and experience using Microsoft Office applications.

· Ability to facilitate improvements and positive changes.

· Ability to organize and prioritize tasks to meet personal and organizational goals.

  • Report and Procedure writing proficient (PPAP’s, Corrective Action Reports etc.)
