title: Mortgage Loan Pipeline Processor
description:
OUR LEADERSHIP PHILOSOPHY

At Lighthouse Credit Union, we believe all individuals, regardless of position level, are considered leaders. By providing a framework that balances clarity with adaptability, our Leadership Competencies aim to foster a culture of continuous growth and agile leadership. Lighthouse Credit Union is committed to embracing change, nurturing leadership talent, and ensuring our performance management practices are aligned with our vision of fostering a resilient and forward-thinking organization. As such, we all hold ourselves accountable to the following:

LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES
Demonstrates Interpersonal Awareness & Skills
A cornerstone of our collaborative work environment, this competency emphasizes effective communication, relationship building and teamwork. It also supports creating a positive work environment that values individual contributions and fosters teamwork. As an individual leader, you will demonstrate active listening, clear communication, and contribute beneficially to team dynamics.
Embraces Change & Learning
This competency focuses on adaptability, personal development and the advocacy and embracing of progressive change. You will be challenged to explore continuous learning opportunities to achieve excellence and foster a culture of growth and innovation. As an individual leader, you will actively engage in personal development, embrace change enthusiastically and support team members in their growth. You will also demonstrate flexibility and adaptability in response to changing
circumstances.
Utilizes Critical & Creative Thinking
Underlining the importance of innovative problem solving, challenging the status quo and strategic thinking, this competency is vital for driving excellence and leadership. This competency challenges team members to take initiative beyond one’s immediate responsibilities. As an individual leader, you will actively look for and share opportunities for improvement, show open-mindedness to new ideas and professionally challenge inefficient processes. You will also actively contribute to defining solutions and promoting innovation.
Takes Personal Ownership
This competency focuses on taking responsibility for performance goals, proactive collaboration, and accountability. It highlights the significance of each team member taking ownership of their role and contributions while demonstrating leadership qualities regardless of their position. As an individual leader, you will be actively engaged in setting and achieving performance goals, take responsibility for personal action and decisions and seek opportunities for self-improvement and skill development.

POSITION SUMMARY
Under the direction of the Director, Residential Lending Operations, the Mortgage Loan Pipeline Processor plays a crucial role in managing the mortgage loan application process from initial submission through closing. This role involves coordinating with mortgage loan originators, underwriters, and clients to ensure a smooth and efficient pipeline, maintaining accurate documentation, and adhering to credit union and regulatory requirements to ensure a smooth and efficient loan processing experience.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Manages and processes Mortgage Loan applications ensuring timely progression through the processing pipeline while meeting service, quality and member experience standards, and identifying opportunities to improve workflow efficiency, reduce processing bottlenecks, and enhance member experience.
• Monitors and manages assigned loan pipelines to ensure timely movement through processing milestones, achievement of closing deadlines, and adherence to service, quality, and compliance standards.
• Performs detailed reviews of loan applications, supporting documentation, collateral information, and system data to verify accuracy, completeness, and compliance with Credit Union policies and regulatory requirements.
• Collects applicable fees and coordinate the ordering, tracking, review, and receipt of third-party services, including appraisals, title examinations, flood certifications, tax verifications, and other collateral-related reports.
• Orders, tracks, and evaluates appraisal reports to ensure property valuations meet lending requirements and regulatory standards; identify discrepancies, valuation concerns, or missing information and coordinates resolution with vendors and underwriters as needed.
• Ensures appraisal reports and associated valuation disclosures are delivered to borrowers within required regulatory timeframes.
• Reviews title reports to verify ownership, confirm lien position, identify title defects, judgments, encumbrances, easements, or other matters impacting the Credit Union’s collateral interest, and facilitate resolution of outstanding issues.
• Reviews and evaluates loan conditions and borrower documentation submitted by applicants or Loan Originators for completeness and accuracy, ensuring supporting conditions meet Secondary Market requirements.
• Obtains verification of employment for all borrowers. Serves as the primary point of contact between the members/borrowers, real estate agents, title companies, third-party brokers and internal sales staff providing exceptional member service, communicating loan status updates, obtaining required documentation, resolving processing issues and guiding members through closing requirements.
• Investigates and resolves processing exceptions, documentation deficiencies, title issues, appraisal discrepancies, collateral concerns, and other loan-related matters that may impact regulatory compliance, approval conditions, closing timelines, funding requirements or secondary market salability, serving as a resource for complex or escalated processing issues and determining appropriate courses of action to facilitate resolution.
• Performs points and fee loan reviews to ensure compliance with Ability-to-Repay/Qualified Mortgage rules.
• Coordinates and facilitates loan closings by working with borrowers, lending officers, branch staff, title companies, attorneys, appraisers, and other third parties; schedule closings, prepare and review closing packages, and ensures all underwriting conditions, stipulations, and approval requirements are satisfied prior to funding.
• Prepares and delivers Closing Disclosures in accordance with TRID requirements, processes and distributes closing documents, ensuring accurate loan, collateral, payment, escrow and regulatory data.
• Maintains working knowledge of applicable federal and state lending regulations, Credit Union policies, and compliance requirements to ensure accurate and compliant loan processing, serving as a subject matter resource for mortgage processing procedures, loan documentation requirements, and regulatory expectations.
• Meets established productivity, quality, accuracy, and member service standards while safeguarding confidential member information and adhering to all Credit Union policies, procedures, and professional conduct expectations.
• Identifies opportunities to improve workflows, enhance operational efficiency, reduce processing bottlenecks, and strengthen the member experience. Participates in process improvement initiatives, system enhancements, and departmental projects as assigned.
• Supports a broad range of mortgage operations functions, including the preparation and distribution of weekly pipeline reporting for leadership. Maintains and publishes daily mortgage rate information, ensuring timely communication to internal stakeholders. Performs pre-closing quality control reviews of peer loan files to validate accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, identifying trends, recommending corrective actions, and supporting continuous improvement efforts.
• Follows and adheres to the Credit Union’s policy regarding attendance and punctuality.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS
• Understanding of mortgage lending regulations, compliance standards, and loan products.
• Familiarity with the mortgage application and closing processes.
• Must meet and comply with all requirements set forth in the SAFE ACT including but not limited to successful completion of the required background checks and obtaining a Unique Identifier for NMLS.
• Strong organizational and time management abilities.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• A significant level of trust and diplomacy is required, in addition to normal courtesy and tact.

EDUCATION, TRAINING & EXPERIENCE
• High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, or related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• 2+ years of mortgage processing, mortgage operations, residential lending, consumer lending, or related financial services experience required. Experience with conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and home equity lending preferred.
• Proficiency using mortgage loan origination systems (LOS), document imaging platforms, workflow management tools, and Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Teams.

WORK ARRANGEMENT
The working arrangement for this position is hybrid. Hybrid work is an opportunity to find the right balance between working in the
office and remotely, especially if it supports individual success and the needs of our organization. Hybrid schedules are determined
by the hiring manager based on business unit needs and may vary by department.

title: Outreach Worker
description:
Job Summary:
Under the supervision of the Outreach Program Manager, the Outreach Worker will be responsible for connecting with youth on the streets to build healthy and strong relationships with these youth in hopes of helping them on their path to self-sufficiency. The Outreach Worker acts as a liaison to inform youth, the community, and businesses about the services offered by Urban Peak to promote the health, safety, and well-being of homeless and runaway youth and to assist them in permanently exiting the street life. Other duties include coverage of program shifts at the Mothership, outreach on the streets and to Denver area shelters, intensive and basic needs case management, and facilitation of activities. This position will ensure that interactions, interventions and environments at Urban Peak are trauma informed and emphasize the physical and emotional safety of youth and staff.

Large encampments in Denver are becoming more commonplace and present a set of unique challenges. Some of the other duties of this position, in collaboration with other outreach workers from partner agencies, that include case managers, outreach workers, a peer support specialist and street nurses, will also serve as the service providers dedicated to engaging marginalized individuals in these complex environments. Services provided will include but are not limited to: crises intervention; supplying of basic needs (socks, food, cold weather gear, etc.); facilitation of increased access to the Urban Peak shelter, micro communities, medical respite, medical and behavioral health care and COVID-related health care and shelter; transportation; client advocacy; and general service linkage. This position will also build relationships and collaborate with Denver Police, Denver Department of Public Health and Environment, Parks and Recreation, and other city entities as needed to best engage and serve those living in large encampments.

The Urban Peak Outreach Worker will specialize in connecting with youth under the age of 25 and will work to connect with the youth as Case Managers for longer term case management and support. This position will ensure that interactions and interventions are trauma informed and emphasize the physical and emotional safety of youth and staff.
staff.

Who You Are:
  • A master’s degree in social work, psychology, or child development AND a minimum of two (2) years’ treatment-oriented or case management experience; OR a bachelor’s degree in behavioral science, human services, or related fields AND three (3) years’ experience working with children/youth; OR 5 years’ full-time (FT) experience with homeless or runaway youth.
  • Experience in providing trauma informed care or willingness to adapt this approach is required.
  • Experience, competence, sensitivity and ability to connect well and work effectively with the homeless youth community, especially youth who identify as LGBTQ, or are often difficult to engage, mentally ill, addicted to substances or otherwise impaired.
  • Skill in oral and written communications.
  • Skill in negotiating and mediating, particularly in sensitive situations as well as some skill in crisis intervention and de-escalation.
  • Able to communicate effectively with a diverse population.
  • Able to make independent judgement and sound decisions using available information while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
  • Able to function as a member of a multi-disciplinary team and work with collaborating agencies Lived experience reflective of the youth we serve encouraged but not required.
  • Must be computer proficient and possess experience of Microsoft Office Suite (e.g. Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel).
  • Understanding of the provision of and commitment to trauma-informed care and positive youth development.
  • Must be insurable as a driver on Urban Peak’s auto liability policy in order to conduct business on behalf of the agency or transport youth using an Urban Peak vehicle and/or an approved personal vehicle.
  • Must be QMAP-certified or eligible for QMAP certification.
  • Ability to use second language in written and verbal communication is desired but not a requirement (most common languages in the Denver Metro area).
  • Must pass both federal and state background checks.
  • Must pass pre-employment physical.
  • Must pass pre-employment tuberculosis (TB) screening.
  • Ability to provide proof of education (HS Diploma OR Official Transcripts).

What You Will Do:
The duties of this position are performed personally, in cooperation with your supervisor, and/or in coordination with other staff. Additional work functions and duties may be assigned.

All Outreach Worker positions will be responsible for performing the general work duties listed:
  • Actively represent Urban Peak in the community to persons interested in the issue of homelessness for education, funding, and advocacy purposes.
  • Works collaboratively with shelters to identify homeless persons living in the shelter that need assistance accessing services and housing.
  • Attends all required staff meetings and client reviews, being prepared to address client issues.
  • Assists in conducting yearly Point In Time survey.
  • Attends professional trainings as required.
  • Accompanies youth on group outings (e.g., DMV, movies, and other recreational activities).
  • Educates and trains volunteers in all aspects of working with youth who are homeless or at high risk of homelessness.
  • Actively engage youth on the streets, in the Mothership, and other Urban Peak programming.
  • Accountable to all defined outcomes, both individually and team level.
  • Track and maintain supplies for the Outreach team, as well as place orders, arrange for pick-up, and communicate clear standards of proper use and storage of items used in the Mothership.
  • Outreach.
  • Focuses on a limited number of large encampments and non-congregate shelters prioritized by City. In the least intrusive manner possible, collects aggregate de-identified data on the population and service needs of identified camps. Documents and reports back to supervisors in a timely fashion to inform them of client dispositions, camp trends, and additional services needed.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain programming to deliver resources and knowledge to youth on the streets as well as to build community with youth on the streets.
  • Seek out and build trusting and healthy relationships with youth who are not yet accessing other services at Urban Peak.
  • Attend Human Trafficking events and represent Urban Peak in Human Trafficking efforts within the community.
  • Work to provide street youth resources through street outreach using a trauma-informed approach.
  • Case Management and Referrals.
  • Collaborates with homeless service providers in the community and Urban Peak programs to provide optimum coordination, communication and continuity of services.
  • Assists youth into permanent housing and/or family reunification and provide referrals for supportive services to help maintain stability.
  • Accepts referrals from other agencies and works collaboratively with staff of all agencies to provide contact and to support additional goals.
  • Implements individual assessments and develops case plans with participating youth to identify needs and provide appropriate resources and services.
  • Work to provide street youth resources through street outreach using a trauma-informed approach.
Milieu Supervision:
  • Develops relationships with homeless/runaway youth to encourage and assist them in moving from the streets into housing or appropriate reunification with parents/legal guardians, or networks of support.
  • Provide milieu supervision through a trauma informed approach, working to ensure the physical and emotional safety of the youth and their environment.
  • Provide youth direction and referrals and cultivate relationships that could eventually move to case management.
  • Work with youth to maintain cleanliness of the environment.
Documentation:
  • Accurately document all services including assessments, case notes, service plans, and specific services received by client into HMIS.
  • Collect and maintain accurate data on an ongoing basis.
  • Document relevant and significant events that occur during the shift in the Communication Log.
  • Maintain clear and effective communication with other staff regarding clients.
  • Work to ensure client confidentiality.
Intakes and Assessment:
  • Complete thorough intakes in a manner that begins to establish comfort and trusting relationships.
  • Assess the level of need and intent of youth and make recommendations regarding youth’s involvement in other Urban Peak programs.

What We Offer:
  • Salary: $ 24.26 / Hour
  • Shift Schedule: Monday through Friday 8AM to 4PM.
  • 100% Employer paid Medical and Dental plans - Buy-up plans available.
  • Vision Plan.
  • Flexible Spending Plan – Health & Dependent Care.
  • Accident Coverage | Critical Care & Hospitalization Ancillary Plan.
  • Employer paid Basic Life and AD&D.
  • Employee Voluntary Life Insurance.
  • Employer paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability.
  • Colorado Paid Famli Leave Private Plan – Employee / Employer Split @ 50%.
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan with 2% Agency Match.
  • Employer paid RTD Eco Pass.
  • 10 Paid Holidays.
  • 48 hours Paid Sick Time .
  • 120 hours of Vacation to start on an accrual basis.
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program.
  • Second Language pay differential upon successfully passing language exam.
  • Staff support for lateral growth through training and mentorship.

Who We Are:
Founded in 1988, Urban Peak is the only non-profit organization in Denver that provides a full convergence of services for youth ages 12 through 24 experiencing homelessness or at imminent risk of becoming homeless. Our goal is to meet youth where they are and to provide them with the assistance and support, they need to become self-sufficient or obtain the necessary services they need to exit a life on the streets.

Urban Peak provides numerous programs and services that are founded on the principles of trauma-informed care and Positive Youth Development to assist youth in reaching their potential and living a successful life off the streets. Services include street outreach, a 136-bed shelter for youth ages 12 through 24, daytime drop-in services, supportive housing, education and employment services, case management, life skills courses, behavioral health evaluations, meals and more. The youth served at the shelter come from a variety of backgrounds, and we strive to be a safe community for all youth, regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, class, educational background, sexual orientation, gender identity, or ability status.

Urban Peak embraces diversity and considers all qualified candidates that have an interest in the non-profit sector. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, HIV/AIDS status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. We encourage all candidates to apply.

title: Patient Accounts Representative Lead
description:
The Patient Accounts Representative Lead is a full-time position responsible for assisting the Patient Accounts Supervisor with leading the daily operations. The individual is responsible for managing denials, payments, and accounts receivable (A/R) activity. This role ensures accurate billing, collections, and reconciliation processes while managing denial and appeal activities. The individual is also responsible for auditing financial transactions, identifying overpayments and underpayments, and ensuring compliance with third-party reimbursement guidelines, medical necessity, and coding standards. Additionally, this position provides training, develops workflow improvements, and communicates trends and inconsistencies to key stakeholders.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead and oversee payment posting, denial management, and A/R activities to optimize efficiency and accuracy.
  • Coach and coordinate the daily operations of the payment posting and denials team to optimize efficiency, accuracy and timely posting
  • Monitor and resolve discrepancies, patterns impacting outstanding balances, and payment activity.
  • Audit financial transactions, identify and address overpayments, underpayments, and necessary refunds.
  • Research and analyze payer reimbursement guidelines, coding requirements, filing limits, and billing regulations impacting payment and A/R processes.
  • Develop and implement training materials and workflow enhancements for the billing staff.
  • Recommend updates to claims processes and practice management systems to improve efficiency.
  • Review third-party communications and identify potential policy and reimbursement risks; escalate concerns to clinical stakeholders, contract coordinators, and Revenue Cycle leadership.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for billing, payment posting, denials and A/R processes.
  • Assist with specialized billing and follow-up workflows, including but not limited to:
    • Dental Billing
    • OB Global Billing
    • Out-of-Office Services
    • Vision Care
    • Behavioral Health
    • Specialty Services

Qualifications:

Skills:

  • Ability to work independently and results-driven.
  • Self-starter with a willingness to implement new ideas.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Adaptability to frequent changes in duties and workload.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to collaborate with medical staff to improve clinical and financial outcomes.

Knowledge:

  • Healthcare reimbursement processes, third-party payer procedures, and collection techniques.
  • Federal, commercial, and state medical reimbursement regulations.
  • Medical terminology and coding compliance.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in medical insurance, healthcare billing, and collections within a health system.

Other Elements:

Judgment & Initiative:

  • Ability to assess and resolve issues, correct errors, and develop processes to improve efficiency.
  • Strong initiative with the capability to work independently.

Independent Action:

  • Ability to prioritize and manage daily, weekly, monthly, and annual tasks with minimal supervision.

Accountability:

  • Ability to meet deadlines and ensure accuracy in financial reporting and audits.

Interrelationships:

  • Effective communication with internal and external stakeholders impacting medical billing and patient revenue.
  • Collaboration with immediate staff and other managers to resolve problems efficiently.

title: Ambassador
description:

Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams is searching for Ambassadors to join our Sparkman Wharf team.

At Jeni’s, we’re devoted to making better ice creams and bringing people together. Our scoop shops are at the heart of how we serve this mission. They are where we offer the ice creams we work so hard to build from the ground up—where people come together to share joy and conversation. We love people. We love ice cream. We view ice cream as a form of art.

Team Jeni’s Ambassadors are our part-time, front-line crew members. They scoop and serve ice cream to our customers, make waffle products, run the register, keep the shop clean, change out buckets of ice cream, and perform a number of other important, related tasks.

As an Ambassador, you will:

  • Serve the ice cream Time magazine calls “the best in America”

  • Gain valuable real-world business and entrepreneurship experience

  • Work in an environment oriented around serving each other and making people’s day

  • Have opportunities for growth within a growing company

  • Receive competitive compensation

Qualities of an Ice Cream Ambassador (also known as a scoop shop employee):

  • Exhibit passion for community, an eye for detail, a willingness to clean (a lot), stamina (to serve people in long lines), and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Familiar with (and be able to articulate to customers) what distinguishes Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams from other ice creams, and be able to articulate that to the 500th customer with the same care and presence as the 1st customer

  • Available to work weekends, late nights (past 11 p.m.)

  • Provide consistent, world-class service to every single customer

  • Reliable, on time, and ready to hustle for every shift

  • Committed to the well-being of their shop team, their community, and the environment around them

About Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams:

Founded by Jeni Britton in 2002, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams is a B Corp headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with scoop shops in over twenty cities across the country, making it possible for members of Team Jeni’s who are interested in developing their careers, or transitioning to a new city, to have meaningful opportunities to learn, grow, and explore.

Our Ambassadors make a difference in their shop, their community, and in how they partner with their team and serve their customers. If this opportunity sounds delicious to you, please apply.

Jeni's is an equal opportunity employer. Said our way, we love and honor differences, and we love sharing common values such as talent, hustle, guts, resilience, and empathy. Our differences are a primary source of our team's strength and we crave having a team rich with diversity which is creativity and art in its human form.

title: Senior Platform Engineer (API & Gateway - Data & AI Platform)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to design and build the API and Gateway layer that unifies our Data & AI Platform, transforming a fragmented service landscape into one coherent, secure, and observable product.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build APIs and SDKs on top of distributed platform services using Python/FastAPI
  • Define REST/async API design standards, versioning strategies, and contract testing practices
  • Develop client libraries that provide consistent, reliable access to platform services
  • Architect and maintain a gateway layer that fronts platform services and removes direct fragmented access
  • Establish orchestration and routing patterns that converge independent services into one cohesive product
  • Implement RBAC/ABAC least-privilege authorization models at the gateway level
  • Manage identity and token flows, including managed/workload identity and delegation, to keep downstream services simple
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions with a test-first delivery approach
  • Produce clear service contracts and documentation to support platform adoption
  • Integrate services across Azure and GCP, leveraging private endpoints for secure service-to-service communication
  • Implement observability practices using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana to ensure end-to-end visibility
  • Use metrics, traces, and logs to debug and tune performance in production environments

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in platform or software engineering, with expert-level proficiency in Python
  • Hands-on experience building APIs and SDKs on top of distributed services, including client libraries
  • Proficiency in FastAPI, REST/async design, API versioning, and contract testing
  • Expertise in designing gateway architectures, including orchestration, API integration, and consistent routing
  • Knowledge of IAM concepts including RBAC/ABAC least-privilege models, managed/workload identity, and token delegation flows
  • Hands-on experience with Azure and GCP, including private endpoints and multi-cloud service-to-service integration
  • Skills in CI/CD and automation using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Familiarity with observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana
  • Ability to translate a fragmented service landscape into one coherent, unified product
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher

title: Ambassador
description:
In ATL, our Team Jeni's Ambassadors have the opportunity to earn an average of $18.51 per hour!*

Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams is searching for Ambassadors to join our WSPD team.

At Jeni’s, we’re devoted to making better ice creams and bringing people together. Our scoop shops are at the heart of how we serve this mission. They are where we offer the ice creams we work so hard to build from the ground up—where people come together to share joy and conversation. We love people. We love ice cream. We view ice cream as a form of art.

Team Jeni’s Ambassadors are our part-time, front-line crew members. They scoop and serve ice cream to our customers, make waffle products, run the register, keep the shop clean, change out buckets of ice cream, and perform a number of other important, related tasks.

As an Ambassador, you will:

  • Serve the ice cream Time magazine calls “the best in America”

  • Gain valuable real-world business and entrepreneurship experience

  • Work in an environment oriented around serving each other and making people’s day

  • Have opportunities for growth within a growing company

  • Receive competitive compensation

Qualities of an Ice Cream Ambassador (also known as a scoop shop employee):

  • Exhibit passion for community, an eye for detail, a willingness to clean (a lot), stamina (to serve people in long lines), and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Familiar with (and be able to articulate to customers) what distinguishes Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams from other ice creams, and be able to articulate that to the 500th customer with the same care and presence as the 1st customer

  • Available to work weekends, late nights (past 11 p.m.)

  • Provide consistent, world-class service to every single customer

About Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams:

Founded by Jeni Britton in 2002, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams is a B Corp headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with scoop shops in over twenty cities across the country, making it possible for members of Team Jeni’s who are interested in developing their careers, or transitioning to a new city, to have meaningful opportunities to learn, grow, and explore.

Our Ambassadors make a difference in their shop, their community, and in how they partner with their team and serve their customers. If this opportunity sounds delicious to you, please apply.

Jeni's is an equal opportunity employer. Said our way, we love and honor differences, and we love sharing common values such as talent, hustle, guts, resilience, and empathy. Our differences are a primary source of our team's strength and we crave having a team rich with diversity which is creativity and art in its human form.

title: Frontend Developer – Ads Platform
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.

Viaplay is accelerating our growth on Advertising & Monetisation with sharper focus to bring measurable, attractive, modern advertising formats to the Nordic market cross all our platforms. Right now, we’re searching for a Frontend Developer (Smart TV) in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?

The Role

We are looking for a frontend developer to help build and evolve our ads & monetisation experience across mobile video and streaming products, focusing on our TV application. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the user experience while also solving complex technical challenges around playback, performance, reliability, and advertising delivery. You will work in a cross-functional product team, collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across engineering, product, design, data, and commercial teams to deliver high-quality ad experiences.

What your day might look like

  • Design, build, and maintain features on our platform, related to ads monetisation in a modern mobile app

  • Work with tracking and measurement of ads, and ad decisioning integrations

  • Contribute smooth, reliable ad experiences across live, linear, and on-demand streaming use cases

  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams on integrations involving client-side and server-side ad insertion workflows

  • Improve app performance, stability, observability, and user experience around ad playback

  • Participate in technical discovery, architecture discussions, code reviews, testing, and release activities

  • Help troubleshoot complex production issues related to playback, ads, analytics, and device-specific behaviour

What we’re looking for

We are looking for a passionate and experienced developer with a genuine interest in frontend development. If you have experience working with TV applications, we would be blown away.

You thrive in a high energy, team-driven environment where you love getting stuff done, and having fun while you are doing it.

Successful candidates also meet all or some of the following:

  • Experience developing customer-focused web-based services, using HTML/JavaScript

  • Experience working with a state-less and highly transactional end user product.

  • Good understanding of architecture, performance optimisation, testing, debugging, and maintainable code design

  • Experience working with video playback, streaming, media apps, or complex mobile user journeys

  • Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical trade-offs clearly

  • A pragmatic engineering mindset with attention to reliability, quality, and user experience

It’s a bonus if you have:

  • Experience with advertising technology in media streaming, such as SSAI, CSAI, VAST, VMAP, ad SDKs, ad tracking, or measurement

  • Experience from AVOD, FAST, live streaming, OTT, or other ad-supported video products

  • Experience working with commercial, ad operations, or monetisation stakeholders

  • You value collaboration, inclusive communication, and continuous improvement

Why join us

You will have the opportunity to work in a business-critical area where you directly contribute to product quality, viewer experience, and sustainable revenue growth. You will join a team where technical excellence, experimentation, and collaboration are valued, and where your work can have a visible impact on scale.

What we offer you

  • We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.

  • Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.

  • Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.

  • A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.

  • An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.

  • Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.

Hit play today

If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.

Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Virtualization Systems Engineer

  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, writing, and handling documents.
  • Clear vision and hearing required for meetings, presentations, and communication.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time, which may include extended periods of standing, walking, or navigating airports and government facilities.
  • Ability to sit or stand for long periods of time
  • Ability to withstand abnormal environmental conditions

title: Hearing & Vision Technician 1
description:
About Us

The Charter County of Wayne

The Charter County of Wayne is Michigan's largest county. We are home to 34 cities and nine townships. From Rockwood to Livonia, from Sumpter Township to the Grosse Pointes, each community in Wayne County offers residents and businesses a unique blend of opportunity to live, work, play and raise families. Job Summary

Hearing and Vision Technicians 1 provide preschool and school-age hearing and vision screening in Michigan according to the Public Health Code; Act 368 of 1978; Part 93. Hearing and Vision Technicians are employed by local health departments (LHDs) and comprehensively trained by the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) to provide screenings in the LHD service area. Under limited supervision, this position performs preliminary and re-test hearing and vision screening at various schools throughout Out-Wayne County to detect hearing or vision abnormalities in children; interprets and records test results and performs any necessary follow-up by letter, phone, or conference; travels to various schools throughout Out-Wayne County and utilizes current county-wide and department-specific software to complete assignments.

Required Tasks

  • Provide preliminary hearing screening to children and adolescents
  • Provide vision screening to children and adolescents
  • Document results of screening correctly and in a timely manner
  • Enter data into pre-approved forms and databases. Assist with generating monthly reports
  • Correctly complete and submit necessary forms for each program, times sheets, and activity sheets in a timely manner
  • Schedule screening sessions in the community
  • Make follow-up telephone calls regarding screening sessions, results, and referrals
  • Develop effective working relationships with a wide variety of people to assure efficient screenings

Educational Requirements

  • High School Diploma or equivalent

Experience Requirements

  • One (1) year of paid or volunteer experience working with children in a medical setting (Doctor's office, clinic or hospital) or nine (9) months of paid or volunteer experience working in an education setting (Daycare, after-school program, preschool, elementary/secondary school, school lunchroom and school library)
  • A valid state of Michigan driver's license with safe and acceptable driving record
  • An automobile available for transportation during work hours on a reimbursed mileage basis
  • Attend the two-week hearing threshold and the one-week vision training courses provided by the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services (MDHHS) and obtain the hearing threshold and vision certification within two years of hire, if trainings are offered by MDHHS or as soon thereafter
  • Demonstrate a professional attitude
  • Demonstrate an ability to work with children, parents, and school staff in a friendly and supportive manner

title: Käsityön lehtori
description:
Haemme Imatran kaupungille KÄSITYÖN LEHTORIA viransijaisuuteen ajalle 26.10.2026 – 5.6.2027. Tehtävä sijoittuu palvelussuhteen alussa Vuoksenniskan koulukeskukseen ja opetettavana aineena on käsityön kovat materiaalit vuosiluokille 5–9.

Vuoksenniskan koulukeskus on noin 560 oppilaan ja lähes sadan ammattilaisen vireä työyhteisö. Sijaitsemme upealla paikalla Salpausselän harjulla, Saimaan ja Immolanjärven välissä. Koulumme lähiympäristö tarjoaa monipuoliset liikunta- ja ulkoilumahdollisuudet ja opetuksessamme painottuu luonto ja luontoyhteys.

Koulussamme annetaan perusopetusta luokille 1-9. Lisäksi oppilaat saavat tukea oppimiseen ja käyttäytymiseen joustavissa pienryhmissä, tukiluokilla sekä pidennetyn oppivelvollisuuden luokilla. Koulussamme on myös joustavan perusopetuksen JOPO-luokka sekä valmistava luokka.

Yhdessä olemme enemmän - Uskomme osaamisen jakamiseen ja kollegan auttamiseen. Meillä et jää yksin: panostamme positiiviseen toimintakulttuuriin, jota vahvistamme muun muassa ProKoulu-toiminnan avulla.

Tiimityö on voimamme - Pääset mukaan vaikuttamaan ja kehittämään koulun arkea tavoitteellisesti toimivien luokkataso- ja aihealuetiimien kautta.

Hyvinvointi keskiössä - Tavoitteenamme on työssään viihtyvä henkilöstö ja hyvinvoivat oppilaat. Olemme tiivis ja toisiamme kannustava yhteisö, jossa jokaisen vahvuudet tunnistetaan ja niitä hyödynnetään.

Tukea alkuun - Meille on kunnia-asia ottaa uusi työntekijä avosylin vastaan. Saat avuksesi vertaismentorin, joka perehdyttää sinut koulun käytäntöihin ja on tukenasi opetustyön arjessa.

Tutustu Imatran kouluihin työpaikkana www.imatra.fi/koulutyot.

Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä eläväisen karjalaisen työyhteisön tuen. Ympäriltäsi löydät kehittymisestä innostuneen kaupungin, joka on kokoaan suurempi ja katsoo tulevaisuuteen. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja työnkuvaasi.

Työntekijänämme saat myös
hyvät täydennyskoulutusmahdollisuudet
ePassi-edun
mahdollisuuden osallistua kehittämistyöhön ja vaikuttaa sen muotoutumiseen
perhemyönteisen työyhteisön
hyvät työnohjaus- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet
lakisääteisen ennaltaehkäisevän työterveyshuollon lisäksi yleislääkäritasoisen sairaanhoidon
savuttoman työyhteisön.

Viran kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen (986/98) mukaan; teknisen työn tai monimateriaalisen käsityön opettajan kelpoisuus. Tehtävään valitaan ansioitunein ja työnantajan sopivimmaksi haastattelujen ja muiden selvitysten perusteella arvioima henkilö.

Kelpoisten hakijoiden puuttuessa myös kelpoisuutta vailla olevat huomioidaan.

Arvostamme positiivista asennetta ja innostunutta, ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta.

Valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote. Virkasuhteen ehdot määräytyvät OVTES:n mukaan. Kelpoisen aineenopettajan peruspalkka Imatran kaupungilla on 3199,95 - 3393,14 €/kk. Käytämme määräaikaisissa virkasuhteissa koeaikaa, joka on korkeintaan puolet virkasuhteen kestosta, kuitenkin enintään kuusi kuukautta.

Toimita hakemuksesi tiistaihin 22.9.2026 kello 15.00 mennessä oheisen Kuntarekryn linkin kautta. Opinto- ja työtodistuksia ei liitetä hakemukseen, niihin tutustumme haastattelun yhteydessä.

title: Engineering Supervisor
description:
OVERVIEW:

At The Westin Nashville, we believe every exceptional guest experience begins behind the scenes. As an Engineering Supervisor, you'll play a vital role in maintaining the comfort, safety, and quality our guests expect while helping ensure our hotel operates at its best every day. This senior-level engineering position is ideal for a highly skilled maintenance professional with advanced expertise in one or more building trades and a passion for solving complex challenges. You'll work independently on sophisticated maintenance and repair projects, support the reliability of critical hotel systems, and serve as a trusted technical resource and mentor to fellow engineering associates. If you take pride in craftsmanship, thrive in a collaborative environment, and are committed to delivering excellence, we invite you to build your career with The Westin Nashville.

THE POSSIBILITIES:

Have you ever had a job where you left better than you started? That’s life at The Westin Nashville where more than half of associates move into second, third, or more roles with us. Where most companies measure performance, we also measure and reward potential. Career Development is not just a buzz word, it’s our way of doing business. And career development doesn’t stop at the door. Millions have found a lifetime of opportunity and growth in the hospitality industry. Who knows, before you know it you are managing your own hotel/restaurant or owning it. Whether you stay with us, or grow beyond us, your leader will be right there with you, cheering you on.

Now, we also know you are more than just the sum of what you do at work. That’s why when it comes to benefits and perks, we think about the whole person, the total you, and offer benefits which are flexible and able to meet your individual needs.

Some reasons people really like working here:

  • Discounts on Rental Cars, other popular hotels, and hotel alternatives

  • Discounts on Car and Computer Purchases
  • But you don’t need to go anywhere to have a great time. We host Associate Recognition events, celebrations, and parties year-round.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair complex building systems, equipment, and facilities to ensure safe, efficient, and uninterrupted hotel operations.
  • Perform advanced preventive maintenance and inspections on hotel equipment and infrastructure, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
  • Utilize advanced expertise in one or more skilled trades, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or carpentry, while maintaining a strong working knowledge of all building systems.
  • Respond promptly to guest service requests and maintenance work orders, delivering timely solutions and exceptional service.
  • Complete minor renovation, repair, and improvement projects while ensuring quality workmanship and adherence to hotel standards.

Upon employment, all employees are required to fully comply with policies and procedures for the safe and effective operation of the hotel’s facilities.

title: Global Master Data Coordinator
description: About the role The Global Master Data Coordinator plays a critical role in enabling operational excellence across Breville’s global business. This position is responsible for the governance, integrity, and lifecycle management of product and master data across our enterprise systems. From SKU creation to product lifecycle transitions, this role ensures that our data is structured, accurate, and aligned — supporting everything from product launches to supply chain execution and consumer experience. The successful candidate combines analytical rigor with systems thinking, understanding how data flows across ERP, PIM, CRM, and supporting platforms to keep our global operations running seamlessly. This is more than data maintenance — it is about building and sustaining the foundation that supports a premium global brand. Key responsibilities include: Master Data Governance Accuracy Create, maintain, and govern global product master data and SKUs using PIM system and published across ERP, CRM, and related systems. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of data in alignment with global standards and governance frameworks. Define and uphold data naming conventions, attribute structures, and documentation standards. Conduct routine audits and proactively resolve discrepancies to maintain high data integrity. Support global harmonization initiatives to ensure scalable and consistent data practices across regions. Product SKU Lifecycle Management Manage SKU setup, updates, substitutions, supersessions, and deactivations for finished goods and spare parts within the PIM system, maintaining it as the single source of truth and ensuring accurate data flow to all downstream systems. Maintain and oversee SKU Product Lifecycle, ensuring alignment from development through end-of-life. Coordinate cross-functionally with Product Development tram, Spares team, Service team, Technical Services, and regional teams to ensure product data readiness. Proactively communicate potential product availability or master data risks to relevant stakeholders. Systems Integration, Performance Continuous Improvement Understand system logic, data dependencies, and process flows to proactively identify, mitigate, and resolve risks. Support system enhancements, testing cycles, and data migration initiatives to ensure data integrity and operational continuity. Develop and maintain clear process documentation to enable scalable, efficient, and repeatable master data workflows. Drive initiatives that enhance data accuracy, operational efficiency, and overall consumer experience. Monitor performance against KPIs and SLAs related to master data creation and maintenance. Identify opportunities for automation, optimization, and process improvement. Contribute to a culture of accountability, precision, and continuous improvement across global operations.

title: LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST
description:
Location: UFC GYM Pinellas Park + Surrounding Community
Job Type: Commission Only | Flexible Schedule
Experience: Preferred, but Not Required

TURN YOUR NETWORK INTO INCOME

UFC GYM Pinellas Park is looking for motivated, outgoing individuals to join our team as Lead Generation Specialists.

This is not a traditional sales position. Your job is to get out into the community, start conversations, build relationships, and identify people who may be interested in UFC GYM.

You create the opportunity. Our sales team handles the rest.

The position is commission based, with no required schedule. You choose when and where you work, making this an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a flexible way to earn additional income while building valuable marketing and networking experience.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Engage with people throughout the local community.
  • Introduce people to UFC GYM Pinellas Park and what we offer.
  • Identify individuals who may be interested in fitness, training, MMA, BJJ, boxing, Muay Thai, or other UFC GYM programs.
  • Collect qualified leads and their contact information.
  • Generate leads through networking, community events, social interactions, local businesses, referrals, and grassroots outreach.
  • Build relationships with local businesses, organizations, and community members.
  • Share approved UFC GYM promotions, guest passes, and offers.
  • Submit leads to the UFC GYM Pinellas Park sales team for follow up.
  • Track your leads and their results.
  • Represent UFC GYM Pinellas Park professionally in the community.
YOU DO NOT HAVE TO SELL

Your responsibility is lead generation, not closing memberships.

Once you provide a qualified lead, our professional sales team will contact the prospect, conduct the tour, explain membership options, and close the sale.

You earn your commission when your lead becomes a UFC GYM Pinellas Park member.

COMPENSATION

$50 COMMISSION FOR EVERY MEMBERSHIP SALE

For every qualified lead you generate that results in a completed UFC GYM Pinellas Park membership sale, you earn:

$50 COMMISSION

ADDITIONAL $100 BONUS FOR EVERY 20 SALES

Hit 20 completed membership sales from your leads and receive an additional:

$100 BONUS

There is no cap on your earning potential.

The more qualified leads you generate and the more memberships your leads produce, the more you can earn.

WORK YOUR OWN HOURS

There is no fixed schedule for this position.

Work when it fits your schedule.

You can generate leads:

  • During your free time
  • On evenings or weekends
  • At community events
  • Through your personal network
  • While visiting local businesses
  • Through social and community activities
  • Anywhere you can professionally connect with potential UFC GYM members
This is an opportunity designed around your availability and your ability to generate results.

OPPORTUNITY FOR ADVANCEMENT

High performing Lead Generation Specialists may have the opportunity to advance into a Sales Specialist position with UFC GYM Pinellas Park.

Sales Specialists may qualify for an hourly wage plus additional compensation and take on greater responsibility within our membership sales team.

This gives you the opportunity to start with a flexible, commission based role and build your way into a more traditional sales position based on your performance.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for people who are:

  • Outgoing and comfortable talking to new people
  • Energetic and positive
  • Self motivated
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Good communicators
  • Professional and personable
  • Active in their local community
  • Comfortable networking and building relationships
  • Motivated by performance and earning potential
  • Interested in fitness, MMA, sports, or the UFC GYM environment
Previous sales experience is not required.

Previous experience in sales, marketing, fitness, hospitality, customer service, networking, or community outreach is a plus.

Training and guidance will be provided.

WHY UFC GYM PINELLAS PARK?

UFC GYM combines fitness, MMA, combat sports, and a strong community environment. As a Lead Generation Specialist, you'll have the opportunity to represent a recognized fitness brand while developing real world experience in networking, marketing, lead generation, and business development.

If you're someone who enjoys meeting people, building relationships, and creating opportunities, this position gives you the freedom to work on your own schedule and get paid for your results.

READY TO GET STARTED?

Interested in becoming a Lead Generation Specialist at UFC GYM Pinellas Park?

Contact Sly at UFC GYM Pinellas Park to learn more and apply.

Email: largo@ufcgym.com

UFC GYM Pinellas Park
Create opportunities. Build relationships. Get paid for results.

ABOUT US

One Partner. Every Phase.

As a recognized Top Workplace, we offer professional development opportunities, flexible work arrangements, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to share in our success.

Learn more about our culture at .

OVERVIEW

Join our team as a Graphic Designer!

We are looking for this person to join our team in one of our 8 office locations (Maumee, OH; Cincinnati, OH; Indianapolis, IN; Peachtree City, GA; Overland Park, KS; Edina, MN; Raleigh, NC; Westminster, CO). The position is salaried and includes eligibility for overtime pay.

The Graphic Designer is responsible for creating visually compelling materials that support the company’s brand, marketing initiatives, and communication goals. This role works closely with the marketing team, technical staff, subject-matter experts, and various other departments to design graphics, marketing campaigns, and collateral materials that clearly and effectively communicate complex concepts to internal and external audiences.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Proposal & Pursuit Support

  • Design visually compelling proposals, qualification packages, presentations, and pursuit materials that align with brand standards.
  • Create graphics, diagrams, and visual storytelling elements that explain engineering services, processes, and project approaches.
  • Work closely with proposal writers, project managers, and subject-matter experts to turn technical information into accessible, professional layouts.
  • Format and refine proposal documents in Adobe InDesign and Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint).
  • Develop custom templates, cover designs, infographics, and project sheets that enhance the firm’s competitive positioning.

Branding & Marketing Design

  • Produce digital and print marketing materials including brochures, one-pagers, email graphics, trade show displays, posters, and social media assets.
  • Ensure consistent brand presence across all materials and internal teams.
  • Update and maintain the library of brand assets, corporate imagery, and design templates.
  • Support internal communications with presentation decks, program logos, and event collateral.

Collaboration & Project Management

  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering, construction, and automation teams to understand projects and gather accurate information.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Work within established brand guidelines while contributing fresh creative ideas.
  • Assist with administrative design tasks such as file organization, template updates, and content formatting.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communications, or related field.
  • 1-3 years of graphic design experience (experience in architecture, engineering, or construction industry preferred but not required).
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).
  • Experience in Microsoft Word and PowerPoint for proposal environments.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating layout design, branding, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to interpret technical information and translate it into simple, clean visuals.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to work on multiple proposals and marketing projects simultaneously with quick turnaround times.
  • May require travel, both locally and overnight, approximately 10-15%.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; stoop, kneel, crouch; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk, and hear.
  • The employee must frequently lift and/or move objects up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • This employee may perform industrial field work which could include exposure to hazardous locations, inclement weather, moving mechanical parts, noise, ladders, uneven ground, and stairs.
  • This employee may perform industrial field work which could include exposure to a wide range of known food allergens.

WHY MATRIX?

  • Generous Paid Time Off (Extra Days for Purchase) and Nine Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave, Bereavement Leave
  • Flexible Work Schedules, Work at Home Options
  • Wellness Program with Incentive Dollars, Preventative Health Screenings
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Critical Illness and Accident Insurance

Financial Wellness:

  • 401(k) and Roth Plans with 5% Match and immediate vesting upon enrollment
  • Market-based competitive Compensation and Overtime Pay for Salaried positions
  • Quarterly Bonus Program and Spot Bonus Program
  • Pre-Tax Health Savings Account (HSA) with Match, and Pre-Tax Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Life Insurance Paid by Matrix and Buy-Up Options
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Plan Paid by Matrix

Personal and Professional Growth:

  • Onboarding and Mentoring, Internal Training and Cross Training
  • PE Certifications, Registration, and Renewals
  • Assessments and Leadership Development
  • External Certification Programs, Professional Memberships
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

Recognition, Culture, and Other Perks:

  • Regular Employee Updates and Town Halls, Annual Engagement Surveys
  • Employee Service Awards and Peer Recognition
  • Strong Fundamentals (Core Values)
  • Employee Referral Program/Bonus
  • Casual Dress
  • Discount Programs
  • Community Involvement Committee

title: Safety Director
description:
Overview:

The Director of Safety is responsible for developing, leading, and executing the Company's enterprise-wide safety strategy across all manufacturing, warehouse, and corporate operations. This role serves as the senior safety leader and is responsible for fostering a culture where safety is integrated into every aspect of the business.

The Director of Safety will partner closely with Operations, Transportation, Human Resources, Facilities, Risk Management, and senior leadership to ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local safety regulations while driving continuous improvement initiatives that reduce workplace injuries, improve employee engagement, and promote operational excellence.

This position requires travel to all company locations to ensure consistency in safety standards, conduct site assessments, coach leaders, and support local teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Safety Strategy & Leadership

· Develop and execute the Company's enterprise-wide health and safety strategy.

· Establish long-term safety goals, objectives, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

· Lead initiatives that build a proactive safety culture across all locations.

· Serve as the subject matter expert on occupational health and safety matters.

· Present safety metrics and strategic initiatives to executive leadership.

· Champion safety as a core organizational value throughout the business.

Regulatory Compliance

· Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and all applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

· Develop, maintain, and continuously improve company safety policies and procedures.

· Monitor changes in regulatory requirements and implement necessary operational changes.

· Coordinate OSHA inspections and responses.

· Maintain required safety documentation and reporting.

Injury Prevention & Risk Reduction

· Develop strategies to reduce OSHA recordables, lost-time incidents, workers' compensation claims, and near misses.

· Lead incident investigations utilizing root cause analysis methodologies.

· Identify trends through safety analytics and implement corrective actions.

· Oversee hazard assessments, ergonomic evaluations, and risk mitigation plans.

· Develop preventive action plans following incidents.

Multi-Site Safety Operations

· Conduct regular safety audits at all manufacturing plants, warehouses, transportation facilities, and corporate offices.

· Standardize safety programs across all locations.

· Ensure consistency in safety expectations regardless of location.

· Evaluate facility-specific risks and develop customized action plans.

· Monitor compliance through routine inspections and scorecards.

Leadership Development

· Coach executives, directors, managers, and supervisors on safety leadership.

· Develop safety accountability programs for operational leaders.

· Deliver leadership training focused on incident prevention, hazard recognition, and employee engagement.

· Support managers in conducting effective safety meetings and observations.

Training & Employee Engagement

· Develop comprehensive safety training programs for new hires and existing employees.

· Ensure required OSHA and regulatory training is completed.

· Lead annual safety campaigns and awareness initiatives.

· Promote employee participation through safety committees and engagement programs.

· Foster a "See Something, Say Something" culture throughout the organization.

Continuous Improvement

· Develop dashboards to monitor leading and lagging safety indicators.

· Benchmark safety performance against industry standards.

· Identify opportunities for process improvement.

Requirements:

Education

· Bachelor's degree in Occupational Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Environmental Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field required.

· Master's degree preferred.

· OSHA 30-Hour Certification.

Experience

· 10+ years of progressive environmental health and safety leadership experience.

· Minimum 5 years leading multi-site safety programs.

· Experience within manufacturing, food manufacturing, distribution, warehouse, logistics, or transportation operations strongly preferred.

· Experience leading safety strategy across multiple states.

· Proven success reducing OSHA recordables and workers' compensation costs.

· Experience developing enterprise safety programs.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following preferred:

· Certified Safety Professional (CSP)

· Associate Safety Professional (ASP)

· Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH)

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

title: Street Operator III/CDL
description:
A Street Operator III for Maumelle Public Works carries out various duties to contribute to the upkeep and construction of streets in the City of Maumelle. Typical duties for this position include (but are not limited to): operating heavy machinery, using various hand and power tools, pouring concrete, laying asphalt, and other duties as assigned by the Supervisor and/or Director of Public Works.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES

  1. Operate graders, backhoes, dozers, front-end loaders, and other related machinery
  2. Operate mowing machines, jackhammers, chain saws, concrete saws, and posthole diggers
  3. Use hand tools such as saws, hammers, nail guns, and related equipment and tools
  4. Mow grass using riding or other types of lawnmowers
  5. Remove or trim shrubs, hedges, and trees using hand or power tools
  6. Plant grass, flowers, and trees
  7. Paint and repair park benches and other park equipment
  8. Build, repair, and paint guardrails and fences
  9. Remove weeds and trash from parks and streets
  10. Perform heavy manual labor for extended periods and under varying weather conditions
  11. Ground maintenance work such as weed-eating, edging, and similar tasks
  12. Building maintenance work such as painting, carpentry, concrete, and similar tasks
  13. Pick up trash on rights-of-way, parks, common areas, and other City property
  14. Repair playground equipment and motor vehicle equipment, as instructed
  15. Assist Crew Foreman in the design and construction of street signs and traffic control devices
  16. Install and maintain street signs and traffic control equipment
  17. Assist Crew Foreman in performing carpentry and building maintenance work in City-owned buildings
  18. Assist in construction projects of laying concrete blocks, mixing and pouring cement mortar, constructing and repairing street curbs, gutters, and sidewalks
  19. Operate paint striper for painting markings on street surfaces, sidewalks, and parking lots
  20. Work on street construction and maintenance crews performing tasks such as breaking pavement, pouring and shoveling asphalt and concrete, removing ice and snow, salting and sanding streets, and other similar tasks
  21. Operate and perform minor maintenance on trucks and other motor-driven equipment
  22. Supervise assigned employees
  23. Notify the Director of Public Works of unusual or suspicious activities or circumstances
  24. Perform any other activities as may be deemed necessary by the Director of Public Works

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The education and experience listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities generally necessary to fulfill this requirement.

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED)
  • 12 to 18 months related experience (equivalent training/experience will be considered)
  • 1 to 6 months managerial/supervisory experience.
  • Class A or B Commercial Driver’s License

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operator IIIs in the Street Department directly lead one (1) to three (3) laborers. They carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the City’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance, rewarding and disciplining employees, addressing complaints, and resolving problems as they arise.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions and expectations.
  • While performing the functions of this job, the employee is regularly required to: sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; climb or balance; and taste or smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move 25 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

SUPPLEMENTAL INFORMATION

  • May occasionally work nights, weekends, or holidays.
  • Benefits include: health, dental, and life insurance; 12 paid holidays; paid vacation; paid sick leave; reduced rates on family insurance coverage, and other voluntary insurance benefits. Perks include individual membership to the Jess Odom Community Center and Center on the Lake; with reduced rates for family memberships.

title: Controller
description:
Title: Corporate Controller.
Company: The DeMatteis Organization.
Location: Elmont, NY (onsite 5x a week).

Position Summary:
The Corporate Controller serves as the organization's senior accounting leader, providing financial oversight, strategic guidance, and operational support to ownership and executive leadership while ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and scalability of the company's financial systems. They are both strategic and tactical — a hands-on, roll-up-your-sleeves executive who is as comfortable working directly in the numbers as they are building trusted processes, systems, and people. This individual serves as a trusted financial steward to ownership, earning and maintaining the confidence that a closely-held, family-financed organization requires from its senior accounting leader, while building and leading a high-performing, multi-functional accounting organization spanning corporate accounting, project accounting, payroll, and accounts receivable/payable.

Duties:

Leadership:
  • Own all accounting and financial operations of the company.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, multi-functional accounting department spanning corporate accounting, project accounting, payroll, and accounts receivable/payable.
  • Hire, mentor, and establish clear goals and trusted processes across the accounting function.
  • Partner effectively with other departments on matters where responsibilities intersect or are shared, to reach aligned, company-wide outcomes.
  • Build and maintain direct, ongoing relationships with external CPA firms, bonding companies, and banks proactively managing these relationships rather than engaging only during audit season or renewal periods.
  • Lead and coordinate annual audits, working directly with external auditors.
  • Oversight & Compliance.
  • Develop and maintain sound financial policies, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Prepare and oversee the review of accurate monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual financial statements, including financial analysis and reporting to ownership and executive leadership.
  • Produce executive financial reports, forecasts, cash flow projections, and key performance indicators.
  • Manage company cash flow and banking relationships.
  • Partner with executive leadership on strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and business decision-making.
  • Oversee job cost accounting, work-in-progress (WIP) schedules, and percentage-of-completion accounting across all active projects.
  • Oversee project profitability reporting, contract billing, change order accounting, retainage management, and cost code management.
  • Apply GMP, lump sum, CM, and GC accounting treatment appropriately across project types.
  • Manage general ledger reconciliation.
  • Oversee project financial performance reporting and partner with project managers and operations teams to identify cost issues, margin risks, forecasting variances, and corrective actions.
  • Oversee payroll administration and compliance for union and non-union employees, including certified payroll, prevailing wage requirements, deductions, and tax reporting.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local tax and regulatory requirements affecting the company's accounting and financial operations, including timely filing of taxes.
  • Manage surety reporting requirements, including preparation of financial information provided to bonding companies and monitoring bonding capacity.
  • Improve departmental efficiency through process improvements and technology.
  • Ensure accurate month-end and year-end closing processes.
  • Create, implement, and manage internal controls and risk management programs, identifying financial risks and implementing corrective measures as needed.
  • Oversee cost-to-complete forecasting and estimated cost at completion (EAC) reporting to evaluate project profitability and financial performance.
  • Oversee analysis of project overbillings, underbillings, and related revenue recognition impacts.
  • Develop and analyze backlog reporting, including awarded work, remaining contract value, projected revenue, and profitability trends.

Qualifications:

Required:
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive accounting experience in construction, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (e.g., Controller).
  • Extensive experience in commercial or heavy civil GC/CM accounting, including in union environments.
  • Proven experience building and leading a multi-functional accounting department (corporate accounting, project accounting, payroll, AR/AP).
  • Experience with multi-entity/multi-company consolidated financial reporting.
  • Experience managing bonding/surety relationships and banking covenant compliance.
  • Experience with certified payroll and prevailing wage compliance.
  • Experience supporting proposal/bid financial analysis and project-level budgeting and forecasting.
  • Established experience working directly with external auditors, CPA firms, bonding companies, and financial institutions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modeling, multi-entity consolidation, and pivot table-based reporting.
  • Experience with construction ERP/accounting software (CMiC preferred).
  • Experience working for a large commercial GC, heavy civil, or comparable construction contractor.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and city accounting, tax, and payroll regulations relevant to construction including FLSA wage and hour requirements, IRS/ERISA employee benefit plan reporting, and prevailing wage law with particular attention to New York City's distinct regulatory requirements, which often go beyond state and federal baselines.
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and city recordkeeping and document retention requirements applicable to financial, tax, and payroll records.

Preferred:
  • CPA designation.
  • MBA or master's degree in accounting or finance.
  • Experience leading or supporting an ERP/accounting system implementation or conversion.
  • Familiarity with lien waivers, AIA billing, and owner/GC contract billing formats.
  • Knowledge of GAAP percentage-of-completion accounting and ASC 606 revenue recognition.
  • Prior experience in a closely-held or family-owned organization.

Competencies:
  • Trusted Financial Steward — Earns and maintains the confidence of ownership/principals in a closely-held, family-financed organization; operates with the transparency and judgment that level of trust requires.
  • Team Development & Accountability — Builds and scales a high-performing, multi-functional accounting organization.
  • Strategic Thinking & Data-Driven Decision-Making — Connects day-to-day financial data to long-term company goals, drawing sound conclusions from complex, multi-project and multi-entity data to inform recommendations to ownership.
  • Risk Management & Judgment — Identifies financial and compliance risk early and acts decisively.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Works effectively with other departments, including those with overlapping or conflicting responsibilities to reach aligned outcomes.
  • Continuous Learning & Regulatory Currency — Proactively stays current on evolving federal, state, and city accounting, tax, and payroll regulations, as well as emerging financial systems and practices, and translates that knowledge into updated company practices.
