title: Project Coordinator - Brampton, ON
description:
Job Description

VICTAULIC

Project Coordinator
Brampton, ON
Full-Time (Hybrid)

ABOUT VICTAULIC

Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.

Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.

An Industry Leader With a Heart as Big as Its Ambition and Innovation

At Victaulic, we’re committed to constructing a better world for and with our people.

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

Our commitment to our people is built on four pillars:

  • We build from within.
  • We stand behind our people.
  • We foster an environment for constant learning.
  • We engineer change for a more stable and sustainable world.

YOUR IMPACT STARTS HERE

We're looking for a Project Coordinator to join our team in Brampton, ON supporting construction-related projects throughout Eastern Canada.

The Project Coordinator will support the Project Execution Manager and broader project team in the successful planning, coordination, and execution of construction-related projects throughout Eastern Canada.

This role is ideal for a highly organized individual who enjoys managing multiple priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring project details are tracked effectively from project award through completion. The Project Coordinator will play a key role in maintaining project schedules, monitoring deliverables, supporting customer communication, and ensuring project documentation remains accurate and up to date.

The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced environment, possess strong communication skills, and enjoy working collaboratively with internal teams, customers, contractors, and external stakeholders. This role also offers a clear development pathway toward a future Project Execution Manager position within Victaulic.

WHAT YOU’LL BUILD & OWN

  • Support the Project Execution Manager with day-to-day coordination of active projects.
  • Assist in maintaining project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and action item trackers.
  • Coordinate project documentation, meeting minutes, project correspondence, and filing systems.
  • Track project progress and assist with the preparation of project status reports and dashboards.
  • Schedule and coordinate internal project meetings, customer meetings, and project reviews.
  • Work closely with Sales, Engineering, Customer Care, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to support project execution activities.
  • Assist in monitoring project budgets, timelines, and resource requirements.
  • Follow up with internal and external stakeholders to ensure commitments and deliverables are completed on schedule.
  • Support project planning & setup, execution, and close-out activities.
  • Help identify project risks, schedule impacts, and potential issues and escalate as appropriate.
  • Assist with customer communications related to project updates, schedules, and deliverables.
  • Participate in site visits and customer meetings as required.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives and the development of project management best practices.
  • Prepare and deliver project presentations to support internal and customer communication.
  • Conduct MAR (Material-Availability-Report) analysis to support project reporting.
  • Commit to continuous learning through training, mentoring, and skill development initiatives.
  • Support teammates while fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Assist in responding to RFP’s and contribute to proposal development as needed.
  • Support contract, change, and interface management activities throughout project execution.
  • Ensure proper storage and organization of project files, drawings, and records throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in project coordination, project administration, construction, engineering, manufacturing, or a related environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Experience supporting construction, engineering, industrial, manufacturing, or infrastructure projects.
  • Familiarity with project management software such as Microsoft Project, Autodesk, Smartsheet, Asana, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of project management principles and methodologies.
  • CAPM certification or project management coursework is considered an asset.
  • Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Exposure to Lean, Continuous Improvement, or process optimization initiatives.
  • Familiarity with contracting models such as EPC, Design-Bid-Build, Design-Build and Time & Material.
  • Awareness of safety procedures and regulatory compliance requirements in construction or industrial environments.
  • Willingness to travel up to 15-20% throughout Canada for project meetings, customer visits, and site support as required.

WHAT WE OFFER

Build A Better Career

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career development opportunities and internal promotion pathways
  • Educational reimbursement and ongoing learning opportunities, including Victaulic University

Build A Better Future

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
  • Health Spending Account (HSA)
  • Pension Plan with a company contribution
  • RRSP and TFSA savings programs

Build A Better You

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Wellness Hub
  • Wellness Works Program
  • Access to wellness resources including Phzio, PocketPills, and employee discount programs through Venngo
  • Flexible benefits designed to support you and your family’s well-being
  • Inclusive, team-oriented culture where people look out for one another

Build A Better World

Join a company whose products contribute to a safer, more sustainable built environment every day.

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this position is $65,000 to $85,000 annually, based on experience.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Victaulic is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, welcoming applicants without discrimination based on age, race, colour, national origin, citizenship, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status.

Victaulic is committed to providing equitable opportunities to all applicants and welcomes applications from all qualified persons. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require an accommodation, please notify us at hr.canada@victaulic.com and we will work with you to meet your needs.

AI-assisted tools may be used to support the review of applications as part of the hiring process.

Let’s Build a Better World Together.

title: Team Leader

Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams is searching for part-time Team Leaders to join our Sparkman Wharf team.

We view ice cream as a form of art.

Team Jeni’s Team Leaders are part-time crew members who lead shifts. In addition to leading shifts, they scoop and serve ice cream to our customers, make waffle products, run the register with cash management responsibilities, keep the shop clean, change out buckets of ice cream, and perform a number of other important, related tasks.

As a Team Leader, you will:

  • Serve the ice cream Time magazine calls “the best in America”

  • Gain valuable real-world business and entrepreneurship experience

  • Work in an environment oriented around serving each other and making people’s day

  • Lead shifts and act as a role model for other team members

  • Have opportunities for growth within a growing company

  • Receive competitive compensation

Qualities of Team Leaders:

  • Exhibit passion for community, an eye for detail, a willingness to clean (a lot), stamina (to serve people in long lines), and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • The ability to positively influence and lead a shift of ambassadors, helping them uphold the highest standards and feel supported

  • Resourceful and calm when challenges come up

  • Have great judgment, common sense, and be skillful interpersonally

  • Familiar with (and be able to articulate to customers) what distinguishes Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams from other ice creams, and be able to articulate that to the 500th customer with the same care and presence as the 1st customer

  • Available to work weekends, late nights (past 11 p.m.)

  • Provide consistent, world-class service to every single customer

  • Reliable, on time, and ready to hustle for every shift

  • Committed to the well-being of their shop team, their community, and the environment around them

About Jeni’s Splendid Ice Creams:

Founded by Jeni Britton in 2002, Jeni's Splendid Ice Creams is a B Corp headquartered in Columbus, Ohio, with scoop shops in over twenty cities across the country, making it possible for members of Team Jeni’s who are interested in developing their careers, or transitioning to a new city, to have meaningful opportunities to learn, grow, and explore.

Our Team Leaders make a difference in their shop, their community, and in how they partner with their team and serve their customers. If this opportunity sounds delicious to you, please apply.

Jeni's is an equal opportunity employer. Said our way, we love and honor differences, and we love sharing common values such as talent, hustle, guts, resilience, and empathy. Our differences are a primary source of our team's strength and we crave having a team rich with diversity which is creativity and art in its human form.

title: Senior Manager, Data Science, AI and Advance Analytics for Commercial & Medical
location: Americas, US-PA, King of Prussia, CSL Behring
description:
Major Responsibilities:


Analytics & AI Development

· Serve as a hands-on data science practitioner, actively developing models, writing code, conducting exploratory data analysis, engineering features, validating outputs, and supporting deployment of AI/ML solutions into business workflows.

  • Develop, validate, and deploy machine learning, generative AI, and advanced analytics solutions to address Commercial and Medical business challenges, including rare disease patient identification, HCP/HCO segmentation, forecasting, customer analytics, patient journey analytics, and insight generation.
  • Translate complex business problems into well-defined data science use cases, technical requirements, analytical approaches, and implementation plans.
  • Build, evaluate, and monitor analytical models and data pipelines, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, explainability, and alignment with CSL data governance standards.
  • Support the design and implementation of generative AI and LLM-based solutions, including retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge mining, conversational analytics, and agentic workflows, as applicable.
  • Apply appropriate model validation, monitoring, drift detection, and performance measurement approaches to ensure AI/ML solutions remain accurate, reliable, and fit for purpose.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, I&T, Data Governance, Compliance, and other enterprise partners to ensure data science and AI solutions are aligned with strategic business needs and enterprise standards.
  • Serve as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams by translating business needs into actionable analytical requirements and communicating technical concepts in a clear, practical way.
  • Support adoption of AI-enabled tools by building stakeholder trust in model outputs through transparency, explainability, documentation, and strong change management.
  • Contribute to cross-functional AI/ML governance forums and ensure alignment with global AI/ML initiatives, responsible AI principles, and CSL technology standards.
  • Help establish repeatable playbooks, templates, and ways of working for AI use case development, deployment, measurement, and scale.

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Support evaluation, selection, and management of external data science, AI, and technology partners, including vendors supporting advanced analytics platforms, model development, deployment, and AI enablement.
  • Translate business needs into vendor scopes of work, technical requirements, deliverables, timelines, and success measures.

  • Work independently as well as in a team-oriented environment within the organization
  • Ability to read and write proficiently in the English language
  • Ability to understand and follow oral and written directions
  • Must possess excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to cope with Pressure & Setbacks - Work productively in a pressurized environment; Keeps emotions under control during difficult situations
  • Formally accept company drug, alcohol, and physical evaluation screens. Signed acceptance of Turner Industries, Ltd. Drug, Alcohol and Contraband Policy

  • SAP

title: R&D Technician - Product Development
description:
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented R&D Technician to support product development using microbiology, molecular biology, and/or virology and cell culture techniques. This is a tiered position, meaning the final level (Tech I, Tech II, or Tech III/Senior Tech) will be determined based on the candidate’s education, experience, and demonstrated competencies.

Candidates will play a key role in developing new products, collaborating closely across departments to support our innovation pipeline.

What can I expect in this role?

This is a full time position working Monday-Friday from 8am-5pm.

Some key duties in this role include:

  • Assist with development, manufacturing, and quality control (QC) of microbiology/virology and molecular products.
  • Transfer research findings and product details to other departments such as Production and QC.
  • Perform molecular biology techniques such as PCR, gel electrophoresis, nucleic acid quantification, cloning, and nucleic acid isolation.
  • Perform microbiology or cell-culture/virology techniques including microbial culture, enumeration/titration, pathogen identification, and isolation.
  • Manufacture R&D test lots and analyze biomaterial performance per protocols and DMR requirements.
  • Document research activities for product design controls, validations, verifications, qualifications, and statistical analyses.
  • Support product development for unique customer or contract requests outside current product lines.
  • Write or revise SOPs related to R&D procedures.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate and timely production documentation.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What makes you a good fit?

Our goal is finding the right individual for our team – we firmly believe that the right person is someone to invest in and invite to join our family.

Here is what we are looking for:

  • Education (Required for All Tiers):

Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences field (Microbiology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or related discipline)

Tier Differentiation:

Tech I

  • 1 year min experience
  • Requires training and oversight
  • Executes qPCR/ddPCR validation under supervision
  • Participates in basic lab maintenance and documentation tasks
  • Supports production of swabs, pellets, and microorganisms

Tech II

  • 2-3 years min experience
  • Independently documents lab work
  • Executes and reports on qPCR/ddPCR validation
  • Manages multiple lab tasks daily
  • Troubleshoots basic instrumentation
  • Develops single-/two-analyte products under supervision

Tech III

  • 3-5 years min experience
  • Independently plans and executes qPCR/ddPCR studies and writes reports
  • Strong grasp of scientific principles and experimental troubleshooting
  • Mentors and trains junior staff
  • Reprioritizes and manages tasks across multiple projects
  • Troubleshoots both experiments and lab instruments

Competencies:

  • Strong organizational and planning skills
  • High integrity and commitment to quality and compliance
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Proficient with standard laboratory instrumentation and software
  • Strong communication and documentation skills

The ability to pass a background check and drug screening.

Who is Microbiologics?

Microbiologics is one of the fastest growing international biotechnology companies in the nation. We are the world’s leading experts and go-to collaborators in biological products and services, focused on protecting the health and safety of people around the world. For over 50 years, we have been partnering with healthcare and life science laboratories, manufacturers, and suppliers across the globe to co-create and provide biological control materials, assay services and consulting for microbiology, molecular diagnostics, and virology. Headquartered in Saint Cloud, Minnesota, we have additional facilities in California, Kentucky, and Michigan.

What can we offer you?

Glad you asked!

Our award-winning culture is friendly, collaborative, and supportive, providing endless opportunities for individuals to learn and grow, both personally and professionally. At Microbiologics, we believe that "great vision without great people is irrelevant." That's why we are always looking for great people to join our dynamic, innovative company as we provide the highest quality biomaterials for a safer, healthier world.

We have a comprehensive benefits package that includes your standard benefits such as health and dental insurance, health savings account (company funded), life insurance, short and long-term disability, and a 401k program with a generous match to name a few. In addition, we are proud to support our team and their families by offering daycare assistance, tuition reimbursement, bonus potential, a competitive compensation and benefits package, and plenty of opportunities for training and growth.

If you have a passion for science, we encourage you to apply!

Razorpay is one of India's leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that's redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India's largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India's unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you're curious, you'll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say \"thank you.\" Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you'll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About Us

Razorpay today processes $150 Billion+ payments for 10 million+ businesses across 4 continents. The company enables businesses to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale, while helping them manage their finances. We are the leading Payments and Neobanking provider in India and are one of the fastest growing payments providers across South East Asia. We have been the first to bring to market major innovations in India and Malaysia.

Razorpay has raised USD $700M+ in funding till date from marquee investors like GIC, Sequoia Capital, Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, YC, Matrix Partners and many stellar angels.

As part of its ambitious growth strategy in Southeast Asia, Razorpay acquired Curlec in Malaysia. Since making the acquisition, Curlec by Razorpay has received an acquiring license by Bank Negara and is a registered member of Paynet. The Malaysia market presents a unique opportunity for Razorpay Curlec due to its rapid digitalization and growing e-commerce ecosystem. Razorpay Curlec aims to become the preferred payment partner for businesses across Malaysia, offering them the same level of reliability, security, and convenience that has made Razorpay a trusted name in India. We also live in Singapore with plans of expansion to Thailand, Indonesia and the rest of SEA.

About the Role

A Senior Software Development Engineer at Razorpay Curlec is well-grounded - smart, quality focussed, product thinker, business conscious - not mere coders, of course, with very good technical context and experience to write and build quality software. Engineering creates a significant impact across different areas, considering the scale of our software product outreach. You’re also expected to influence the culture of the company and help shape it in the right way.

Location & Commitments

  • Permanent full time role based at our office - Kuala Lumpur (Mondays to Fridays)

Responsibilities

  • Be involved and drive product & design discussions.
  • Help us scale our payment infrastructure to get every Malaysian to pay online.
  • Help us make decisions to shape our REST APIs for developers worldwide.
  • Contribute to open source as we set the standards for mobile payments.
  • Be involved and drive product & design discussions.
  • And, most importantly, brainstorm and create new directions that Razorpay can take in our quest to make online payments easy and accessible to all.
  • Improve system reliability through monitoring, alerting, logging, and automated recovery.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

Requirements

  • 4 - 5 years of experience in Technology.
  • Good experience in working with any of the programming languages like PHP, Python, Django, Golang, Java, C++
  • Understand end-user requirements, formulate use cases and come up with effective solutions.
  • Good understanding of REST APIs and the web in general.
  • Ability to build a feature from scratch & drive it to completion.
  • A willingness to learn new technology, whatever lets you deliver the best product.
  • Have a few weekend side projects up on GitHub
  • Have contributed to an open-source project
  • Have worked at a product company
  • Have a working knowledge of a backend programming language
  • Have worked with AI Code builders like Cursor,Claude etc will be a plus.

title: Senior Product Manager - Safety
description:
Job Title: Senior Product Manager - Safety

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As the newest member of our Product Management team, you will play a crucial role in advancing Veeva Safety, an enterprise-level pharmacovigilance (drug safety) solution that manages the intake, processing, and submission of adverse events for clinical and post-market products. Your contributions will enable the Life Sciences industry as a whole to better track and inform the public about the safety risk profile of the medicines we and our loved ones often rely upon for continued health.
The ideal candidate brings a strong work ethic, a highly inquisitive mindset, a knack for dissecting complex business problems, a collaborative spirit, and a positive attitude in the face of challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers, plus our in-house industry experts and technology A-players to iteratively define a strategic road map, design & build elegant solutions, and bring rewarding solutions to market.
What You'll Do
    • Learn our industry and develop a keen understanding of our customers’ greatest pain points
    • Shape the product road map, prioritizing across releases with respect to strategic and operational goals
    • Design and specify accurate market-wide solutions for urgent real-world problems, in close collaboration with product development teams
    • Become the subject matter expert for your areas of product ownership, providing much-needed guidance to all internal teams
    • Drive product adoption, and measure the success of your solutions
Requirements
    • 5+ years of product management experience with enterprise software
    • 7+ years professional work experience in agile environments
    • Highly motivated, self-driven individual with a strong passion for product success
    • Proven experience with product design and road map planning
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or business administration
Nice to Have
    • Experience in the Life Sciences industry
Interviewing with Veeva

        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise

    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits
    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs

Compensation
    • Base pay: $120,000 - $200,000

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

description:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

AI-Assisted Engineering: Utilize AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate feature development, code generation, refactoring, and unit test creation.

title: Sergeant
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: SERGEANT – PATROL DIVISION – SHERIFF’S OFFICE

Primary Responsibility: Under general supervision, serves as a working first-line supervisor in the Patrol Division. The Patrol Sergeant is responsible for leading deputies through day-to-day field operations, ensuring professional, lawful, and community-oriented policing; providing coaching and accountability; and responding to calls for service and critical incidents. The position enforces local, state, and federal laws; protects life, property, and rights; and promotes public trust and safety for residents and visitors of Gilpin County; and supports effective partnerships with Central City, neighboring agencies, and community stakeholders.

Supervises:

  • Patrol Deputies
  • In the absence of Detention Sergeants, the Patrol Sergeant may provide temporary supervision and support to the Detention Division as operational needs require.

Supervised by:

  • Division Chief - Patrol
  • In the absence of the Division Chief: Follow the chain of command established by the Gilpin County Sheriff's Office.

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Main Job Duties

· Provide visible first-line supervision during routine operations and critical incidents; set expectations, assign resources, and ensure safe, professional performance.

· Coach, train, and evaluate assigned personnel; complete performance evaluations; document performance; and support hiring, onboarding, and discipline processes as needed.

· Promote and model community trust, respectful communication, and de-escalation; resolve problems through sound judgment, tact, discretion, and fairness.

· Respond to calls for service and conduct law enforcement duties, including investigations, arrests based on probable cause or warrants, evidence handling, and court testimony.

· Review, approve, and ensure the quality of written reports and case documentation; ensure timely completion and accuracy of required records.

· Manage and resolve citizen complaints and service concerns; ensure appropriate documentation, follow-up, and communication.

· Coordinate with Communications and partner agencies; provide operational support, mutual aid, and incident command functions as assigned.

· Maintain proficiency and safe operation of assigned equipment and vehicles in normal and emergency conditions; ensure assigned personnel follow policy and "due regard" principles.

· Provide basic medical assistance in emergencies (e.g., first aid/CPR) and coordinate EMS response as needed.

· Participate in professional development to remain current on legal updates, best practices, and trends in law enforcement supervision.

Field Operations (Working Supervisor)

· Respond to and investigate incidents, including assaults, burglaries, thefts, domestic disturbances, alarms, and other calls for service.

· Provide backup and scene supervision; manage scene safety, perimeter control, and coordination with investigators or specialized teams.

· Patrol Gilpin County and assigned areas to maintain visibility, deter crime, and improve community safety; conduct directed patrol, business checks, and problem-solving enforcement.

· Provide law enforcement services to Central City, including response in the casino environment and coordination with city partners.

· Conduct investigations of felony-level crimes when assigned; secure and protect crime scenes; collect and safeguard evidence; and ensure proper submission and documentation.

· Enforce traffic laws and provide traffic control; investigate traffic crashes within assigned jurisdiction(s).

· Prepare and execute search and arrest warrants in coordination with investigators and supervisors, as appropriate.

· Assist with special events planning and operational deployment throughout unincorporated Gilpin County and Central City.

Administrative and Program Responsibilities

· Use computerized systems and databases to enter, store, retrieve, and analyze information as required (e.g., CAD/RMS, evidence tracking, training records).

· Assist with budget preparation and resource planning as assigned.

· Support grant-related activities as assigned, including documentation, reporting, and coordination.

· Support county and agency administrative processes (e.g., workers' compensation initiation when injuries occur) and ensure timely completion of required paperwork.

Specialized / Assignment-Based Duties

The following duties may be assigned to a specific Sergeant based on organizational needs. Performance expectations and evaluation will align with assigned duties.

· Maintain Patrol Division training records, including the Field Training Program; update training materials as needed.

· Audit Daily Field Activity Reports (DFARs), conduct vehicle inspections, and support fleet readiness for assigned teams.

· Oversee Patrol Division scheduling and coverage; coordinate staffing adjustments for operational needs.

· Audit vehicle impounds and ensures compliance with policy and documentation requirements.

· Coordinate and administer selection and testing processes for hiring and transfers as assigned (e.g., Patrol, Detention, Detention Specialist).

· Coordinate and facilitate agency-wide trainings; identify outside training opportunities that support operational readiness and community needs.

· Manage fleet functions as assigned, including vehicle purchase and setup, maintenance coordination, record keeping, and lifecycle planning.

· Assist in the development and maintenance of the Sheriff’s Office policies and procedures.

· Compile and/or review a monthly report of activity and performance statistics for Patrol personnel.

· Order, issue, and track equipment required for duty performance (e.g., less-lethal devices, radar units, uniforms, mobile devices).

· Oversee recruitment activities for Patrol and/or Detentions as assigned.

· Coordinate promotional testing and transfer testing processes (e.g., Sergeant, Investigator) as assigned.

· Serve as liaison with the U.S. Forest Service as assigned; manage related budgeting/accounting and required monthly reports.

· Coordinate DUI, seatbelt, and traffic-safety enforcement grants as assigned.

· Distribute and track civil paperwork as assigned.

· Serve as a back-up Field Training Officer (FTO) when primary FTOs are unavailable and when qualified.

· Maintain and distribute vacation check program participation lists and related records.

· Support summons tracking and development as assigned.

· Serve as back-up liaison for Central City when the Division Chief - Patrol is unavailable.

· Develop operational plans for special events and significant incidents.

· Performs any other duties assigned to support emergency stabilization or facility operations.

· Provides cross-training and knowledge transfer to staff as needed to support continuity of operations and government services.

· Exercises sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive information, ensuring appropriate disclosure only to authorized individuals and entities.

· Assists in stabilizing emergent or unforeseen operational situations to ensure continuity of services and effective organizational response.

· Adheres to all County policies, procedures, regulations, and applicable laws.

Work Schedule

Must be available for shift work, including weekends and holidays, on call coverage, and must be able to respond to call-outs and emergency activations as required, consistent with operational needs and applicable policies and procedures.

Minimum Qualifications

Education: High School diploma or GED required. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience that provide the required knowledge and skills may be considered.

Other Requirements

· Minimum 21 years of age.

· Meets minimum standards established by Colorado Revised Statues and Colorado POST, as applicable.

· Valid Colorado driver’s license with no restriction due to driving record; ability to operate a county vehicle.

· Must be insurable per county policy.

· Successful completion of background investigation, including criminal and driving history. If an internal promotion, the original background investigation will suffice.

· No felony convictions and no disqualifying misdemeanors or significant prior criminal activity as defined by Colorado POST rules and guidelines.

· Minimum of three (3) years of law enforcement experience as a Colorado POST-certified peace officer. Prior supervisory experience preferred. Less experience will be considered depending on the needs of the organization.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

· Knowledge of Colorado and federal criminal law, constitutional criminal procedure, and criminal investigations.

· Strong report-writing and criminal case preparation skills; ability to review and approve reports for quality and completeness.

· Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in English, verbally and in writing; ability to listen and gather information effectively.

· Ability to act calmly and decisively under stress; make sound judgments; and apply policy, law, and best practices to dynamic situations.

· Ability to lead, coach, and hold personnel accountable; build effective teams and maintain professional relationships with subordinates, peers, supervisors, partner agencies, and the public.

· Ability to use modern technology and law enforcement information systems.

Licenses and Certifications

Certifications may be required at hire, within specified timeframes, or as assigned based on duties.

· Colorado Peace Officer certification (Colorado POST) - must be currently certified, eligible for certification, or able to obtain certification consistent with Colorado POST rules and agency hiring requirements.

Required after hire or promotion (timeframes may be adjusted based on training availability and assignment):

· CPR and First Aid certification within 90 days of employment.

· FEMA ICS 100 and ICS 700 within 6 months of employment.

· Obtain OSN access as required within 6 months of request to CBI (or as otherwise directed).

Required as assigned/based on operations need:

· Intoxilyzer certification if assigned to operate the instrument.

· Arrest control/defensive tactics certification per agency policy.

· Range qualification/certification for duty weapons as required by policy (handgun/rifle/shotgun as applicable).

· Taser certification.

· Any additional certifications required for specialized assignments (e.g., tactical team, grant-funded programs).

Work Environment and Physical Demands

Work is performed in a variety of environments including offices, vehicles, court settings, and outdoor locations. Duties may involve exposure to inclement weather, uneven terrain, noise, hazards, infectious materials, and confrontational situations. The position requires the ability to sit, stand, walk, run, kneel, crouch, climb, and lift/carry equipment; to physically restrain individuals when necessary; and to safely operate vehicles and equipment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Part-Time DPS Coordinator - HB0001
description:
The part-time Program Coordinator is responsible for managing the daily operations of the doctoral program and serving as the primary liaison for its various constituents, including faculty, students, alumni, applicants, prospects, and university staff. The administrative tasks required to successfully manage the position are divided into three core domains: resources/technology, university procedures, and program-specific administration.

Position Duties

  • Serving as the initial point of contact for inquiries. The part-time coordinator must log communication details into the applicant database, guide prospects through Application Parts A and B, collect supplementary items (resumes, $75 fees, official transcripts, and recommendations), and maintain biographical files.
  • Reviewing completed applications, coordinating interview schedules on the director's calendar, evaluating candidates alongside the director, and formally processing acceptance or rejection decisions.
  • Facilitating student course registrations, manually overriding Banner restrictions when necessary, tracking students maintaining matriculation ($250 fee), and verifying that student files contain all mandated documentation.
  • Administering the written and oral exam cycles twice a year (January and September). Tasks include ordering exam rooms eight weeks out, collecting faculty questions, managing the secure testing software environment (Respondus), monitoring students during the 4-to-6-hour written tests, audio-recording the 2.5-hour oral components, and filing final evaluation sheets.
  • Creating committee appointment paperwork and scheduling two formal presentation meetings (Proposal Approval and Dissertation Defense) by tracking calendar availability across five distinct committee members.
  • Filing Independent Contractor and Vendor Request forms to process honoraria payments for committee members. Additionally, the coordinator reviews student folders for graduation clearance and coordinates the delivery of finalized dissertations to the university library for binding.
  • Managing the monthly on-campus seminar days where students attend full-day classes. The part-time coordinator books the entire 15th floor of 163 William Street, manages catering and counts with the Downtown Conference Center, submits help desk tickets for media equipment, and ensures building security unlocks the facilities.
  • Partnering with the program director to review, correct, and distribute upcoming semester course schedules with the office of academic scheduling and department chairs.
  • Tracking the department budget utilizing university systems to process purchase orders, handle document services (copying, printing, secure shredding), and oversee office supply replenishment via eProcurement.
  • Performs other such duties as may be assigned from time to time.

Supervision Exercied

Training and overseeing graduate and student assistants who perform routine clerical tasks.

Work Hours

Exact hours to be determined with supervisor; generally up to 20 hours per week.

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Must be proficient in MS Office, internet applications, detail-oriented, and able to handle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and oral communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills are essential.
  • Prior work experience in a University and/or administrative position preferred.

title: Finance Business Partner - Credit Control
description: Purpose of the Job : As a Credit Controller for the South West Europe cluster (based in Barcelona), you will be responsible for managing the credit and collections activities across assigned customers and countries, ensuring timely cash collection, effective credit-risk management and accurate accounts receivable balances. You will work closely with Sales, Customer Service, Finance Business Partners and customers to resolve outstanding balances, prevent overdue debt and support the business in achieving its cash-flow and working-capital objectives. The role has a dual stakeholder structure, with functional reporting to the Divisional Head – Credit Management Europe and close collaboration with the South West Cluster Finance Business Partner. Major Responsibilities : Credit Insurance: Working closely with Credit Insurance Credit advice service providers to ensure adequate Credit limits are assigned for customers to achieve business growth. Manage the operational daily credit management processes, including order blocking, discretionary credit limit reviews, internal credit limit proposals and new customers credit limit analysis. Responsible of Credit Master Data. Credit Overdue Management: Oversee timely customer collections and efficient credit management to ensure lower DSO levels meet monthly targets. Cash Collection Activities: Open item management, direct debit processing and issue resolution (invoice or credit notes related), dunning activities and verification of cash application. Commercial Policy Compliance: Responsible of customer rebates management, customer master data control and analysis and support on any other compliance topic related to commercial Finance. title: Railroad Signal Maintainer
description:
Signal Technician in the Madison, WI area

Incentives Include:

  • Company vehicle, laptop, and cell phone provided.
  • Wages are negotiable as per experience.

Benefits Include:

  • Health, dental, vision, and 401-K plan.
  • Employer paid long term disability and life insurance for all full-time employees.
  • Paid holidays after 60 days of employment.
  • Employee referral bonuses
Summary
A Railroad Signal Maintainer for CDL is responsible for testing, maintaining and improving signal systems at grade crossings and way-side signal locations in accordance with FRA and CDL standards. Alacrity, Dependability, Pride, Ownership, Teamwork and having a Safety Mindset are the hallmarks of a top performer in this job class.
A signal maintainer will be evaluated in 5 basic areas:
  • Safety
  • Maintenance & Improvements
  • Testing & Inspections
  • Trouble Calls & Troubleshooting
  • Team Player

Preferred Experiences:

  • Knowledge of basic electronics and electrical fundamentals with an emphasis in low-voltage AC & DC circuits and relay or ladder logic. Must be able to read wiring diagrams and use multi-meter.
  • Knowledge of rail operations generally and railroad signaling principals specifically. The focus of a signal maintainer will be grade crossing warning systems, defect detectors and AEI readers and possibly radio communications.
  • Signal maintaining is a largely independent job thus good time management and personal initiative are essential.
  • Must be proficient with a personal computer and the MS Office line of products.
  • High school diploma or GED equivalent unless otherwise approved by upper management.
  • Relatable experience in HVAC, Avionics, Communications, Motor Control and PLCs will also be evaluated as requirements for the job. Responsible for testing, maintaining, and improving grade crossing warning, AEI, or defect detector systems on an assigned territory. Follow regulations and testing procedures as set forth in the Blue Book.
  • Willing to be On-Call much of the time and respond to dispatch and supervisor Trouble Calls in a timely manner.
  • Understand and comply with FRA rules and regulations around railroad signaling, including the Hours-of-Service Law.
  • Be responsible for all paperwork and retention schedules. Paperwork can include testing records, HOS forms, timesheets, material handling forms and trouble tickets. The responsibility for complete and accurate testing records and HOS documentation may continue after separation from CDL; voluntary or involuntary.
  • Foster good relationships with local railroad customers and supplier.
  • Be a team player willing to help on other territories and railroads. Assist with special projects, when assigned.
  • Responsible for the safety of themselves and those around them. Reports any unsafe conditions that may exist.
  • Keep company vehicle, equipment, tools and meters in good working order, following all maintenance and calibration schedules.
  • Responsible for implementing strategies to maximize profitability in their area of responsibility.
  • Other duties assigned by leadership team.
  • Demonstrate and attain CDL Core Values: SAFETY, PEOPLE, INTEGRITY, ACCOUNTABILITY, AND EXCELLENCE
  • Demonstrate and attain CDL Core Focus: CUSTOMER SERVICE

Physical Demands:

  • Standing, walking, bending, kneeling and/or sitting for long periods of time.
  • Climbing ladders to reach ceilings and other high objects.
  • Push/Pull/Lift/Moving 50 pounds repeatedly.
  • Working in adverse weather conditions.
  • Walk and stand on uneven surfaces

title: Safety Security Officer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE: Safety Security Officer

FLSA: Non-Exempt

DIVISION: Operations

REPORTS TO: Shift Supervisor

LOCATION: QUEENS, NYC

SALARY: $19.65 hourly


SUMMARY:

The Safety Security Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of all clients, staff, and the property at a homeless shelter. Operations within our facility are 24 hours. This is a relief position that requires face-to-face relief with mandated overtime. This position reports to the Shift Supervisor and Security Manager.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform daily inspections of all clients’ rooms
  • Escort clients to appointments as needed
  • Interact with and monitor clients' behavior, maintaining a good rapport by providing excellent customer service. Encourage clients to comply with the facility's policies and procedures.
  • Control access at the main entrance by screening all clients and visitors with a magnetometer or x-ray machine to detect and prevent weapons from entering the site.
  • Perform Crisis Intervention to de-escalate potential crises and document all such situations and interventions.
  • Make hourly rounds throughout the entire facility, including all hallways, stairwells, floors, bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, and office spaces.
  • Respond to incidents
  • Assist with client intakes
  • Perform daily pack-ups and logging of client property belonging to AWOL clients
  • Store and remove client property once the mandated storage time has expired
  • Maintain a clean and organized storage area
  • Complete logs, incident reports, and all other required documentation.
  • Make calls to police, fire department, and other first responders as directed.
  • Perform administrative and receptionist duties at the operations desk; monitor video surveillance cameras, and the fire prevention/detection alarm notification system.
  • Provide duties related to fire incidents, evacuation of the building when necessary, and utilizing Fire procedures.
  • Ensure the safety and security of all assigned equipment.
  • Mandated overtime
  • Perform other tasks as assigned.

EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION, AND SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

High school diploma or GED. Prior security experience required. Must have NYS Security Guard License and current 8-Hour Annual Certificate. Fire Guard License for Shelters preferred F02. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are necessary. Certified in Nonviolent Crisis Intervention (CPI) preferred. Must be able to work flexible shifts, weekends, and overtime if necessary.


AGENCY PROFILE & EMPLOYEE EXPECTATIONS:

Westhab is a prominent community development organization, providing housing and supportive services for more than 10,000 of the most vulnerable members of our community each year. Our expectations for all staff are high. We believe that the people and the communities that we have the privilege to serve deserve our very best every day. We are a results-driven organization that focuses on empowerment and impact. If you want to apply for this opportunity, it should only be because you feel ready for the challenges and expectations that come with joining this kind of team. (EOE)

OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ADMINISTRATION (OSHA):

The Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) ensures safe and healthful working conditions by setting and enforcing standards and providing training, outreach, education, and assistance. Westhab complies with all applicable OSHA standards, rules, and regulations and keeps our workplaces free of serious recognized hazards.

CapitolHill Consortium for Counseling & Consultation, LLC (CCCC) is a well-established, multidisciplinary healthcare and behavioral health group practice serving clients throughout the Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia region. Join a growing, multidisciplinary healthcare and behavioral health practice where you can focus on what matters most: providing excellent patient care.

Grow Clinically. Not Just Your Caseload.

At CapitolHill Consortium for Counseling and Consultation, we believe your career should evolve—not plateau. We don’t just offer a place to see clients. We look to nurture and invest in helping you become a more skilled, confident, and specialized clinician through curated, high-impact training opportunities and ongoing clinical development.

This is one of many trainings that are part of a learning pathway at CCCC. You’ll have opportunities to integrate these modalities into your work, participate in peer groups at CCCC who have like minded clinical interest, and build real depth in areas that matter - both for client outcomes and your long-term career trajectory.

Diversity As A Core Value.   • Community engagement

We welcome experienced and emerging clinicians who are seeking a supportive, inclusive, and values-aligned professional home. To apply, please submit your CV/Resume and a brief cover letter.

SUMMARY:

The Safety Security Officer is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of all clients, staff, and the property at a homeless shelter. Operations within our facility are 24 hours. This is a relief position that requires face-to-face relief with mandated overtime. This position reports to the Shift Supervisor and Security Manager.

  • Provide duties related to fire incidents, evacuation of the building when necessary, and utilizing Fire procedures.
  • Ensure the safety and security of all assigned equipment.
  • Mandated overtime

High school diploma or GED. Prior security experience required. Must have NYS Security Guard License and current 8-Hour Annual Certificate. Fire Guard License for Shelters preferred F02. title: PDI Technician
description:

Overview:

The Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) Technician is responsible for diagnosing, inspecting, adjusting, repairing, and preparing recreational vehicles (RVs), including travel trailers, for delivery. This role ensures all units meet quality standards and are 100% complete before being handed over to customers. Responsibilities may include work on gas, electrical, hydraulic, plumbing, chassis/towing systems, generators, appliances, and interior features.

Key Responsibilities:

Pre-Delivery Inspections & Repairs:

  • Conduct comprehensive pre-delivery inspections with detailed repair order documentation.

  • Diagnose and repair propane, electrical, hydraulic, and plumbing systems in RVs.

  • Perform general repairs and parts installations to ensure trailer readiness.

  • Utilize manuals, catalogs, and digital resources to troubleshoot and resolve issues.

  • Execute minor carpentry, appliance repair, and hitch installations.

Quality Control & Compliance:

  • Ensure each unit is 100% complete before delivery.

  • Confirm repairs meet company quality standards and safety requirements.

  • Document all work performed in accordance with company and regulatory standards.

Tool & Equipment Handling:

  • Operate various hand and power tools for installations and repairs.

  • Maintain organized work areas and properly care for tools and equipment.

Customer Readiness:

  • Prepare units for customer walkthroughs by ensuring cleanliness and operational functionality.

  • Collaborate with delivery and service teams to meet delivery timelines.

Additional Duties:

  • Perform other related tasks as directed by the supervisor or service manager.

  • Remain adaptable and available for weekend work as needed.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 6+ months’ experience in RV, automotive, or carpentry repair.

  • Strong knowledge of construction/carpentry practices.

  • Electrical systems experience required.

  • Experience with hitch installations and brake control systems preferred.

  • Familiarity with propane systems and appliance troubleshooting.

  • Ability to understand and interpret technical instructions and diagrams.

  • Basic computer proficiency for documentation and diagnostics.

  • Excellent attention to detail and manual dexterity.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to work in outdoor or non-climate-controlled environments.

title: Cultivation Tech
description:
The Opportunity

Lake Leaf Cultivation offers a dynamic and engaging environment where you will have the opportunity to work in on-site cannabis cultivation. Our Cultivation Agents are integral to maintaining plant production and health, ensuring the highest quality product through stringent quality control measures. You will work closely with the Cultivation Manager and team to carry out daily plant care activities, maintain the cleanliness and efficiency of the production area, and adhere to both state and Mille Lacs Band standards. Join us and be a part of a company that values inclusivity, continuous learning, and servant leadership.

What You Get to Do

· Measures and mixes nutrient and plant applications and applies these mixtures according to Lake Leaf Cultivation policy.

· Assists Cultivation Facility Manager with rotation of strains through garden to ensure variety and quantity for dispensary locations.

· Performs all assigned duties required to ensure a clean and safe cultivation facility. If you notice something that is a hygienic hazard to product or Associates, notify your supervisor immediately.

· Responsible for the cleanliness of all cultivation equipment and tools, including light reflectors, containers, mixing tools, application tools, and ventilation equipment.

· Assists the Cultivation Manager with tracking plants from birth to harvest by ensuring proper and accurate documentation for applicable activities.

· Ensures accurate documentation of all plant tracking numbers, lot numbers, and all other applicable information.

· Documents, according to Lake Leaf Cultivation policy, the application of all nutrients and/or substances applied to any plant located within the cultivation facility.

· Assist with trimming and harvesting as needed

· Additional Duties as Required.

What We Look for in a Person

· Serves and develops others by building relationships.

· Fosters an inclusive workplace where inclusion and individual differences are valued.

· Collaborates across boundaries to achieve common goals.

· Aligns organizational objectives and practices with Mille Lacs Band traditions or interests as appropriate.

· Sets direction and influences others to translate vision into action.

· Demonstrates drive for continued personal and professional growth.

What We Offer You

· We have a fun, energetic personality and are adventurous, creative, and open minded.

· We strive to lead through our seven (7) values in all that we do. (Wisdom, Love, Respect, Truth, Humility, Bravery, and Honesty)

· Our foundation of Servant Leadership is a philosophy that embodies and fosters empowerment, decision-making and engagement across all levels of the organization.

· We are a career accelerant, which means developing our Associates is one of our main priorities.

· We provide a space for Associates and others to bring who they are to work and impart a sense of purpose.

· A variety of competitively priced health benefits and supplemental insurances, parental leave, 401k, tuition reimbursement, birthday, and anniversary gifts.

Objectives of this role

· Ensure Optimal Plant Health and Yield: Drive awareness of optimal cultivation practices across the team and identify any substandard processes through close monitoring and evaluation of plant health data.

· Enhance Cultivation Processes: Serve as a thought leader for cultivation processes, developing and implementing prototypes and practices that promote increased efficiency and productivity in plant care and yield.

· Implement Quality Control Measures: Create and enforce precise quality control measures at every stage of the cultivation process to maintain high product standards.

· Maintain Accurate Documentation: Ensure thorough and accurate documentation of all plant care activities, including nutrient application, plant health analysis, and growth tracking, to comply with regulatory standards and company policies.

· Develop Team Competency: Provide training and guidance to team members to ensure they understand and adhere to cultivation best practices, fostering a knowledgeable and skilled workforce.

What Qualifies You

· Two-year degree in horticulture or related field preferred.

· Two years of experience in general gardening production, preferably a regulated field producing for human consumption.

· Or any satisfactory combination of experience and training that clearly demonstrates the ability to perform the above duties.

· Preferred knowledge of cannabis law, and horticulture skills.

Must Haves

· Effective time-management skills and ability to multi-task.

· Ability to stand, sit, kneel, and lift equipment or plants up to 50 lbs. for extended periods.

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing, and challenging environment.

· Reside within a distance that allows for a regular on-site presence.

· Ability to climb small ladder to access up to three tier platform.

Work Environment

· Indoor cultivation facility with controlled temperatures and humidity levels.

· Exposure to strong odors and varying noise levels.

· Frequent use of sharp tools and trimming equipment.

· Standing or sitting for long periods while performing repetitive tasks.

· Compliance with strict hygiene and sanitation standards.

· Collaborative team environment with communication between multiple departments.

· Adherence to safety protocols to maintain a clean and safe workspace

title: Administrative Aide – Theatre

CITY OF FARMINGTON

NUMBER OF VACANCIES: 1

APPLICATIONS WILL BE RECEIVED UNTIL: Open Until Filled

ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

Reports directly to the Facilities Manager in coordination with the Artistic Director and Production Manager. The Facilities Manager is responsible for coordinating needed tasks and schedules with the Artistic Director and Production Manager to ensure clear expectations for this position.

Provides specialized administrative support to the theatre productions and programming offered through the Civic Center division (approximately 70% of time allocated to these tasks). Provides general administrative support to all other aspects of the Civic Center division (approximately 30% of allocated time).

Specialized administrative support for theatre production and programming (70% of time) includes but is not limited to:

  • Coordinates rentals of the theater within the division
  • Prepares and distributes communication and contracts for production casts and crew, assist with vendor registration, background checks, and other needed onboarding processes
  • Coordinated travel and housing for contracted performers and crew
  • Schedules and attends Production meetings
  • Coordinates costume rentals/purchase
  • Manages theatre production volunteers
  • Assists with show program content
  • Assists with box office management and sales

General administrative tasks (30% of time):

Performs a variety of routine and complex clerical, secretarial and administrative work in keeping official records, providing administrative support to the Civic Center staff, and assisting in the administration and operation of the department.

Works under the general supervision of the Facilities Manager. No supervision is exercised in this position.

Using excellent customer service skills, establishes and maintains effective working relationships with other employees, officials, and all members of the general public.

Prepares daily operations report. Reviews for accuracy before posting for technicians.

Greets the public and answers questions both in person and over the telephone. Responds to inquiries from employees, citizens and others and refers, when necessary, to appropriate persons. Screens incoming calls or provides requested information to the client.

Obtains booking information for major events, meetings, and theatrical performances. Prepares necessary paperwork to complete booking.

Prepares monthly billing of Civic Center patrons.

Sets up computerized ticketing information for concerts or other major theater events for ticket sales. Responsible for all ticket sales, deposits, reports and pay outs to the customer or client. Closes out cash register daily and prepares deposits.

Prepares event billings. In the case of nonpayment, follows up with second and final notices, if necessary.

Prepares monthly reports and other specialized statistical reports as assigned.

Assists with payroll and time keeping for all employees in the Civic Center division as needed.

Responsible for receiving invoices, processing FPO's, reconciling P-Card statements and processing for payment. Maintains all records related to accounts payable.

Receives and distributes incoming mail; establishes and maintains filing system.

Orders and maintains inventory of office, janitorial and concessions supplies.

Assists all other departmental staff as needed for special projects or special events.

Operates a motor vehicle to assist in carrying out the business of the department and the City.

Attendance at work is an essential function of this position.

NON-ESSENTIAL DUTIES:

May serve on various employee committees, as required and assigned.

The duties listed above are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to the position.

QUALIFICATIONS

This position is subject to the City's Drug and Alcohol-Free Workplace Program which includes: pre-employment testing, post-accident testing, reasonable suspicion testing, return-to-duty testing, and follow-up testing.

All applicants must provide enough information for a thorough background check.

Graduation from high school or GED equivalent required. Specialized experience in the Production or Performing Arts administration preferred.

Ability to type 60 wpm or at a rate sufficient to perform duties of job.

Valid driver's license with acceptable driving record for past three years.

Working knowledge of personal computers and software packages, including specific knowledge of Word and Excel. Ability to learn EventPro software used in booking events and meetings.

Data entry experience preferred.

Ability to provide exceptional customer service in a high-pressure situation.

Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing.

Ability to handle stressful situations in a busy office setting.

Ability to successfully organize, work and complete multiple tasks simultaneously.

Ability to maintain confidential, sensitive material.

Ability to establish and maintain working relationships with co-workers, supervisors, other City personnel and the public.

Ability to operate tools and equipment listed.

Extensive background checks required.

This position has the responsibility to participate in and comply with the City's Environmental, Health, and Safety program.

TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT USED:

Personal computer including Microsoft software and Google Suite, calculator, copy machine, telephone, fax machine, and base station radio.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit; walk; talk or hear; use hand to operate tools or controls; and reach with hands and arms.

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The work environment is generally a normal office setting, but will occasionally need to assist at the outdoor amphitheater in various weather conditions.

title: Modern Workplace Engineer F/M
description:
WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯

Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology.


WHY JOIN US? 🚀

At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate

📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day

🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us.

🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,300 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux

Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming!


ENTER THE GAME 🎮

As a Modern Workplace Engineer, you will join Betclic’s Technology Department to design, integrate and improve cloud services, identity solutions and internal tools.

You will work mainly on Microsoft Azure, Okta, SaaS integrations and AI powered tools, while developing automations that improve operational reliability and the employee experience.

Autonomous, pragmatic and close to users, you will take ownership of complex technical topics while occasionally providing advanced support when needed.


YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥

In this role, your main missions will be:

Azure Architecture and Operations

  • Design, deploy and maintain services and infrastructures in Microsoft Azure.
  • Administer cloud resources, access, networks, application environments and monitoring mechanisms.
  • Ensure the availability, performance, security and cost control of cloud services.
  • Automate deployments and recurring operations.
  • Contribute to architecture choices and the evolution of the cloud platform.
  • Maintain clear and useful technical documentation.

Okta Identity and Integration

  • Integrate new applications into Okta.
  • Configure and maintain SSO, MFA and provisioning mechanisms.
  • Implement standards such as SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
  • Automate the lifecycle management of accounts, groups and permissions.
  • Collaborate with Security, HR and business teams to ensure consistent identity and access management.
  • Diagnose and resolve authentication or provisioning incidents.

AI and SaaS Tool Integration

  • Integrate AI solutions into the company environment in collaboration with GenAI teams.
  • Connect AI tools to internal applications, data and processes using APIs, webhooks or automation platforms.

Build prototypes and support their transition into production.

  • Define safeguards around access, sensitive data, traceability and responsible AI usage.
  • Monitor new tools and use cases.

Development and Automation

  • Develop scripts, connectors, APIs and internal tools.
  • Automate administration, onboarding, offboarding, control and reporting tasks.
  • Produce clean, maintainable, documented and version-controlled code.
  • Set up tests, code reviews and reliable deployment mechanisms.
  • Contribute to an engineering culture based on automation and continuous improvement.

User Support and Adoption

  • Provide advanced technical support on cloud, identity, application and workplace topics.
  • Occasionally handle user requests when priorities or complexity require it.
  • Identify root causes of incidents and implement long-term solutions.
  • Share knowledge with support teams and contribute to the documentation base.
  • Support users during the rollout of new tools and help drive adoption.

This position requires a strong sense of service and real availability when users need technical support.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍

We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm!

This job is for you if:

  • You have an Engineering degree or equivalent university-level education in IT.
  • You have at least 5 years of experience in Systems Engineering, Modern Workplace, Cloud, Platform or Integration.
  • You have solid experience with Microsoft Azure and hands-on experience with Okta.
  • You understand IAM, SSO, MFA, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
  • You can develop scripts and integrations, especially with PowerShell or Python.
  • You have experience with APIs, webhooks, JSON, Git and code management best practices.
  • You understand security, logging, secrets management and complex technical troubleshooting.
  • You enjoy moving from architecture to implementation and user support.
  • You are autonomous, pragmatic, rigorous and results-oriented.
  • You communicate clearly, enjoy teamwork and can explain technical topics simply.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable working in an international environment.

WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS? 📝

If your application is shortlisted, Sébastien will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning).

Next, you will meet Florent, your future manager.

After meeting your future manager, you will have a technical interview with an expert from the Internal IT team.

Finally, Sébastien will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together.

The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you.


WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT? 🎁

✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days

🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic)

🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children

🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport)

🏡 Hybrid work model

📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year

🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin

🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life

🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…)

title: Crisis Counselor/Clinician
description:
POSITIONS ARE AVAILABLE IN CLEVELAND & GASTON COUNTIES.

General Definition:

In general, under direct supervision of the immediate supervisor or clinical manger the individual is responsible for providing community/facility based Crisis services that are aimed at the prevention, intervention, and immediate stabilization of Crisis events experienced by MH/DD/SA consumers or consumers experiencing emotional distress in response to a Crisis . Examples of Crisis services shall include in community Crisis response and Crisis prevention/intervention.

Performance Expectations (Quality and Quantity):

Each Clinician will be assigned primary and secondary responsibilities, these assignments may changes at any time depending on the need of the agency/department and at the direction of the supervisor.

1. Primary Responsibility: Shall demonstrate the use of knowledge/skill/judgment and provide24/7/365 inpatient clinical services that evidence quality, performance, and meet the needs of persons served and other stakeholders. Performance tasks shall

include:

· Perform screening and evaluation for consumers who are requesting admission/being referred for admission to one of the PCC inpatient services (Facility Based Crisis , Detoxification, SA Residential Treatment, and 23 Hour Observation). Completing the appropriate steps to process a possible admission (i.e. staffing with other clinical staff, staffing with medical staff, and contacting MD/NP). Screenings for admission to one of the inpatient services must be completed using the Mobile Crisis assessment packet, once the consumer has been approved for admission then the screening can be entered under the 24/7 service that the consumer will be engaging in.

o Admission documentation must clearly identify the criteria that the consumer meets as well as the medical necessity for the consumer to receive the requested service.

· Once a consumer has been admitted to one of the inpatient programs the clinical staff will continue to work with the consumer in the development of the Person Centered Plan and document progress/lack of progress towards meeting goals/objectives specified in the PCP.
